user_policy.intent: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.
user_policy.effects: Visible power effects are wanted and may be strong: blazing solar fire, lightning, storms, floods, underworld flame and smoke, divine radiance, petrifying gaze, cosmic scale. Every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute or deed documented in the research claims of that being (for example Ra and the sun, Medusa and her petrifying gaze). Do not add an effect that the research does not support.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, limbs and eyes, and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects add atmosphere and power; they never replace or invent anatomy.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle, monumental scale with small environmental references, dramatic cinematic lighting, strong silhouette, rich detail; the being dominates the frame. Benevolent deities are majestic and radiant rather than monstrous; malevolent beings are menacing.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark. No gore or nudity.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Living religions (Hindu deities, angels, Egyptian revival worship) are depicted with respect.

text.id: Namanya tercatat sejak karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM
text.en: His name is attested from Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC

short_description.id: Mikhael adalah malaikat agung yang dihormati dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam; ia dipandang sebagai pejuang Tuhan dan pelindung umat-Nya.
short_description.en: Michael is an archangel honoured in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, regarded as the warrior of God and a protector of God's people.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, Mikhael diyakini sebagai malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan, dan sebagian tradisi Kristen juga menghormatinya sebagai orang kudus. Penyebutan namanya yang tertua yang masih ada berasal dari karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menempatkannya sebagai pemimpin para malaikat. Kitab Henokh mendaftarnya sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung.
long_description.en: In Jewish, Christian, and Islamic tradition, Michael is believed to be an archangel and the warrior of God, and some Christian traditions also venerate him as a saint. The oldest surviving mentions of his name come from Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC, which present him as chief of the angels. The Book of Enoch lists him as one of seven archangels.

long_description.id: Kitab Daniel menyebut Mikhael sebagai salah satu pemimpin utama yang datang menolong, dan sebagai pemimpin agung yang akan bangkit membela umat Daniel. Berdasarkan ayat-ayat ini, tulisan Yahudi awal dan Kitab Henokh menyebutnya pemimpin Israel, sedangkan tulisan Yahudi yang lebih kemudian menyebutnya pembela orang Yahudi. Karena peran itu, ia juga digambarkan sebagai malaikat kesabaran dan belas kasihan. Dalam Haggadah, ia ditampilkan sebagai malaikat agung yang paling menonjol.
long_description.en: The Book of Daniel calls Michael one of the chief princes who came to help, and the great prince who will stand up for Daniel's people. On the basis of these verses, early Jewish writings and the Book of Enoch call him the prince of Israel, while later Jewish writings call him the advocate of the Jews. Because of this role he is also described as the angel of forbearance and mercy. In the Haggadah he appears as the most prominent of the archangels.

long_description.id: Dalam Perjanjian Baru, Kitab Wahyu mengisahkan perang di surga ketika Mikhael dan para malaikatnya melawan naga, yang kemudian dicampakkan ke bumi. Surat Yudas menyebut Mikhael sang malaikat agung berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa. Menurut Ensiklopedia Katolik, tradisi Kristen memberinya tugas melawan Satan, menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman terutama pada saat kematian, dan menjadi pembela umat Tuhan.
long_description.en: In the New Testament, the Book of Revelation tells of a war in heaven in which Michael and his angels fight the dragon, which is then cast out into the earth. The Epistle of Jude speaks of Michael the archangel disputing with the devil over the body of Moses. According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives him the offices of fighting Satan, rescuing the souls of the faithful especially at the hour of death, and championing God's people.

long_description.id: Dalam Islam, Mikhael (Mīkāʾīl) adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung dan sering dipasangkan dengan Jibril. Literatur Islam mengaitkannya dengan rahmat, dengan permohonan ampun bagi manusia, serta dengan gejala alam dan turunnya hujan. Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, ia jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
long_description.en: In Islam, Michael (Mīkāʾīl) is one of the four archangels and is often paired with Gabriel. Islamic literature associates him with mercy, with asking forgiveness for humans, and with natural phenomena and rain. Unlike in Christian tradition, he is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Kristen, Mikhael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak. Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal. Para pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepadanya, dan di Frigia ia terutama dikenal sebagai penyembuh.
long_description.en: Christian art shows Michael as a fully armed angelic warrior with helmet, sword, and shield, standing above the dragon and at times driving a lance into it. He is also shown with scales used to weigh the souls of the dead. Early Christians entrusted the care of the sick to him, and in Phrygia he was known above all as a healer.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Ensiklopedia Katolik, tradisi Kristen memberi Mikhael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan, menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman pada saat kematian, dan menjadi pembela umat Tuhan, sehingga ia dijadikan pelindung Gereja.
cultural_context.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting Satan, rescuing the souls of the faithful at the hour of death, and championing God's people, so that he became the patron of the Church.

literal_meaning.en: Who is like El (God)?

who.id: Mikhael adalah malaikat agung yang dipandang sebagai pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, maupun Islam.
who.en: Michael is an archangel regarded as God's warrior in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam alike.

origin.id: Namanya pertama tercatat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM.
origin.en: His name first appears in Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC.

role.id: Ia diyakini sebagai pelindung Israel dan pembela umat Tuhan.
role.en: He is believed to be the guardian of Israel and the champion of God's people.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena memimpin para malaikat melawan naga dalam perang di surga menurut Kitab Wahyu.
famous_for.en: He is best known for leading the angels against the dragon in the war in heaven described in Revelation.

did_you_know.id: Liturgi Yunani menyebut Mikhael Archistrategos, yang berarti "panglima tertinggi".
did_you_know.en: The Greek liturgy calls Michael Archistrategos, meaning "highest general".

description.id: Para pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Mikhael, dan di Frigia ia dihormati terutama sebagai penyembuh.
description.en: Early Christians entrusted the care of the sick to Michael, and in Phrygia he was honoured above all as a healer.

role.en: Leader of the angels

summary.id: Mikhael dan para malaikatnya berperang melawan naga dan malaikat-malaikatnya; naga besar yang disebut Iblis dan Satan itu dicampakkan ke bumi.
summary.en: Michael and his angels fight the dragon and its angels; the great dragon, called the Devil and Satan, is cast out into the earth.

title.en: The dispute over the body of Moses

role.en: Opponent of the devil in the dispute

summary.id: Menurut Surat Yudas, Mikhael berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa, tetapi tidak menghujatnya dan hanya berkata, "The Lord rebuke thee."
summary.en: According to Jude, Michael disputed with the devil about the body of Moses but did not bring a railing accusation against him, saying only, "The Lord rebuke thee."

role.en: Helper

summary.id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, pemimpin kerajaan Persia menghalangi utusan yang datang kepada Daniel, sampai Mikhael, salah satu pemimpin utama, datang menolong.
summary.en: In the Book of Daniel, the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstands the messenger sent to Daniel until Michael, one of the chief princes, comes to help.

description.id: Tempat suci terkenal di Normandia tempat Mikhael dihormati sebagai pelindung para pelaut.
description.en: Famous sanctuary in Normandy where Michael is honoured as patron of mariners.

description.id: Tempat suci Mikhael yang termasyhur, terkait dengan kisah penampakannya yang tercatat dalam Brevir Romawi.
description.en: Renowned sanctuary of Michael linked to the account of his apparition in the Roman Breviary.

description.id: Nama Mikhael muncul dalam karya-karya Yahudi dari abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM.
description.en: Michael's name appears in Jewish works of the third and second centuries BC.

description.id: Penampakan Mikhael di tempat sucinya di Monte Gargano menurut Brevir Romawi.
description.en: Michael's apparition at his sanctuary on Monte Gargano, as related in the Roman Breviary.

note.id: Dalam Kitab Wahyu, naga yang dilawan Mikhael disebut Iblis dan Satan.
note.en: In Revelation, the dragon fought by Michael is called the Devil and Satan.

note.id: Menurut tulisan Yahudi, permusuhan Mikhael dengan Samael bermula ketika Samael dicampakkan dari surga.
note.en: According to Jewish writings, Michael's enmity with Samael began when Samael was thrown down from heaven.

note.id: Dalam Islam, Mikhael sering dipasangkan dengan Jibril sebagai sesama malaikat agung.
note.en: In Islam, Michael is often paired with Gabriel as a fellow archangel.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa peran Mikhael sebagai pejuang lebih menonjol dalam tradisi Kristen daripada dalam tradisi Islam?
learning_questions.en: Why might Michael's role as a warrior be more prominent in Christian tradition than in Islamic tradition?

learning_questions.id: Apa persamaan dan perbedaan gambaran Mikhael dalam Kitab Daniel dan Kitab Wahyu?
learning_questions.en: What are the similarities and differences between Michael's portrayal in Daniel and in Revelation?

claims.quote: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam while additionally being venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

statement.id: Michael, juga disebut Archangel Michael atau Michael the Taxiarch, adalah malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, dan dihormati sebagai orang kudus dalam sebagian tradisi Kristen.
statement.en: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, and is venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

claims.quote: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, often but not always apocalyptic, where he is the chief of the angels and archangels

statement.id: Penyebutan nama Michael tertua yang masih ada terdapat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menyebutnya pemimpin para malaikat dan malaikat agung.
statement.en: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, where he is chief of the angels and archangels.

claims.quote: he is the guardian prince of ancient Israel and is responsible for the care of the Israelites

statement.id: Ia adalah pangeran pelindung Israel kuno dan bertanggung jawab memelihara bangsa Israel.
statement.en: He is the guardian prince of ancient Israel, responsible for the care of the Israelites.

claims.quote: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels (the remaining names are Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel)

statement.id: Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch) mendaftar Michael sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung, bersama Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, dan Remiel.
statement.en: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels, with Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel.

claims.quote: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel, with whom he is often paired), ʾIsrāfīl (trumpeter angel) and ʿAzrāʾīl (angel of death).

statement.id: Dalam Islam, Michael atau Mīkāʾīl adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung bersama Jibril (Gabriel), yang sering dipasangkan dengannya, Israfil, dan Azrail.
statement.en: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel), with whom he is often paired, Israfil, and Azrail.

claims.quote: In further Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy. He asks God for forgiveness for humans

statement.id: Dalam literatur Islam, Michael dikaitkan dengan rahmat dan memohon ampun kepada Tuhan bagi manusia.
statement.en: In Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy and asks God for forgiveness for humans.

claims.quote: As the angel to effectuate God's providence he is also associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

statement.id: Sebagai malaikat pelaksana pemeliharaan Tuhan, ia dikaitkan dengan gejala alam dan menurunkan hujan ke daratan.
statement.en: As the angel who carries out God's providence, he is associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

claims.quote: Unlike Christian tradition, Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior-angel

statement.id: Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, dalam Islam Michael jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
statement.en: Unlike in Christian tradition, in Islam Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.

claims.quote: (Hebrew "Who is like God?"). St. Michael is one of the principal angels; his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle fought in heaven against the enemy and his followers.

statement.id: Nama Michael dalam bahasa Ibrani berarti "Who is like God?" (Siapa yang seperti Allah?); ia salah satu malaikat utama, dan namanya menjadi seruan perang para malaikat baik dalam pertempuran di surga.
statement.en: The Hebrew name Michael means "Who is like God?"; he is one of the principal angels, and his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle in heaven.

claims.quote: Following these Scriptural passages, Christian tradition gives to St. Michael four offices: To fight against Satan. To rescue the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

statement.id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia (Ensiklopedia Katolik), tradisi Kristen memberi Michael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan dan menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman dari kuasa musuh, terutama pada saat kematian.
statement.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting against Satan and rescuing the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

claims.quote: To be the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law, the Christians in the New Testament; therefore he was the patron of the Church

statement.id: Michael adalah pembela umat Tuhan, orang Yahudi dalam Hukum Lama dan orang Kristen dalam Perjanjian Baru, sehingga ia menjadi pelindung Gereja.
statement.en: Michael is the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law and the Christians in the New Testament, and therefore the patron of the Church.

claims.quote: In art St. Michael is represented as an angelic warrior, fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield (often the shield bears the Latin inscription: Quis ut Deus), standing over the dragon, whom he sometimes pierces with a lance.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak.
statement.en: In art, Michael is represented as an angelic warrior fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield, standing over the dragon, which he sometimes pierces with a lance.

claims.quote: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed

statement.id: Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal.
statement.en: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed.

claims.quote: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general"

statement.id: Liturgi Yunani menyebutnya Archistrategos, "panglima tertinggi" (highest general).
statement.en: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general".

claims.quote: In Normandy St. Michael is the patron of mariners in his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

statement.id: Di Normandia, Michael adalah pelindung para pelaut di tempat sucinya yang terkenal di Mont-Saint-Michel, Keuskupan Coutances.
statement.en: In Normandy, Michael is the patron of mariners at his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

claims.quote: Well known is the apparition of St. Michael (a. 494 or 530-40), as related in the Roman Breviary, 8 May, at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano

statement.id: Terkenal kisah penampakan Michael (tahun 494 atau 530-40) di tempat sucinya yang termasyhur di Monte Gargano, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam Brevir Romawi (Roman Breviary).
statement.en: Well known is the apparition of Michael (a. 494 or 530-40) at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano, as related in the Roman Breviary.

claims.quote: but to St. Michael they gave the care of their sick. At the place where he was first venerated, in Phrygia, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his interposition in military affairs.

statement.id: Pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Michael; di Frigia (Phrygia), tempat ia pertama dihormati, kemasyhurannya sebagai penyembuh malaikat mengalahkan perannya dalam urusan militer.
statement.en: Early Christians gave Michael the care of their sick; in Phrygia, where he was first venerated, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his role in military affairs.

claims.quote: St. Basil (Hom. de angelis) and other Greek Fathers, also Salmeron, Bellarmine, etc., place St. Michael over all the angels

statement.id: St. Basil, para Bapa Gereja Yunani lain, Salmeron, dan Bellarmine menempatkan Michael di atas semua malaikat.
statement.en: St. Basil and other Greek Fathers, as well as Salmeron and Bellarmine, place Michael over all the angels.

claims.quote: Michael is specially designated in early Jewish writings and very frequently in the Book of Enoch as "the prince of Israel"

statement.id: Tulisan Yahudi awal, dan sangat sering Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch), menyebut Michael "the prince of Israel" (pemimpin Israel).
statement.en: Early Jewish writings, and very frequently the Book of Enoch, designate Michael as "the prince of Israel".

claims.quote: "the advocate of the Jews." It is for this reason that he is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy

statement.id: Sebagai "the advocate of the Jews" (pembela orang Yahudi), Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat kesabaran dan belas kasihan.
statement.en: As "the advocate of the Jews", Michael is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy.

claims.quote: particularly with Samael, Israel's accuser. His enmity with Samael dates from the time when the latter was thrown down from heaven.

statement.id: Michael bermusuhan terutama dengan Samael, penuduh Israel; permusuhan itu bermula ketika Samael dicampakkan dari surga.
statement.en: Michael is opposed particularly to Samael, Israel's accuser; his enmity with Samael dates from when Samael was thrown down from heaven.

claims.quote: Michael is called in Arabic literature "Mika'il" or (in the Koran) "Mikal." He is one of the four archangels

statement.en: In Arabic literature Michael is called "Mika'il" or, in the Koran, "Mikal", and he is one of the four archangels.

claims.quote: Michael should be represented in the Haggadah as the most prominent of the archangels

statement.en: In the Haggadah, Michael is represented as the most prominent of the archangels.

statement.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, the idea that Michael is the Charon of individual souls, common among Christians, is not found in Jewish sources.

claims.quote: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

statement.en: According to Revelation, there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought.

statement.en: The great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was cast out into the earth.

statement.en: In the Book of Daniel, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help the messenger who remained there with the kings of Persia.

statement.en: At that time Michael shall stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of thy people.

claims.quote: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

short_description.id: Hathor adalah dewi Mesir kuno yang berkaitan dengan cinta dan sukacita, sering digambarkan sebagai sapi atau perempuan berciri sapi.
short_description.en: Hathor is an ancient Egyptian goddess of love and joy, often shown as a cow or a woman with bovine features.

long_description.id: Hathor berkaitan dengan cinta, perayaan, dan kesehatan perempuan. Ia kerap digambarkan sebagai sapi atau perempuan berciri sapi. Nama Hathor diterangkan sebagai 'Wilayah Horus' atau 'Kuil Horus'. Dalam pemujaannya, sistrum dikaitkan dengan pengusiran kejahatan.
long_description.en: Hathor is associated with love, celebration, and women's health. She is often shown as a cow or a woman with bovine features. Her name is explained as 'Domain of Horus' or 'Temple of Horus'. In her cult, the sistrum is associated with driving away evil.

long_description.id: Satu kisah Mesir menceritakan Hathor mengamuk dalam wujud Sekhmet. Setelah ia mabuk dan tertidur, ia bangun sebagai Hathor yang baik hati. Pusat pemujaannya berada di Dendera, tetapi penghormatannya tersebar di Mesir.
long_description.en: An Egyptian story describes Hathor raging as Sekhmet. After becoming drunk and falling asleep, she wakes as benevolent Hathor. Her cult center was Dendera, while her worship spread across Egypt.

long_description.id: Plak logam dari Deir el-Bahari menampilkan sapi bercakram matahari di antara tanduknya, bentuk umum Hathor. Sumber museum lain menyebutnya pelindung dan ibu susuan Horus bayi serta mengaitkannya dengan ritual papirus, sistrum, dan menat. Pada masa awal, Hathor juga dipuja sebagai sapi, terkadang dengan bintang di atasnya; karya lain memperlihatkannya muncul dari rumpun papirus.
long_description.en: A metal plaque from Deir el-Bahari shows a cow with a sun disk between its horns, a common Hathor form. Another museum source names her protector and nurse of infant Horus and connects her to papyrus ritual, sistrum, and menat. Early worship also pictured Hathor as a cow, sometimes with stars above her; another work shows her emerging from a papyrus thicket.

short_description.id: Set adalah dewa Egypt kuno yang terkait dengan badai, kekacauan, dan gurun; ia juga tampil sebagai pelindung Ra dari Apophis.
short_description.en: Set is an ancient Egyptian god associated with storms, chaos, and the desert who also protects Ra from Apophis.

long_description.id: Set, juga disebut Seth atau Suetekh, adalah anak Geb dan Nut serta saudara Osiris dan suami Nephthys. Gurun, wilayah asing, badai, dan kekacauan terkait dengannya; gelarnya mencakup Lord of the Desert.
long_description.en: Set, also called Seth or Suetekh, is a child of Geb and Nut and brother of Osiris and husband of Nephthys. Deserts, foreign lands, storms, and chaos are associated with him, and one title calls him Lord of the Desert.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Osiris, kecemburuan Set memicunya membuat peti yang pas untuk Osiris dan melemparkannya ke Nile. Horus lalu bersaing dengannya melalui serangkaian persidangan dan pertarungan; Horus akhirnya dinyatakan menang. Kisah pembunuhan Osiris menjadi sangat menonjol pada New Kingdom.
long_description.en: In the Osiris story, Set's jealousy leads him to make a casket fitted for Osiris and cast it into the Nile. Horus then contests him through trials and battles and is ultimately declared the winner. The murder of Osiris became especially prominent in the New Kingdom.

long_description.id: Set juga memiliki peran melindungi perjalanan dewa matahari Ra dari ular Apophis pada malam hari. Ia dipuja di Ombos sejak masa dinasti awal, sementara Horus dan Set bersama-sama melambangkan kekuasaan raja. Sosok hewan khas yang mewakilinya belum teridentifikasi pasti sebagai spesies nyata.
long_description.en: Set also protects the sun god Ra against the serpent Apophis at night. He was worshipped at Ombos from early dynastic times, while Horus and Set together symbolized royal power. The distinctive Set animal has not been securely identified with any real species.

short_description.en: Lilith is a demonic figure in Jewish tradition. A medieval story presents her as Adam's first wife, while the interpretation of the word lilit in Isaiah remains debated.

long_description.id: Sumber Jewish menggambarkan Lilith sebagai demon malam. Kata lilit muncul dalam Isaiah 34:14, tetapi penafsirannya dapat menunjuk pada burung malam atau demon; karena itu, kemunculan kata tersebut tidak dapat begitu saja disamakan dengan seluruh legenda Lilith yang berkembang kemudian. Sumber ensiklopedis lama juga membandingkannya dengan nama-nama demon Assyrian.
long_description.en: Jewish sources describe Lilith as a night demon. The word lilit appears in Isaiah 34:14, but its interpretation may refer to a night bird or demon; the word should therefore not be equated with the full later Lilith legend. An older encyclopedia also compares her with names of Assyrian demons.

long_description.id: Dalam Alphabet of Ben Sira yang berasal dari sekitar abad kesembilan atau kesepuluh, Lilith digambarkan diciptakan bagi Adam, lalu bertengkar dan melarikan diri setelah mengucapkan nama ilahi. Cerita itu mengaitkannya dengan ancaman bagi bayi dan penggunaan nama malaikat pada jimat untuk melindungi mereka. Keterangan ini berasal dari kisah tersebut.
long_description.en: In the ninth or tenth century Alphabet of Ben Sira, Lilith is made for Adam, quarrels with him, and flees after speaking the divine name. The tale connects her with danger to infants and with angels' names on amulets to protect children. These details come from that work.

long_description.id: Teks Talmud juga mengaitkan Lilith dengan kegelapan dan seksualitas. Zohar kemudian menempatkannya sebagai istri Adam dan Satan dalam penafsiran mistik. Pada masa modern, sejumlah pembaca menafsirkan ulang Lilith sebagai lambang kebebasan perempuan.
long_description.en: Talmudic material also connects Lilith with darkness and sexuality. The Zohar later portrays her as wife of Adam and Satan in a mystical reading. In modern reinterpretations, some readers have made Lilith a symbol of women's freedom.

short_description.id: Amaterasu adalah dewi matahari utama dalam Shinto, penguasa Takama no Hara, dan leluhur ilahi keluarga kekaisaran Japan.
short_description.en: Amaterasu is the chief sun goddess of Shinto, ruler of Takama no Hara, and divine ancestor of Japan's imperial family.

long_description.id: Amaterasu Omikami berarti 'dewa agung yang menerangi langit'. Kisah kelahirannya menempatkannya muncul dari mata kiri Izanagi, dan ia adalah kakak Susanoo sang dewa badai. Ia memerintah dataran langit Takama no Hara.
long_description.en: Amaterasu Omikami means 'great divinity illuminating heaven'. In one birth story she emerges from Izanagi's left eye, and she is the elder sister of the storm god Susanoo. She rules the celestial plain Takama no Hara.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita gua, tindakan Susanoo membuat Amaterasu bersembunyi sehingga dunia gelap. Para dewa menyiapkan cermin dan perhiasan pada pohon sakaki; Uzume menari hingga mereka tertawa. Tajikarao lalu menarik Amaterasu keluar dan terang kembali.
long_description.en: In the cave story, Susanoo's actions cause Amaterasu to hide, leaving the world dark. The gods set a mirror and jewels on a sakaki tree; Uzume dances and they laugh. Tajikarao then pulls Amaterasu out and light returns.

long_description.id: Amaterasu memberi Ninigi tiga benda yang kemudian menjadi lambang kekaisaran Japan. Situs resmi Ise Jingu menyebut Amaterasu sebagai kami leluhur keluarga kekaisaran dan menyatakan cermin suci ditempatkan di Naiku. Lebih dari 1.500 ritual diadakan setiap tahun di kompleks itu.
long_description.en: Amaterasu gives Ninigi three objects that become Japan's imperial regalia. The Ise Jingu shrine describes Amaterasu as the imperial family's ancestral kami and says her sacred mirror is housed at Naiku. More than 1,500 rituals take place at the shrine complex each year.

short_description.id: Bastet adalah dewi Egypt kuno yang terkait dengan kucing, rumah, kesuburan, dan perlindungan; citranya berubah dari singa betina menjadi kucing.
short_description.en: Bastet is an ancient Egyptian goddess associated with cats, the home, fertility, and protection, depicted first as a lioness and later as a cat.

long_description.id: Bastet melindungi rumah dari roh jahat dan penyakit, terutama yang mengancam perempuan serta anak-anak. Ia juga dihubungkan dengan Ra sebagai putri dan Eye of Ra. Makna namanya sendiri tidak disepakati secara pasti oleh para peneliti.
long_description.en: Bastet protects households from evil spirits and disease, especially threats to women and children. She is also linked with Ra as his daughter and with his Eye. The meaning of her name is not firmly agreed upon.

long_description.id: Gambaran awalnya menampilkan kepala singa betina dan menghubungkannya dengan Sekhmet serta dewi singa lain. Dalam periode kemudian ia lebih sering berwujud kucing atau perempuan berkepala kucing, kadang membawa sistrum atau bersama anak kucing. Perubahan itu tidak menghapus peran perlindungannya.
long_description.en: Early images show a lioness head and link her to Sekhmet and other lioness goddesses. Later she is more often a cat or cat-headed woman, sometimes with a sistrum or kittens. The shift did not erase her protective role.

long_description.id: Pusat pemujaannya berada di Bubastis atau Per Bastet di Delta. Kementerian pariwisata Egypt menyebut kuilnya sebagai pusat pemujaan penting sejak Old Kingdom dan mencatat perluasan bangunannya ketika Per Bastet menjadi ibu kota pada 22nd Dynasty. Herodotus dilaporkan pernah mengunjungi kuil itu pada abad kelima BC.
long_description.en: Her cult centered on Bubastis or Per Bastet in the Delta. Egypt's antiquities ministry describes its temple as an important cult site from the Old Kingdom and records its enlargement when Per Bastet became the capital in the 22nd Dynasty. Herodotus is reported to have visited the temple in the fifth century BCE.

short_description.id: Elf adalah makhluk peri dari cerita rakyat European dan mitologi Norse; gambaran mereka berubah dari sosok ambigu dalam tradisi lama menjadi tokoh fantasi yang lebih seragam.
short_description.en: Elves are fairy beings of European folklore and Norse myth; their older ambiguous portrayal differs from more standardized modern fantasy versions.

long_description.id: Dalam sumber Norse, elf atau álfar disebut bersama dewa dalam puisi, tetapi kisah pribadi mereka jarang dicatat. Mereka dikaitkan dengan keterampilan, pembuatan benda berharga, dan sifat yang tidak selalu baik atau jahat. Batas antara elf, kurcaci, dan makhluk lain dalam sumber lama tidak selalu tegas.
long_description.en: In Norse sources, elves or álfar accompany gods in poetry, but individual stories about them are scarce. They are linked with skill, precious crafts, and moral ambiguity. Boundaries among elves, dwarves, and other beings were not always firm in older sources.

long_description.id: Snorri membedakan elf terang di Alfheim dari elf gelap yang terkait tanah, meski hubungannya dengan kurcaci diperdebatkan. Wayland atau Völund adalah tokoh elf pandai besi yang kisah balas dendamnya muncul dalam Poetic Edda. Teks pengobatan lama juga mengaitkan elf dengan penyakit, sehingga mereka tidak hanya digambarkan ramah.
long_description.en: Snorri distinguishes light elves in Alfheim from dark elves linked to the ground, though their relation to dwarves is debated. Wayland or Völund is an elven smith whose revenge story appears in the Poetic Edda. Older medical writings also associate elves with illness, so they were not always portrayed as friendly.

long_description.id: Sebuah wawancara menempatkan elf dan peri dalam sejarah budaya European serta menyoroti pengaruh sastra modern yang membentuk elf sebagai makhluk kuat. Ringkasan penelitian mencatat bahwa penulis gereja medieval pernah menggolongkan mereka sebagai demon, sedangkan telinga runcing khas fantasi modern tidak jelas berasal dari tradisi awal.
long_description.en: An interview places elves and fairies in European cultural history and describes modern literature's role in portraying elves as powerful. A research abstract notes that medieval church writers sometimes categorized them as demons, while pointed ears characteristic of modern fantasy are not securely an early trait.

short_description.id: Lucifer dalam tafsir Kristen adalah nama yang dikaitkan dengan Iblis atau malaikat jatuh; sebelumnya kata Latin itu menamai Venus sebagai bintang fajar.
short_description.en: In Christian interpretation, Lucifer names the Devil or a fallen angel; the Latin word originally named Venus as the morning star.

long_description.id: Nama Lucifer mula-mula menunjuk bintang fajar, Venus. Tradisi Romawi juga mempersonifikasikannya sebagai laki-laki berobor, tetapi ia biasanya tidak dianggap dewa dengan mitos tersendiri. Dalam puisi, Lucifer juga tampil sebagai pertanda fajar; nama itu kadang dipakai untuk Venus sebagai bintang senja.
long_description.en: Lucifer first referred to Venus as the morning star. Roman tradition sometimes personified it as a torch-bearing man, though it was not usually a deity with its own myths. Poetry also presents Lucifer as heralding dawn, and the name sometimes applies to Venus as an evening star.

long_description.id: Dalam kitab Yesaya, sebutan bintang dipakai secara puitis untuk raja Babilonia. Tafsir Kristen kemudian menghubungkannya dengan Setan sebelum kejatuhannya, sehingga arti astronomis dan teologisnya perlu dibaca sesuai konteks.
long_description.en: Isaiah used a star image poetically for the king of Babylon. Christian interpretation later connected it with Satan before his fall, so its astronomical and theological senses depend on context.

long_description.id: Pada Abad Pertengahan nama Lucifer menjadi umum untuk sosok itu. Kisah kejatuhannya kemudian memperoleh penggambaran sastra dalam Paradise Lost karya Milton.
long_description.en: The name Lucifer became common for that figure in the Middle Ages. The story of his fall later received literary treatment in Milton's Paradise Lost.

short_description.id: Thoth adalah dewa Mesir yang terkait dengan tulisan, kebijaksanaan, bulan, dan peran juru tulis.
short_description.en: Thoth is an Egyptian god linked to writing, wisdom, the moon, and scribes.

long_description.id: Nama Mesir Thoth ialah Djehuty, sedangkan Thoth merupakan bentuk Yunani. Dalam tradisi Mesir ia menaungi penulisan, pengukuran, dan perhitungan; kisah tertentu menghubungkannya dengan penciptaan kata tertulis.
long_description.en: Thoth is a Greek name for the Egyptian Djehuty. Egyptian tradition links him to writing, measurement and calculation, and some accounts attribute written words to him.

long_description.id: Ia lazim digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berkepala ibis atau sebagai babun. Artefak Metropolitan Museum juga menunjukkan wujud babun di belakang seorang juru tulis dan beberapa bentuk Thoth pada sebuah stela.
long_description.en: He is commonly shown as an ibis-headed man or a baboon. Metropolitan Museum objects likewise show a baboon behind a scribe and several forms of Thoth on a stela.

long_description.id: Thoth hadir dalam adegan penimbangan jiwa dan, sebagai A'an, terkait dengan pengadilan arwah bersama Osiris. Orang Yunani mengidentifikasinya dengan Hermes; Hermopolis menjadi pusat pemujaannya. Hubungan Yunani itu juga melahirkan nama Hermes Trimegistus. Nehemetawy disebut sebagai salah satu pasangannya.
long_description.en: Thoth appears in soul-weighing scenes and, as A'an, in the judgment of the dead with Osiris. Greeks identified him with Hermes, and Hermopolis was a cult centre. The Greek association also produced the name Hermes Trimegistus. Nehemetawy is named as one of his consorts.

short_description.id: Monster Loch Ness atau Nessie adalah kriptid dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia yang dikatakan menghuni Loch Ness; keberadaannya belum dibuktikan.
short_description.en: The Loch Ness Monster or Nessie is a Scottish folklore cryptid said to inhabit Loch Ness; its existence has not been established.

long_description.id: Nessie dilaporkan sebagai makhluk besar berleher panjang dengan tonjolan di permukaan air. Deskripsi itu berasal dari laporan dan bukti anekdotal, bukan spesimen yang terverifikasi.

long_description.id: Cerita tentang Columba menyebut binatang air di Sungai Ness, bukan danau. Legenda modern menguat pada 1933, ketika George Spicer dan istrinya melaporkan makhluk yang mereka anggap luar biasa. Foto Surgeon's Photograph dari 1934 kemudian terbukti tipuan. Dalam legenda yang berkaitan, Colmcille dikisahkan mengusir binatang air itu dengan tanda salib.
long_description.en: The story of Columba places a water beast in the River Ness, not the loch. The modern legend grew in 1933 after George Spicer and his wife reported an extraordinary creature. The 1934 Surgeon's Photograph was later discredited as a hoax. In a related legend, Colmcille drives away the water beast with the sign of the cross.

long_description.id: Penelitian DNA lingkungan dengan 250 sampel air tidak menemukan bukti makhluk serupa plesiosaurus dan mendapati banyak DNA belut. Belut mungkin menjelaskan sebagian laporan, sementara penampakan lain dapat berasal dari benda atau hewan biasa.
long_description.en: Environmental DNA research using 250 water samples found nothing close to a plesiosaur and found much eel DNA. Eels may explain some reports, while other sightings can result from ordinary objects or animals.

short_description.id: Valkyrie adalah kelompok perempuan ilahi dalam mitologi yang memilih pejuang gugur untuk dibawa ke Valhalla milik Odin.
short_description.en: Valkyries are divine women of Norse myth who select fallen warriors and bring them to Odin's Valhalla.

long_description.id: Valkyrie berarti pemilih yang gugur. Mereka digambarkan sebagai perempuan pejuang yang menunggang kuda, serigala, atau babi hutan dan bersenjatakan tombak. Dalam tugas Odin mereka menentukan nasib pejuang dan membawa yang terpilih ke Valhalla. Museum Denmark juga menyebut mereka makhluk ilahi perempuan.
long_description.en: Valkyrie means chooser of the slain. They are depicted as armed warrior women riding horses, wolves or boars. In Odin's service they decide warriors' fates and lead the chosen to Valhalla. A museum also calls them female divinities.

long_description.id: Menurut satu uraian, Freyja memilih separuh yang gugur untuk Fólkvangr dan Valkyrie memilih separuh lainnya bagi Odin. Mereka juga melayani pejuang terpilih di Valhalla, yang kelak bertempur di sisi Odin saat Ragnarök. Kisah mereka terdapat dalam Prose Edda dan Poetic Edda.
long_description.en: In one account Freyja selects half of the dead for Fólkvangr and Valkyries choose the rest for Odin. They serve the chosen warriors at Valhalla, where those warriors prepare to fight beside Odin at Ragnarök. Their stories appear in the Prose Edda and Poetic Edda.

long_description.id: Tradisi juga mengaitkan Valkyrie dengan gagak dan kisah gadis angsa. Jumlah mereka beragam menurut sumber. Brynhild adalah Valkyrie terkenal yang, setelah menentang Odin, dibuat fana dan ditidurkan dalam lingkaran api. Istilah sejenis juga dikenal di England kuno.
long_description.en: Tradition also links Valkyries with ravens and swan maidens. Their number varies across accounts. Brynhild is a famous Valkyrie made mortal and put to sleep within a ring of fire after defying Odin. A related name was known in England.

short_description.id: Bigfoot atau Sasquatch adalah kriptid menyerupai manusia berbulu yang konon hidup di hutan; keberadaannya belum terbukti.
short_description.en: Bigfoot or Sasquatch is a hairy humanoid cryptid purported to live in North American forests; its existence remains unverified.

long_description.id: Laporan tentang Bigfoot menggambarkan makhluk besar berbulu yang berjalan dengan dua kaki dan meninggalkan jejak besar di hutan wilayah Oregon serta pesisir barat. Nama Sasquatch merupakan bentuk serapan dari istilah Sasq’ets dalam bahasa Halq’emeylem. Cerita tentang sosok mirip manusia liar juga hidup dalam tradisi setempat.
long_description.en: Reports describe Bigfoot as a large hairy biped leaving huge tracks in the forests of Oregon and the North American west coast. Sasquatch anglicizes Sasq’ets from the Halq’emeylem language. Stories of wild humanlike beings also belong to regional traditions.

long_description.id: Tradisi masyarakat adat di Pacific Northwest memiliki kisah yang perlu dipahami dalam konteksnya sendiri. Kemunculan jejak pada 1958 membuat Bigfoot menjadi sensasi media modern; kemudian terungkap bahwa sebagian jejak di Bluff Creek dipasang oleh Ray Wallace. Film Patterson dan Gimlin dari 1967 tetap menjadi bahan perdebatan.
long_description.en: Indigenous traditions in the Pacific Northwest have their own context. Tracks in 1958 made Bigfoot a modern media sensation; tracks near Bluff Creek were later attributed to a Ray Wallace hoax. Patterson and Gimlin's 1967 film remains debated.

long_description.id: Banyak ilmuwan skeptis dan mengaitkan laporan dengan salah identifikasi hewan atau tipuan. Analisis FBI terhadap rambut yang diklaim sebagai milik Bigfoot menghasilkan identifikasi rambut rusa, bukan konfirmasi makhluk tersebut. Seorang penafsir melihat Bigfoot sebagai konsep budaya manusia liar.
long_description.en: Many scientists are skeptical and attribute reports to misidentified animals or hoaxes. FBI analysis of hair said to belong to Bigfoot identified deer hair, not confirmation of the creature. One commentator interprets Bigfoot as a cultural wild-man concept.

short_description.id: Sobek adalah dewa berkepala buaya yang terkait dengan air, kesuburan, dan perlindungan.
short_description.en: Sobek is a crocodile god linked to water, fertility, protection and the Nile.

long_description.id: Sobek digambarkan sebagai buaya atau manusia berkepala buaya. Ia menaungi air, rawa, kesuburan, dan juga perlindungan; sumber lain mengaitkannya dengan pengobatan. Sumber kuno menyebutnya putra Neith, sementara sebuah kisah menyatakan bahwa sungai berasal dari keringatnya.
long_description.en: Sobek appears as a crocodile or crocodile-headed man. He governs water, marshes, fertility and protection and is also linked to medicine. The Pyramid Texts name him son of Neith, while one account derives the Nile from his sweat.

long_description.id: Pemujaannya kuat di Fayum dan wilayah lain. Para imam memelihara buaya hidup di kuil dan memumikan mereka setelah mati. Namun, sikap terhadap buaya bervariasi menurut tempat: ada yang menganggapnya perwujudan Sobek, ada pula yang memburu dan membunuhnya.
long_description.en: His cult was prominent in the Fayum and Upper Egypt. Priests kept live crocodiles in temples and mummified them after death. Attitudes to crocodiles varied by place: some treated them as Sobek's embodiment, while others hunted and killed them.

long_description.id: Sebuah museum mencatat patung buaya di atas tempat suci sebagai lambang Sobek. Kaitan dengan banjir sungai dan kesuburan kemudian terhubung dengan kekuasaan raja serta dewa Re. Sumber lain juga menautkannya dengan kematian mendadak akibat buaya.
long_description.en: A museum record identifies a crocodile on a shrine as Sobek. His connection to Nile floods and fertility later linked him to royal power and Re. Another source also associates the crocodile god with sudden death.

long_description.id: Troll mencakup makhluk besar maupun kecil dalam cerita rakyat Nordic. Mereka kerap ditempatkan di pegunungan, gua, hutan, atau tempat terpencil; beberapa kisah menggambarkan mereka hidup sebagai keluarga kecil. Karena ragam itu, gambaran troll sebagai raksasa saja tidak mencakup seluruh tradisi.
long_description.en: Troll is a broad label for beings of different sizes in Nordic folklore. They inhabit mountains, caves, forests or remote places; some stories place them in small families. The image of a giant alone does not cover the whole tradition.

long_description.id: Dalam sebagian cerita, cahaya matahari mengubah troll menjadi batu. long_description.en: In some tales sunlight turns a troll to stone. Folklore also treats trolls as dangerous, while their appearance ranges from grotesque to humanlike. Older uses of the word include jötnar, mountain dwellers and ghosts, showing its variable meaning.

short_description.id: Marduk adalah dewa pelindung Babylon yang dalam kisah Enuma Elish menjadi raja para dewa setelah mengalahkan Tiamat.
short_description.en: Marduk is Babylon’s patron god who becomes king of the gods after defeating Tiamat in Enuma Elish.

long_description.id: Marduk menjadi dewa pelindung Babylon dan dikaitkan dengan keadilan, penyembuhan, serta sihir. Ia disebut putra Enki, pasangan Sarpanitu, dan ayah Nabu. Ikonografinya memakai sekop dan naga ular; nama Bel juga dipakai sebagai sebutannya.
long_description.en: Marduk is Babylon’s patron god, associated with justice, healing and magic. He is named Enki’s son, Sarpanitu’s spouse and Nabu’s father. A spade and serpent dragon belong to his iconography, and Bel is another name for him.

long_description.id: Dalam Enuma Elish, Marduk bersedia melawan Tiamat setelah para dewa berjanji menjadikannya raja. Ia mengalahkan Quingu dan Tiamat, lalu membentuk langit dari tubuh Tiamat. Kisah itu juga menghubungkannya dengan penciptaan manusia dan pengaturan dunia. Karya tersebut dipahami sebagai pengesahan keunggulan Marduk di Babylon.
long_description.en: In Enuma Elish, Marduk confronts Tiamat after the gods promise him kingship. He defeats Quingu and Tiamat and makes the heavens from her body. The story also links him to humanity’s creation and world order. Scholars read it as a theological legitimation of his supremacy in Babylon.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Marduk berpusat di kuil Esagila. Patungnya memiliki peran penting dalam pengesahan raja dan perayaan Akitu; ketiadaan patung itu dapat menghalangi perayaan. Hubungan simbolik dengan planet Jupiter muncul pada masa kemudian.
long_description.en: Marduk’s worship centers on the Esagila temple. His statue mattered to royal legitimization and the Akitu festival, which could not proceed when the statue was absent. Later tradition associated him with Jupiter.

claims.quote: although he was commonly referred to simply as Bel (Lord).

claims.quote: The Babylonian creation myth, Enuma Elish, tells the story of Marduk's rise to power.

statement.en: Enuma Elish tells Marduk’s rise to power.

claims.quote: Marduk defeats Quingu in single combat and then kills Tiamat by shooting her with an arrow that splits her in two

claims.quote: from her corpse, Marduk forms the heavens

statement.id: Marduk membentuk langit dari tubuh Tiamat.

claims.quote: In consultation with Enki, Marduk then created human beings from the remains of the defeated gods

statement.id: Marduk menciptakan manusia bersama Enki dalam kisah ini.
statement.en: Marduk creates humans with Enki in this account.

claims.quote: This reign was centered, not in the heavens, but in the temple – the Esagila – in Babylon.

claims.quote: the Akitu festival (New Year's celebration) could not be observed because the statue of Marduk had left the city.

claims.quote: the Babylonian creation story Enuma Elish is a theological legitimization of the rise of Marduk as the supreme god in Babylon

statement.en: Enuma Elish legitimizes Marduk’s supremacy in Babylon.

claims.quote: Ea and his wife Damkina then gave birth to the hero Marduk, the tallest and mightiest of the gods.

claims.quote: The young warrior god Marduk then volunteers his strength in return for a promise that, if victorious, he will become king of the gods.

short_description.id: Kartikeya adalah dewa perang Hindu yang umumnya disebut putra Shiva dan Parvati.
short_description.en: Kartikeya is a Hindu war god generally described as the son of Shiva and Parvati.

long_description.id: Kartikeya adalah dewa perang Hindu yang umumnya disebut putra Shiva dan Parvati. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Skanda, Subrahmanya, Shanmukha, dan Muruga.
long_description.en: Kartikeya is a Hindu war god generally described as the son of Shiva and Parvati. He is also known as Skanda, Subrahmanya, Shanmukha, and Muruga.

long_description.id: Ganesha disebut saudaranya. Kaumaram adalah aliran Hindu yang terutama memuja Kartikeya. Artikel mengaitkan Muruga dalam sastra Sangam Tamil dengan wilayah Kurinji. Ia lazim digambarkan sebagai pemuda dengan merak bernama Paravani. Ia membawa tombak vel yang dikaitkan dengan pemberian Parvati. Sebagian gambar menunjukkan satu kepala, sebagian lainnya enam. Ia memimpin pasukan deva melawan asura termasuk Tarakasura dan Surapadma. Nama Kartikeya berarti milik para Krittika, pengasuhnya dalam cerita kelahiran. Salah satu cerita menyebut Parvati menyatukan enam bayi menjadi Kartikeya berkepala enam. Versi Vana Parva Mahabharata menyebutnya putra Agni dan Svaha. Pemujaan Kartikeya juga terdapat di Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapura, dan Indonesia. Museum Bihar membahas patung Kartikeya batu pasir merah dari masa Gupta akhir dengan tombak dan merak. Mackenzie merangkum versi yang menghubungkan Kartikeya dengan Agni dan Gangga.
long_description.en: Ganesha is described as his brother. Kaumaram is a Hindu denomination that primarily venerates Kartikeya. The article connects Muruga in Tamil Sangam literature with the Kurinji region. He is commonly depicted as a young man with a peacock named Paravani. He carries the vel spear associated with Parvati's gift. Some images show one head, while others show six. He leads the devas' army against asuras including Tarakasura and Surapadma. Kartikeya means of the Krittikas, his nurses in the birth narrative. One account says Parvati merges six babies into six headed Kartikeya. The Vana Parva version of the Mahabharata describes him as the son of Agni and Svaha. Kartikeya worship also occurs in Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. The Bihar Museum discusses a red sandstone Kartikeya sculpture of the Later Gupta period with spear and peacock. Mackenzie summarises a version connecting Kartikeya with Agni and the Ganges.

long_description.id: Britannica 1911 menyebut Kartikeya sebagai dewa perang dalam mitologi Hindu dan mencatat berbagai legenda kelahirannya. Satu legenda menyebutnya tidak beribu dan dihasilkan oleh Siva sendiri, disusui enam bidadari Sungai Gangga, dan diberi enam wajah agar dapat menyusu dari masing-masing sekaligus. Cerita lain menyebut enam bayi lahir dari keenam bidadari itu, lalu Parvati, istri Siva, memeluk mereka begitu erat hingga menyatu tetapi tetap berenam wajah dan berdua belas lengan. Britannica juga mencatat bahwa ia menjadi penakluk para raksasa dan pemimpin pasukan para dewa, digambarkan menunggang merak, dan di India selatan dikenal sebagai Subramanya.
long_description.en: The 1911 Britannica calls Kartikeya the god of war in Hindu mythology and records several legends of his birth. One legend says he had no mother, was produced by Siva alone, was suckled by six nymphs of the Ganges, and was given six faces so that he could feed from each at once. Another story says six babes were born of the six nymphs and Parvati, wife of Siva, embraced them so closely that they became one while keeping six faces and twelve arms. Britannica also records that he became the victor of giants and leader of the armies of the gods, is shown riding a peacock, and is known in southern India as Subramanya.

long_description.id: Museum Bihar menulis bahwa menurut Shiva Purana Kartikeya dianggap putra sulung Shiva, sedangkan Wikipedia mencatat bahwa Ganesha Purana, Shiva Purana, dan Skanda Purana menyatakan Ganesha lebih tua. Museum itu juga menggambarkan arca Kartikeya yang duduk di atas merak dengan kalung berhias kuku harimau dan jimat. Dalam Ramayana Valmiki ia digambarkan sebagai anak Rudra dan Parvati dengan kelahiran yang dibantu Agni dan Ganga. Menurut Shiva Purana, asura Tarakasura memperoleh anugerah dari Brahma bahwa hanya putra Shiva yang dapat membunuhnya.
long_description.en: The Bihar Museum writes that according to the Shiva Purana Kartikeya is considered the eldest son of Shiva, whereas Wikipedia notes that several Shavite puranas, among them the Ganesha Purana, Shiva Purana, and Skanda Purana, hold Ganesha to be the elder. The museum also describes a Kartikeya sculpture seated on a peacock and wearing a necklace with a tiger's nail and an amulet. In Valmiki's Ramayana he is described as the child of Rudra and Parvati, with his birth aided by Agni and Ganga. According to the Shiva Purana, the asura Tarakasura received a boon from Brahma that only a son of Shiva could slay him.

long_description.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan Surapadma, Surapadma lari ke laut dan menjelma pohon mangga besar; Kartikeya membelahnya dengan vel, dan kedua belahannya menjadi merak dan ayam jantan yang kemudian menjadi wahana dan panjinya. Dalam kisah buah pengetahuan, ia mengelilingi dunia dengan merak, tetapi Ganesha mengelilingi orang tuanya dan memenangkan buah itu; Kartikeya yang merasa dicurangi meninggalkan Kailasha dan menetap di Bukit Palani sebagai pertapa. Teks Tamil kuno Tolkappiyam dari abad kedua SM menyebut Ceyon ("si merah") dan Murukan ("si pemuda") sebagai dewa daerah perbukitan. Thaipusam dirayakan untuk memperingati kemenangan Murugan atas para asura.
long_description.en: In the battle against Surapadma, Surapadma flees to the sea as a large mango tree; Kartikeya splits it with the vel, and the halves become a peacock and a rooster that later serve as his mount and his pennant. In the story of the fruit of knowledge he circles the world on his peacock, but Ganesha circles his parents and wins the fruit; Kartikeya, feeling cheated, leaves Kailasha and settles in the Palani Hills as a hermit. The Tolkappiyam, a Tamil text from the second century BCE, names Ceyon ("the red one") and Murukan ("the youth") in connection with the god of the hills. Thaipusam is celebrated to commemorate Murugan's victory over the asuras.

claims.quote: According to Shiva Purana, asura Tarakasura performed tapas to propitiate the creator god Brahma. Brahma granted him two boons: one, that none shall be his equal in all of the three worlds, and two, that only a son of Shiva could slay him.

statement.id: Menurut Shiva Purana, asura Tarakasura bertapa kepada Brahma dan memperoleh dua anugerah: tak seorang pun setara dengannya di tiga dunia, dan hanya putra Shiva yang dapat membunuhnya.
statement.en: According to the Shiva Purana, the asura Tarakasura performed tapas to Brahma and received two boons: none would be his equal in the three worlds, and only a son of Shiva could slay him.

claims.quote: When Kartikeya threw his vel, Surapadma escaped to the sea and took the form of a large mango tree, which spread across the three worlds. Kartikeya used his vel to split the tree in half, with each half transforming into a peacock and a rooster, respectively. After Surapadma was killed, Kartikeya took the peacock as his vahana and the rooster as his pennant.
claims.locator: Section on the war against the asuras

statement.id: Ketika Kartikeya melempar vel, Surapadma lari ke laut dan menjelma pohon mangga besar; Kartikeya membelahnya dengan vel, dan kedua belahannya menjadi merak dan ayam jantan. Setelah Surapadma tewas, ia menjadikan merak sebagai wahana dan ayam jantan sebagai panjinya.
statement.en: When Kartikeya threw his vel, Surapadma escaped to the sea as a large mango tree; Kartikeya split it with the vel and the halves became a peacock and a rooster. After Surapadma was killed, he took the peacock as his vahana and the rooster as his pennant.

claims.quote: Accepting the challenge, Kartikeya started his journey around the globe atop his peacock mount. However, Ganesha surmised that the world was no more than his parents Shiva and Shakti combined, circumambulated them, and won the fruit.
claims.locator: Section on the fruit of knowledge

statement.id: Dalam kisah buah pengetahuan, Kartikeya mengelilingi dunia dengan merak, tetapi Ganesha, yang menganggap dunia tidak lebih dari orang tuanya Shiva dan Shakti, mengelilingi mereka dan memenangkan buah itu.
statement.en: In the story of the fruit of knowledge, Kartikeya sets off around the globe on his peacock, but Ganesha, reasoning that the world is no more than his parents Shiva and Shakti combined, circles them and wins the fruit.

claims.quote: When Kartikeya returned, he was furious to learn that his efforts had been in vain, and felt cheated. He discarded all his material belongings and left Kailasha to take up abode in the Palani Hills as a hermit.
claims.locator: Section on the fruit of knowledge

statement.id: Ketika Kartikeya kembali, ia murka karena jerih payahnya sia-sia dan merasa dicurangi; ia membuang semua harta bendanya, meninggalkan Kailasha, dan menetap di Bukit Palani sebagai pertapa.
statement.en: When Kartikeya returned he was furious that his efforts had been in vain and felt cheated; he discarded all his belongings, left Kailasha, and took up abode in the Palani Hills as a hermit.

short_description.id: Iblis adalah tokoh ajaran Islam yang dianggap pemimpin para setan.
short_description.en: Iblis is an Islamic religious figure regarded as leader of the devils.

long_description.id: Iblis adalah tokoh ajaran Islam yang dianggap pemimpin para setan. Al-Qur’an 18:50 menyebut Iblis berasal dari jin dan menolak perintah bersujud.
long_description.en: Iblis is an Islamic religious figure regarded as leader of the devils. Quran 18:50 identifies Iblis as one of the jinn who refuses the command to bow.

long_description.id: Ayat itu menyebut Iblis dan keturunannya sebagai musuh manusia. Dalam Al-Qur’an 7:12, Iblis menyatakan dirinya lebih baik karena dibuat dari api, sedangkan Adam dari tanah liat. Hamid Algar mengaitkan kemungkinan asal kata Eblis dengan diabolos Yunani. Sebagian penafsir menghubungkan nama itu dengan ublisa dalam bahasa Arab. Algar menegaskan bahwa ayat 18:50 menyebut Eblis berasal dari jin. Banyak penulis Sufi yang dibahas menilai egoisme sebagai sumber kejatuhan Iblis. Penafsiran Sufi juga menyebut iri sebagai keburukan Iblis. Dalam uraian Sufi tersebut, Iblis menyesatkan manusia dengan menularkan sifat buruknya. Uraian itu menyebut Iblis dapat membujuk perbuatan baik untuk tujuan buruk. Bagi penulis Sufi yang dibahas, Eblis sebagai penggoda memiliki keberadaan di luar manusia. Sebagian ungkapan Sufi juga memperlakukan Eblis sebagai kecenderungan berdosa di dalam manusia. Algar mengutip al-Ghazali yang menyebut Iblis mengambil bentuk anjing, babi, dan katak. Algar menyebut Attar membuka kemungkinan pemulihan Iblis pada akhirnya.
long_description.en: The verse describes Iblis and his offspring as enemies of humanity. In Quran 7:12, Iblis claims superiority because he is created from fire and Adam from clay. Hamid Algar traces a possible origin of Eblis to Greek diabolos. Some interpreters connect the name with Arabic ublisa. Algar emphasizes that verse 18:50 identifies Eblis as being from the jinn. Many of the Sufi writers discussed regard egoism as the cause of Iblis’s downfall. Sufi interpretation also identifies envy as a vice of Eblis. In that Sufi account, Eblis misguides people by promoting his own vices. That account describes Eblis persuading people to perform good acts for malicious ends. For the Sufis discussed, Eblis as tempter has an existence external to humanity. Some Sufi expressions also treat Eblis as sinful inclinations internal to humanity. Algar cites al-Ghazali describing Eblis taking the forms of dogs, pigs, and frogs. Algar reports Attar suggesting Eblis may ultimately be rehabilitated.

short_description.id: Ravana adalah raja rakshasa Lanka yang lazim digambarkan berkepala sepuluh.
short_description.en: Ravana is the rakshasa king of Lanka traditionally depicted with ten heads.

long_description.id: Ravana adalah raja rakshasa Lanka yang lazim digambarkan berkepala sepuluh. Ia disebut putra Vishrava dan Kaikasi.
long_description.en: Ravana is the rakshasa king of Lanka traditionally depicted with ten heads. He is described as the son of Vishrava and Kaikasi.

long_description.id: Ia menculik Sita dan menahannya di Ashoka Vatika. Rama melawannya dengan dukungan Sugriva dan pasukan vanara lalu membunuhnya. Kekalahannya diperingati dengan pembakaran patung Ravana pada Dussehra. Ravana dipandang sebagai pemuja Shiva. Ia juga hadir dalam Lankavatara Sutra, Jataka Buddha, dan Ramayana Jain. Nama Ravana diterangkan berarti mengaum. Gelar Dashanana berarti yang berkepala sepuluh. Nama lainnya mencakup Lankapati dan Lankeshwara. Brahma memberinya anugerah kebal terhadap ciptaannya kecuali manusia dalam cerita. Anugerah Brahma juga mencakup senjata, kereta, dan kemampuan berganti wujud. Mandodari, putri Maya, disebut sebagai ratu utamanya. Mackenzie menggambarkan Rama sebagai pembunuh Ravana yang menindas manusia dalam Ramayana. Adegan koleksi Museum Carlos menggambarkan Ravana membawa Sita dari pertapaannya di hutan.
long_description.en: He abducts Sita and holds her in Ashoka Vatika. Rama fights him with Sugriva and the vanara army's support and kills him. His defeat is commemorated by burning Ravana effigies at Dussehra. Ravana is regarded as a devotee of Shiva. He also appears in the Lankavatara Sutra, Buddhist Jatakas, and Jain Ramayanas. The name Ravana is explained as meaning roaring. The epithet Dashanana means the one with ten heads. His other names include Lankapati and Lankeshwara. Brahma grants him immunity against his creations except humans in the story. Brahma's gifts also include weapons, a chariot, and shapeshifting. Mandodari, Maya's daughter, is described as his chief queen. Mackenzie describes Rama as the slayer of Ravana who oppresses humans in the Ramayana. The Carlos Museum collection scene depicts Ravana carrying Sita from her forest hermitage.

short_description.id: Loong adalah naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok, lazim digambarkan menyerupai ular dengan empat kaki.
short_description.en: Loong belongs to Chinese mythology and commonly has a serpentine shape with four legs.

long_description.id: Loong adalah naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok, lazim digambarkan menyerupai ular dengan empat kaki. Naga menjadi lambang kekuasaan kaisar dalam sejarah Tiongkok.
long_description.en: Loong belongs to Chinese mythology and commonly has a serpentine shape with four legs. The dragon served as an emblem of imperial authority in Chinese history.

long_description.id: Bentuk naga melingkar juga ditemukan pada amulet giok zaman Shang. Sebagian benda yang dahulu disebut tulang naga ternyata fosil mamalia. Wang Fu mencatat tradisi sembilan kemiripan anatomi naga dengan hewan lain. Doré mencatat varian anatomi dengan tanduk rusa dan kepala buaya. Naga dalam seni sering mengejar atau memperebutkan mutiara menyala. Kepercayaan populer menghubungkan naga dengan sungai, laut, dan pengaturan hujan. Saat kekeringan atau banjir, masyarakat melakukan ritual untuk memohon bantuan raja naga setempat. Sebuah legenda mengisahkan Kaisar Kuning naik ke langit setelah menjadi naga. Museum Norton menjelaskan naga sebagai penguasa langit yang dimohon mendatangkan hujan dalam ritual. Pada jubah istana, naga merujuk pada mandat kaisar untuk memerintah dari Takhta Naga. Museum V&A menafsirkan mutiara menyala dalam motif naga sebagai kebijaksanaan, pencerahan, dan hakikat spiritual. Pola naga pada keramik ekspor Tiongkok mengilhami keramik cetak biru-putih Inggris abad kesembilan belas. V&A mencatat bahwa pola piring Inggris mengikuti porselen biru-putih yang diekspor dari Tiongkok pada abad ketujuh belas dan kedelapan belas.
long_description.en: Coiled dragon forms occur on jade amulets from the Shang period. Scientific examination identifies many objects called dragon bones as mammal fossils. Wang Fu recorded a tradition of nine animal resemblances in dragon anatomy. Doré records an anatomical variant with deer antlers and a crocodile head. Art often shows dragons pursuing or contesting a flaming pearl. Popular belief connects dragons with rivers, seas, and the distribution of rain. During drought or flooding, villagers offered sacrifices and religious rites to appease local dragon kings and seek rain. One legend describes the Yellow Emperor ascending to heaven after becoming a dragon. The Norton Museum describes dragons as heavenly rulers petitioned for rain through ritual. On court robes, dragon imagery refers to the emperor’s mandate to rule from the Dragon Throne. The V&A interprets the flaming pearl in dragon imagery as wisdom, enlightenment, and spiritual essence. Dragon patterns on Chinese export ceramics inspired British printed blue-and-white wares in the nineteenth century. The V&A notes that the British plate pattern follows blue-and-white porcelain exported from China in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

claims.quote: Historically, the Chinese dragon was associated with the emperor of China and used as a symbol to represent imperial power. short_description.id: Khonsu adalah dewa bulan Mesir kuno.
short_description.en: Khonsu is an ancient Egyptian moon god.

long_description.id: Khonsu adalah dewa bulan Mesir kuno. Namanya berarti pengelana, dihubungkan dengan perjalanan bulan. Ia membentuk triad Thebes bersama ibu Mut dan ayah Amun.
long_description.en: Khonsu is an ancient Egyptian moon god. His name means traveller and is connected with the moon’s journey. He forms the Theban triad with his mother Mut and father Amun.

long_description.id: Seni sering menggambarkannya sebagai mumi dengan rambut samping anak-anak. Ia juga dapat berkepala elang dengan cakram dan sabit bulan. Ia disebut dalam Teks Piramida dan Teks Peti Mati. Sebuah kisah Karnak menjadikannya ular besar yang membuahi telur kosmis. Stela Bentresh mengisahkan penyembuhan putri Bekhten setelah gambar Khonsu tiba.
long_description.en: Art often depicts him as a mummy with a child’s sidelock. He may also be falcon-headed with the lunar disk and crescent. He is mentioned in the Pyramid Texts and Coffin Texts. A Karnak account makes him the great serpent fertilizing the cosmic egg. The Bentresh stela recounts healing a princess of Bekhten when Khonsu’s image arrives.

long_description.id: Pusat kultusnya mencakup Memphis, Hibis, dan Edfu. Ia dipanggil untuk melindungi dari hewan liar dan membantu penyembuhan. Pada Kerajaan Baru ia disebut sangat populer dan terbesar sesudah Amun. Dalam legenda terjemahan Budge, Khensu Nefer-Hetep memberikan daya pelindungnya kepada Khensu Pa-ari-sekher-em-Uast dalam ukuran empat kali lipat. Raja mengirim gambar Khonsu dalam kapal besar dengan lima kapal pendamping. Perjalanan ke Bekhten berlangsung satu tahun lima bulan dalam legenda tersebut. Pangeran bermimpi Khonsu meninggalkan kuil sebagai elang emas.
long_description.en: His cult locations include Memphis, Hibis and Edfu. He is invoked for protection from wild animals and for healing. In the New Kingdom he is described as highly popular and greatest after Amun. In Budge’s translated legend, Khensu Nefer-Hetep transfers protective power to Khensu Pa-ari-sekher-em-Uast in a fourfold measure. The king sends Khonsu’s image in a great boat with five accompanying boats. The journey to Bekhten lasts one year and five months in that legend. The prince dreams of Khonsu leaving the shrine as a golden hawk.

short_description.id: Will-o'-the-wisp adalah fenomena cahaya hantu di malam hari yang dalam cerita rakyat dikaitkan dengan arwah atau peri penyesat musafir di rawa-rawa.
short_description.en: The will-o'-the-wisp is an atmospheric ghost light in folklore attributed to spirits or fairies that mislead travelers in marshes.

long_description.id: Will-o'-the-wisp, yang juga dikenal sebagai ignis fatuus, adalah penampakan cahaya hantu di malam hari, terutama di atas rawa atau lahan basah. Cerita rakyat sering mengaitkannya dengan hantu, peri, atau roh alam yang menampakkan atau menyembunyikan arah jalan. Sosok ini digambarkan menari atau melayang hingga kemudian memudar saat didekati.
long_description.en: The will-o'-the-wisp, also called ignis fatuus, is an atmospheric ghost light seen at night, particularly over bogs or marshes. Folklore associates it with ghosts, fairies, or elemental spirits that reveal or conceal paths. It is depicted as dancing or flowing until fading when approached.

long_description.id: Secara etimologi, istilah ini merujuk pada lentera jerami yang dibawa oleh sosok bernama Will, serupa dengan sebutan jack-o'-lantern. Cerita rakyat mencatat nama-nama padanan seperti feu follet, Irrlicht, sebutan hinkypunk, serta Ellylldan.
long_description.en: Etymologically, the term stems from a straw torch associated with Will, akin to jack-o'-lantern. Folklore records corresponding names such as feu follet, Irrlicht, hinkypunk, and Ellylldan.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Skotlandia, fenomena ini sering digambarkan sebagai roh jahil atau hantu yang memikat musafir ke tempat berbahaya hingga menemui ajal, meski beberapa kisah mengaitkannya dengan petunjuk menuju harta terpendam. Beberapa keyakinan menyebut roh-roh ini adalah jiwa yang tidak diterima di Surga maupun Neraka sehingga terpaksa mengembara selamanya.
long_description.en: In Scottish traditions, these lights are often depicted as mischievous spirits or ghosts luring travelers off safe paths to their doom, though rare tales associate them with guiding to vast treasure. Some believe they represent souls rejected by both Heaven and Hell, doomed to wander.

claims.quote: In folklore, a will-o'-the-wisp, or will-o'-wisp (Latin: ignis fatuus, "foolish flame"), is an atmospheric ghost light seen by travellers at night, especially over bogs, swamps, or marshes.

statement.id: Will-o'-the-wisp atau ignis fatuus adalah cahaya hantu atmosfer yang dilihat musafir di malam hari di atas rawa atau lahan basah.
statement.en: A will-o'-the-wisp or ignis fatuus is an atmospheric ghost light seen by travellers at night, especially over bogs, swamps, or marshes.

claims.quote: In folklore, will-o'-the-wisps are typically attributed as ghosts, fairies or elemental spirits meant to reveal (or conceal) a path or direction.

statement.id: Will-o'-the-wisp biasanya dianggap sebagai hantu, peri, atau roh alam penunjuk atau penyembunyi jalan.
statement.en: Will-o'-the-wisps are typically attributed as ghosts, fairies or elemental spirits meant to reveal or conceal a path or direction.

claims.quote: These wisps are portrayed as dancing or flowing in a static form, until noticed or followed, in which case they visually fade or disappear.

statement.id: Cahaya ini digambarkan menari atau melayang statis hingga memudar atau lenyap saat diikuti.
statement.en: These wisps are portrayed as dancing or flowing in a static form, until noticed or followed, in which case they visually fade or disappear.

claims.quote: The term will-o'-the-wisp comes from wisp, a bundle of sticks or paper sometimes used as a torch and the name 'Will', thus meaning 'Will of the torch'.

statement.id: Istilah will-o'-the-wisp berasal dari kata wisp yang berarti ikatan kayu atau kertas untuk obor, dan nama Will.
statement.en: The term will-o'-the-wisp comes from wisp, a bundle of sticks or paper used as a torch, and the name Will.

claims.quote: The term jack-o'-lantern ('Jack of the lantern') originally referred to a will-o'-the-wisp.

statement.id: Istilah jack-o'-lantern awalnya merujuk pada will-o'-the-wisp.
statement.en: The term jack-o'-lantern originally referred to a will-o'-the-wisp.

claims.quote: Equivalents of the will-o'-the-wisps appear in European folklore by various names, e.g., ignis fatuus in Latin, feu follet in French, Irrlicht or Irrwisch in Germany, dwaallicht in The Netherlands and fuoco fatuo in Italy.

statement.id: Padanan will-o'-the-wisp muncul dalam cerita rakyat Eropa dengan berbagai nama, seperti ignis fatuus, feu follet, Irrlicht, dwaallicht, dan fuoco fatuo.
statement.en: Equivalents of will-o'-the-wisps appear in European folklore under names such as ignis fatuus, feu follet, Irrlicht, dwaallicht, and fuoco fatuo.

claims.quote: The phenomenon is known in the United Kingdom by a variety of names, including jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, and hinkypunk, and is said to mislead and/or guide travellers by resembling a flickering lamp or lantern.

statement.id: Di Britania Raya fenomena ini dikenal dengan berbagai nama termasuk jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, dan hinkypunk.
statement.en: The phenomenon is known in the United Kingdom by various names including jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, and hinkypunk.

claims.quote: In Scottish folklore, will-o’-the-wisps are variously depicted either as mischievous spirits (typically fairies), or even the ghosts of the dead, eager to lead travellers off their path and into their death.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia, will-o'-the-wisp digambarkan sebagai roh jahil atau hantu orang mati yang memikat pengelana keluar dari jalur menuju kematian.
statement.en: In Scottish folklore, will-o'-the-wisps are depicted as mischievous spirits or ghosts of the dead eager to lead travellers off path and to death.

claims.quote: The lights typically appear close to a bog, marsh, or swamp, places where straying off the beaten path can become dangerous – or even deadly.

statement.id: Cahaya tersebut biasanya muncul dekat rawa atau paya di mana tersesat dari jalan setapak bisa berbahaya atau mematikan.
statement.en: The lights typically appear close to a bog, marsh, or swamp where straying off path can become dangerous or deadly.

claims.quote: Few myths, however, show the will-o’-the-wisps leading those brave enough to follow the light in the middle of the dark night to a vast treasure, and riches beyond comprehension.

statement.id: Beberapa mitos menggambarkan will-o'-the-wisp memandu orang yang berani mengikuti cahaya menuju harta karun besar.
statement.en: Few myths show the will-o'-the-wisps leading those brave enough to follow the light in the dark night to vast treasure.

claims.quote: Some believe that the spirits behind the will-o’-the-wisps were souls who could enter neither Heaven nor Hell, and were thus forced to wander the earth forever.

statement.id: Sebagian percaya roh will-o'-the-wisp adalah jiwa yang tidak dapat masuk Surga maupun Neraka dan terpaksa mengembara selamanya.
statement.en: Some believe the spirits behind will-o'-the-wisps were souls unable to enter Heaven or Hell, forced to wander the earth forever.

claims.quote: Uniquely, in Sweden, the will-o’-the-wisp is a manifestation of an unbaptised soul, who tries to lead travellers into bodies of water, in hopes of being baptised.

statement.id: Di Swedia will-o'-the-wisp dipandang sebagai perwujudan jiwa yang belum dibaptis yang menuntun musafir ke perairan demi dibaptis.
statement.en: In Sweden, the will-o'-the-wisp is a manifestation of an unbaptised soul trying to lead travellers into water in hopes of baptism.

statement.en: Will-o'-the-Wisp is the most common English designation for fairy-beings characterized by fiery appearance and misleading wayfarers.

claims.quote: The term wisp refers to a twist of straw, used as a torch.

statement.id: Istilah wisp merujuk pada pilinan jerami yang digunakan sebagai obor.
