short_description.id: Kurcaci (dwarf) adalah makhluk gaib berwujud manusia dalam cerita rakyat Jermanik, yang umumnya tinggal di gunung atau batu dan dikenal sebagai perajin yang mahir.
short_description.en: A dwarf is a supernatural human-shaped being of Germanic folklore, commonly said to live in mountains or stones and known as a skilled craftsman.

long_description.id: Kurcaci (dwarf) adalah makhluk gaib berwujud manusia dalam cerita rakyat Jermanik (Germanic). Gambaran tentang mereka sangat beragam sepanjang sejarah; umumnya, tetapi tidak selalu, mereka tinggal di gunung atau batu dan merupakan perajin yang mahir. Dalam sumber sastra awal hanya lelaki yang secara tegas disebut kurcaci, meski mereka disebut punya saudari dan anak perempuan. Kata Inggris dwarf berasal dari dweorg (Old English), sekerabat dengan dvergr (Old Norse) dan twerg (Old High German).
long_description.en: A dwarf is a supernatural human-shaped being of Germanic folklore. Accounts of dwarfs vary widely through history; they are commonly, though not always, said to live in mountains or stones and to be skilled craftsmen. In early literary sources only males are explicitly called dwarfs, though they are said to have sisters and daughters. The English word dwarf comes from Old English dweorg, related to Old Norse dvergr and Old High German twerg.

long_description.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, para kurcaci mula-mula tumbuh seperti belatung dalam daging raksasa Ymer, lalu atas keputusan para dewa memperoleh akal dan rupa manusia, tetapi tetap harus tinggal di dalam tanah dan batu; Modsogner dan Durin adalah dua di antaranya. Syair Völuspá juga menyebut bahwa Motsognir adalah yang terkuat di antara para kurcaci, dan Durin berikutnya. Para sarjana menduga Svartálfar ("elf hitam") dalam Edda Prosa adalah makhluk yang sama dengan kurcaci, karena keduanya disebut tinggal di Svartálfheimr.
long_description.en: According to the Prose Edda, the dwarfs first quickened like maggots in the flesh of the giant Ymer, then by the gods' decision gained understanding and the likeness of men, yet still had to dwell in earth and rocks; Modsogner and Durin were two of them. The poem Völuspá likewise calls Motsognir the mightiest of the dwarfs, with Durin next. Scholars take the Svartálfar ("black elves") of the Prose Edda to be the same beings as dwarfs, since both are said to live in Svartálfheimr.

long_description.id: Dalam sumber Edda, kurcaci membuat harta ajaib bagi para dewa, seperti Mjölnir, rambut Sif, Draupnir, Gullinbursti, Skíðblaðnir, Gleipnir, dan Gungnir, serta Brísingamen bagi Freyja; mereka juga membuat mead puisi dari darah Kvasir. Dalam kesusastraan Jerman banyak kurcaci dapat menjadi tak kasatmata, biasanya dengan Tarnkappe (jubah tak kasatmata), dan bisa bersikap bermusuhan atau bersahabat terhadap manusia. Kurcaci Alberich dalam Nibelungenlied menjaga harta Nibelung dan sekuat dua belas lelaki.
long_description.en: The Eddic dwarfs are the makers of the gods' wonders, among them Gungnir, Gleipnir, Draupnir, Mjölnir, Gullinbursti, Skíðblaðnir and the golden hair of Sif, as well as Freyja's Brísingamen; they also brewed the mead of poetry from Kvasir's blood. In German literature many dwarfs can become invisible, usually with a Tarnkappe (cloak of invisibility), and may be hostile or friendly to humans. The dwarf Alberich in the Nibelungenlied guards the Nibelung treasure and has the strength of twelve men.

long_description.id: Dalam sumber Nordik awal kurcaci tidak disebut kecil, tetapi dalam saga legenda dan cerita rakyat kemudian mereka sering digambarkan pendek; sebagian dapat berubah wujud, seperti Andvari yang hidup sebagai ikan tombak. Dalam syair Alvissmol, kurcaci Alvis yang ingin menikahi putri Thor dipaksa menjawab banyak pertanyaan hingga fajar, lalu Thor berkata "hari telah menangkapmu, kurcaci" ketika matahari bersinar di aula. Menurut artikel id, kurcaci tinggal di gua di pegunungan atau di bawah tanah, dapat melihat dengan baik dalam gelap, menambang emas, perak, dan besi, dan merupakan pandai besi yang mahir; dalam mitologi Nordik mereka membuat rantai yang mampu mengikat serigala Fenrir.
long_description.en: In early Norse sources dwarfs are not said to be small, but in the legendary sagas and later folklore they are often described as short; some can change shape, like Andvari who lived as a pike. In the poem Alvissmol, the dwarf Alvis, wishing to marry Thor's daughter, is made to answer question after question until dawn, and Thor says "the day has caught thee, dwarf" as the sun shines in the hall. According to the id article, dwarfs live in caves in the mountains or underground, see well in the dark, mine gold, silver and iron, and are skilled smiths; in Norse mythology they made the chain able to bind the wolf Fenrir.

long_description.id: Kurcaci tetap muncul dalam cerita rakyat modern wilayah berbahasa Jermanik, misalnya Simonside Dwarfs di Northumberland yang konon memakai cahaya untuk menyesatkan orang seperti will-o'-the-wisp. Dalam budaya populer mereka tampil dalam karya J. R. R. Tolkien dan Terry Pratchett, dan dalam dongeng Putih Salju digambarkan sebagai bangsa pekerja keras yang polos tetapi melindungi.
long_description.en: Dwarfs remain in the modern folklore of Germanic-speaking regions, such as the Simonside Dwarfs of Northumberland, said to use lights to lure people off paths like a will-o'-the-wisp. In popular culture they appear in the works of J. R. R. Tolkien and Terry Pratchett, and in the tale of Snow White they are a hard-working, simple but protective people.

short_description.id: Naga adalah kelompok makhluk ilahi atau setengah ilahi berbentuk manusia dan ular dalam tradisi Asia.
short_description.en: Nagas are a class of divine or semidivine human and serpent beings in Asian traditions.

long_description.id: Naga adalah kelompok makhluk ilahi atau setengah ilahi berbentuk manusia dan ular dalam tradisi Asia. Tempat tinggalnya disebut Patala, alam bawah.
long_description.en: Nagas are a class of divine or semidivine human and serpent beings in Asian traditions. Their dwelling is called Patala, the netherworld.

long_description.id: Mereka dapat tampil sebagai manusia, ular, atau makhluk campuran manusia dan ular. Naga perempuan disebut Nagini. Kashyapa dan Kadru disebut sebagai orang tua kelompok ini dalam legenda. Nagaraja adalah gelar raja para naga. Kisah mereka penting dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha di Asia Selatan serta Tenggara. Naga dalam Sanskerta terutama berarti ular, sering kali kobra India. Naga menonjol dalam ikonografi Hindu dan buku pertama Mahabharata. Alam Naga-loka digambarkan berisi permata, emas, dan harta bumi. Naga dikaitkan dengan sungai, danau, laut, dan sumur serta peran penjaga harta. Vishnu digambarkan berbaring pada Shesha atau dilindungi tudungnya. Di India Selatan, sarang rayap dianggap tempat tinggal nagamma perempuan. Mackenzie membahas naga sebagai setengah dewa yang kadang membantu manusia dan memberi minuman penambah kekuatan dalam cerita. Museum Cleveland menjelaskan pentingnya naga bagi pemuja lokal sebagai pengendali air yang menunjang kemakmuran.
long_description.en: They can appear as humans, serpents, or mixed human and serpent beings. A female naga is called Nagini. Kashyapa and Kadru are called this class's parents in legend. Nagaraja is the title of the king of nagas. Their narratives are important in Hindu and Buddhist traditions in South and Southeast Asia. Naga in Sanskrit primarily means snake, often the Indian cobra. Nagas are prominent in Hindu iconography and the first book of the Mahabharata. Naga-loka is described as containing gems, gold, and earthly treasures. Nagas are associated with rivers, lakes, seas, and wells and with guarding treasure. Vishnu is depicted reclining on Shesha or sheltered by his hood. In South India, termite hills are regarded as dwellings of female nagammas. Mackenzie discusses nagas as demigods who sometimes aid humans and give strength enhancing drinks in stories. The Cleveland Museum explains the importance of nagas to local worshippers as controllers of water supporting prosperity.

short_description.id: Tefnut adalah dewi kelembapan Mesir dan anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
short_description.en: Tefnut is an Egyptian moisture goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

long_description.id: Tefnut adalah dewi kelembapan Mesir dan anggota Ennead Heliopolis. Atum disebut sebagai orang tuanya. Shu adalah saudara laki-laki sekaligus pasangannya.
long_description.en: Tefnut is an Egyptian moisture goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead. Atum is named as her parent. Shu is her brother and consort.

long_description.id: Geb dan Nut adalah anak-anaknya bersama Shu. Ia berupa singa betina atau dewi berkepala singa. Ia membantu Shu menopang langit dan menjaga kestabilan dunia. Dalam satu kisah ia pergi dari Mesir ke gurun Nubia sebagai singa betina ganas. Ia dapat diidentifikasi dengan Bastet, Sekhmet, dan Hathor.
long_description.en: Geb and Nut are her children with Shu. She takes the form of a lioness or lion-headed goddess. She helps Shu support the sky and maintain the world’s stability. In one tale she leaves Egypt for the Nubian desert as a fierce lioness. She can be identified with Bastet, Sekhmet and Hathor.

long_description.id: Sumber ini menggambarkan Tefnut sebagai dewi atmosfer dekat bumi. Namanya dikaitkan dengan bunyi meludah dalam penafsiran yang dikutip sumber. Seni juga menggambarkannya sebagai ular berkepala singa. Satu versi penciptaan melahirkan Shu dan Tefnut lewat ludah Atum. Budge menghubungkan Tefnut sebagai dewi orang mati dengan minuman bagi almarhum. Dalam uraian Budge, Tefnut adalah mata kiri Temu, dibandingkan dengan bulan. Temu, Shu, dan Tefnut membentuk tiga serangkai dalam teks penciptaan yang dikutip Budge.
long_description.en: This source describes Tefnut as goddess of the atmosphere near the earth. Her name is associated with the sound of spitting in the interpretation cited by this source. Art also depicts her as a lion-headed serpent. One creation version produces Shu and Tefnut through Atum’s spitting. Budge connects Tefnut as a goddess of the dead with drink for the deceased. In Budge’s account Tefnut is Temu’s left eye, compared with the moon. Temu, Shu and Tefnut form a trinity in the creation text cited by Budge.

long_description.id: Tefnut adalah padanan perempuan dewa udara Shu. Fungsi mitologisnya kurang jelas dibanding Shu, tetapi para Egiptolog mengaitkannya dengan kelembapan berdasarkan satu bagian Pyramid Texts tempat ia menghasilkan air. Budge menyebutnya saudari kembar Shu yang melambangkan kelembapan atau salah satu aspek panas matahari, dan World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya ibu Geb dan Nut, yang lahir agar manusia punya tempat tinggal. Ia juga salah satu dewi yang dapat berfungsi sebagai Mata Ra yang berapi.
long_description.en: Tefnut is the feminine counterpart of the air god Shu. Her mythological role is less clear than his, but Egyptologists link her with moisture on the strength of a Pyramid Texts passage in which she produces water. Budge calls her the twin sister of Shu who typified moisture or an aspect of the sun's heat, and World History Encyclopedia calls her the mother of Geb and Nut, born so that humans would have somewhere to live. She is also one of the goddesses who could act as the fiery Eye of Ra.

long_description.id: Nama Tefnut tidak punya etimologi yang pasti, tetapi mungkin meniru bunyi meludah, sebab dalam sejumlah versi mitos penciptaan Atum meludahkannya. Pyramid Text 527 menyatakan bahwa Atum bersin di Heliopolis dan lahirlah Shu dan Tefnut, sedangkan Teks Peti Mati menyebut Shu dibersinkan dari hidung Atum dan Tefnut diludahkan seperti air liur. Dalam legenda penciptaan terjemahan Budge, dewa yang berbicara mengatakan bahwa ia belum mengeluarkan Shu dan belum meludahkan Tefnut. Budge juga menulis bahwa Temu memindahkan daya magis hidupnya kepada Shu dan Tefnut dengan memeluk mereka. Dalam sebuah mantra terjemahan Budge, mata kiri seseorang disamakan dengan Tefnut dan mata kanannya dengan Shu, yang disebut anak-anak Ra.
long_description.en: The name Tefnut has no certain etymology but may imitate the sound of spitting, since in several versions of the creation myth Atum spits her out. Pyramid Text 527 says that Atum sneezed in Heliopolis and Shu and Tefnut were born, while the Coffin Texts speak of Shu being sneezed out of the nose of Atum and Tefnut being spat out like saliva. In a creation legend translated by Budge, the god who speaks says that he had not yet emitted Shu or spat out Tefnut. Budge also writes that Temu gave Shu and Tefnut the magical force of his life through an embrace. In a spell translated by Budge, the left eye of the person addressed is likened to Tefnut and his right eye to Shu, who are called the children of Ra.

long_description.id: Tefnut berwujud singa: ia tampil sebagai manusia berkepala singa betina ketika menjadi bagian dari Ennead Agung Heliopolis, sering pula sebagai singa betina, dan dapat digambarkan sepenuhnya sebagai manusia. Ia juga berperan sebagai nyonya api yang dihiasi nyala api sebagai lambang perlindungan terhadap musuh. Pada masa Dinasti ke-18 dan ke-19, terutama pada Periode Amarna, ia digambarkan berwujud manusia dengan penutup kepala datar rendah yang dihiasi tanaman bertunas. Heliopolis dan Leontopolis adalah pusat pemujaannya, dan di Leontopolis ia dipuja bersama Shu sebagai sepasang singa. Dalam sebuah pasal Kitab Orang Mati, Tefnut disebut bersama Ra dan Shu sebagai salah satu Jiwa Annu.
long_description.en: Tefnut is leonine: she appears as a lioness-headed human as part of the Great Ennead of Heliopolis, often as a lioness, and can also be shown fully human. She also takes the role of mistress of the flame, adorned with a flame as protection against enemies. In the 18th and 19th Dynasties, especially in the Amarna Period, she was shown in human form with a low flat headdress topped with sprouting plants. Heliopolis and Leontopolis were her cult centres, and at Leontopolis she was worshiped together with Shu as a pair of lions. In a Book of the Dead chapter, Tefnut is named with Ra and Shu as one of the Souls of Annu.

cultural_context.id: Temu, Shu, dan Tefnut membentuk tiga serangkai dalam teks penciptaan yang dikutip Budge. Di Karnak, Tefnut diseru dalam doa untuk kesehatan dan kesejahteraan firaun.
cultural_context.en: Temu, Shu and Tefnut form a trinity in the creation text cited by Budge. At Karnak, prayers for the pharaoh's health and wellbeing invoked Tefnut.

note.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the twin lion gods Ruty were originally associated with Shu and Tefnut as sky deities.

claims.quote: テフヌト（Tefnut）は、エジプト神話における湿気の女神。ヘリオポリス九柱神に数えられる。テフヌト、テフヌウト、テフェネト、テフヌートなどとも表記され、ギリシア語ではトフェニスと呼ばれる。

statement.id: Tefnut adalah dewi kelembapan Mesir dan anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
statement.en: Tefnut is an Egyptian moisture goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

claims.quote: 創造神アトゥムを親に持ち、アトゥムの自慰によって生まれた（ラーと習合されたため、ラーともされる）。

statement.id: Atum disebut sebagai orang tuanya.
statement.en: Atum is named as her parent.

statement.id: Shu adalah saudara laki-laki sekaligus pasangannya.
statement.en: Shu is her brother and consort.

statement.id: Geb dan Nut adalah anak-anaknya bersama Shu.
statement.en: Geb and Nut are her children with Shu.

claims.quote: 雌ライオンもしくは、ライオンの頭を持った女神として描かれる。シューの妻としての伝承ばかりでテフヌト単独での伝承は、ほとんど見られない。

statement.id: Ia berupa singa betina atau dewi berkepala singa.
statement.en: She takes the form of a lioness or lion-headed goddess.

statement.id: Ia membantu Shu menopang langit dan menjaga kestabilan dunia.
statement.en: She helps Shu support the sky and maintain the world’s stability.

claims.quote: テフヌトは、シューの妻となる前に家出をしたという神話があり、宮殿で退屈していたテフヌトは父親（ここでは太陽神ラーとされる）に何も告げず、南のヌビア砂漠へ家出してしまう。獰猛な雌ライオンとなって気ままに駆け回っていたテフヌトに父親は、息子シューと知恵の神トートに依頼し、ようやく連れ戻すことに成功した、という内容である。

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah ia pergi dari Mesir ke gurun Nubia sebagai singa betina ganas.
statement.en: In one tale she leaves Egypt for the Nubian desert as a fierce lioness.

claims.quote: 太陽神ラーの娘であること、雌ライオンの姿を持つことから、エジプトの女神バステトとセクメト、セクメトと同一視された女神ハトホルと同一視されることがある。

statement.id: Ia dapat diidentifikasi dengan Bastet, Sekhmet, dan Hathor.
statement.en: She can be identified with Bastet, Sekhmet and Hathor.

claims.quote: She is goddess of the atmosphere of the lower world, the earth, just as Shu is god of the upper atmosphere above the earth.

statement.id: Sumber ini menggambarkan Tefnut sebagai dewi atmosfer dekat bumi.
statement.en: This source describes Tefnut as goddess of the atmosphere near the earth.

claims.quote: her name represents the sound of spitting

statement.id: Namanya dikaitkan dengan bunyi meludah dalam penafsiran yang dikutip sumber.
statement.en: Her name is associated with the sound of spitting in the interpretation cited by this source.

claims.quote: She is most often depicted as a woman seated with a lion's head or a serpent with a lion's head.

statement.id: Seni juga menggambarkannya sebagai ular berkepala singa.
statement.en: Art also depicts her as a lion-headed serpent.

claims.quote: Shu and Tefnut were the first two gods Atum created either by mating with his shadow or by spitting.

statement.id: Satu versi penciptaan melahirkan Shu dan Tefnut lewat ludah Atum.
statement.en: One creation version produces Shu and Tefnut through Atum’s spitting.

claims.quote: as a god of the dead she seems to have been, in some way, connected with the supply of drink to the deceased.

statement.id: Budge menghubungkan Tefnut sebagai dewi orang mati dengan minuman bagi almarhum.
statement.en: Budge connects Tefnut as a goddess of the dead with drink for the deceased.

claims.quote: she was the left, i.e., Shu represented an aspect of the Sun, and Tefnut of the Moon.

statement.id: Dalam uraian Budge, Tefnut adalah mata kiri Temu, dibandingkan dengan bulan.
statement.en: In Budge’s account Tefnut is Temu’s left eye, compared with the moon.

claims.quote: The gods Temu, Shu, and Tefnut thus formed a trinity

statement.id: Temu, Shu, dan Tefnut membentuk tiga serangkai dalam teks penciptaan yang dikutip Budge.
statement.en: Temu, Shu and Tefnut form a trinity in the creation text cited by Budge.

claims.quote: is a deity in Ancient Egyptian religion, the feminine counterpart of the air god Shu.

statement.id: Tefnut adalah dewa dalam agama Mesir kuno, padanan perempuan dewa udara Shu.
statement.en: Tefnut is a deity in Ancient Egyptian religion, the feminine counterpart of the air god Shu.

claims.quote: Her mythological function is less clear than that of Shu, but Egyptologists have suggested she is connected with moisture, based on a passage in the Pyramid Texts in which she produces water, and on parallelism with Shu's connection with dry air.

statement.id: Fungsi mitologis Tefnut kurang jelas dibanding Shu, tetapi para Egiptolog mengusulkan bahwa ia berkaitan dengan kelembapan, berdasarkan satu bagian Pyramid Texts tempat ia menghasilkan air dan berdasarkan kesejajaran dengan kaitan Shu pada udara kering.
statement.en: Her mythological function is less clear than that of Shu, but Egyptologists have suggested she is connected with moisture, based on a Pyramid Texts passage in which she produces water and on parallelism with Shu's connection with dry air.

claims.quote: She was also one of the goddesses who could function as the fiery Eye of Ra.

statement.id: Tefnut juga salah satu dewi yang dapat berfungsi sebagai Mata Ra yang berapi.
statement.en: Tefnut was also one of the goddesses who could function as the fiery Eye of Ra.

claims.quote: The name Tefnut has no certain etymology but it may be an onomatopoeia of the sound of spitting, as Atum spits her out in some versions of the creation myth. Additionally, her name was written as a mouth spitting in late texts.

statement.id: Nama Tefnut tidak memiliki etimologi yang pasti, tetapi mungkin tiruan bunyi meludah, karena dalam beberapa versi mitos penciptaan Atum meludahkannya; selain itu, dalam teks-teks akhir namanya ditulis sebagai mulut yang meludah.
statement.en: The name Tefnut has no certain etymology but may be an onomatopoeia of the sound of spitting, as Atum spits her out in some versions of the creation myth; in addition, her name was written as a mouth spitting in late texts.

claims.quote: Tefnut's grandchildren were Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and, in some versions, Horus the Elder.

statement.id: Cucu-cucu Tefnut adalah Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, dan, dalam sebagian versi, Horus yang Tua.
statement.en: Tefnut's grandchildren were Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys and, in some versions, Horus the Elder.

claims.quote: Pyramid Text 527 says, "Atum was creative in that he proceeded to sneeze while in Heliopolis. And brother and sister were born - that is Shu and Tefnut."

statement.id: Pyramid Text 527 menyatakan bahwa Atum bersifat kreatif karena ia bersin di Heliopolis, lalu kakak-beradik itu lahir, yaitu Shu dan Tefnut.
statement.en: Pyramid Text 527 says that Atum was creative in that he sneezed in Heliopolis, and that brother and sister were born, that is Shu and Tefnut.

claims.quote: The Coffin Texts contain references to Shu being sneezed out by Atum from his nose, and Tefnut being spat out like saliva.

statement.id: Teks Peti Mati memuat rujukan bahwa Shu dibersinkan oleh Atum dari hidungnya, dan Tefnut diludahkan seperti air liur.
statement.en: The Coffin Texts contain references to Shu being sneezed out by Atum from his nose and Tefnut being spat out like saliva.

claims.quote: Tefnut is a leonine deity, and appears as human with a lioness head when depicted as part of the Great Ennead of Heliopolis. The other frequent depiction is as a lioness, but Tefnut can also be depicted as fully human.

statement.id: Tefnut adalah dewi berwujud singa: ia tampil sebagai manusia berkepala singa betina ketika digambarkan sebagai bagian dari Ennead Agung Heliopolis. Penggambaran lain yang sering adalah sebagai singa betina, tetapi ia juga dapat digambarkan sepenuhnya sebagai manusia.
statement.en: Tefnut is a leonine deity and appears as a human with a lioness head when depicted as part of the Great Ennead of Heliopolis. The other frequent depiction is as a lioness, but she can also be depicted as fully human.

claims.quote: She even assumes the role of the mistress of the flame, where she is adorned with a flame to represent protection against enemies.

statement.id: Tefnut bahkan berperan sebagai nyonya api, dihiasi nyala api sebagai lambang perlindungan terhadap musuh.
statement.en: Tefnut even assumes the role of the mistress of the flame, adorned with a flame to represent protection against enemies.

claims.quote: Heliopolis and Leontopolis (now ell el-Muqdam) were the primary cult centres.

statement.id: Heliopolis dan Leontopolis adalah pusat pemujaan utama Tefnut.
statement.en: Heliopolis and Leontopolis were the primary cult centres of Tefnut.

claims.quote: She was worshiped with Shu as a pair of lions in Leontopolis in the Nile Delta.

statement.id: Tefnut dipuja bersama Shu sebagai sepasang singa di Leontopolis, di Delta Nil.
statement.en: Tefnut was worshiped with Shu as a pair of lions in Leontopolis in the Nile Delta.

claims.quote: At Karnak, Tefnut formed part of the Ennead and was invoked in prayers for the health and wellbeing of the pharaoh.

statement.id: Di Karnak, Tefnut menjadi bagian dari Ennead dan diseru dalam doa untuk kesehatan dan kesejahteraan firaun.
statement.en: At Karnak, Tefnut formed part of the Ennead and was invoked in prayers for the health and wellbeing of the pharaoh.

claims.quote: As a lioness she could display a wrathful aspect and is said to have escaped to Nubia in a rage, jealous of her grandchildren's higher worship. Only after receiving the title "honorable" from Thoth, did she return.

statement.id: Sebagai singa betina, Tefnut dapat menunjukkan sisi murka dan dikatakan melarikan diri ke Nubia dalam kemarahan karena cemburu pada pemujaan yang lebih tinggi bagi cucu-cucunya; ia baru kembali setelah menerima gelar "terhormat" dari Thoth.
statement.en: As a lioness Tefnut could display a wrathful aspect and is said to have escaped to Nubia in a rage, jealous of her grandchildren's higher worship; she returned only after receiving the title "honorable" from Thoth.

claims.quote: Tefnut is the mother of Geb (earth) and Nut (sky) who were born so human beings could have somewhere to live.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Tefnut adalah ibu Geb (bumi) dan Nut (langit), yang lahir agar manusia punya tempat tinggal.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Tefnut is the mother of Geb (earth) and Nut (sky), who were born so human beings could have somewhere to live.

claims.quote: Shu - The primordial god of the air whose name means "Emptiness". He was born at the beginning of creation of Atum (Ra) and sent to create the world with his sister Tefnut (goddess of moisture). The two were gone so long that Atum came to miss them and sent his eye (the Eye of Ra) in search of them. When the eye returned with them, Atum was so happy he cried and his tears created human beings.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Shu, dewa udara, dilahirkan Atum (Ra) pada awal penciptaan dan diutus menciptakan dunia bersama saudarinya Tefnut, dewi kelembapan. Keduanya pergi begitu lama sampai Atum merindukan mereka dan mengirim matanya (Mata Ra) untuk mencari; ketika mata itu kembali bersama mereka, Atum begitu bahagia hingga menangis, dan air matanya menciptakan manusia.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Shu, the god of the air, was born of Atum (Ra) at the beginning of creation and sent to create the world with his sister Tefnut, goddess of moisture. The two were gone so long that Atum came to miss them and sent his eye (the Eye of Ra) to find them; when the eye returned with them Atum was so happy he cried, and his tears created human beings.

claims.quote: Ruty - The twin lion gods who represented the eastern and western horizons. The name means "Pair of Lions". They were originally associated with Shu and Tefnut as sky deities and eventually became linked with Ra and the solar barge.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Ruty, dewa kembar berwujud singa yang mewakili cakrawala timur dan barat, pada mulanya dikaitkan dengan Shu dan Tefnut sebagai dewa langit, lalu akhirnya dikaitkan dengan Ra dan perahu matahari.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Ruty, the twin lion gods who represented the eastern and western horizons, were originally associated with Shu and Tefnut as sky deities and eventually became linked with Ra and the solar barge.

claims.quote: TEFNUT was the twin-sister of Shu; as a power of nature she typified moisture or some aspect of the sun's heat
claims.locator: Egyptian Ideas of the Future Life, the gods of the Heliopolitan company

statement.id: Budge menulis bahwa Tefnut adalah saudari kembar Shu dan sebagai kekuatan alam ia melambangkan kelembapan atau salah satu aspek panas matahari.
statement.en: Budge writes that Tefnut was the twin sister of Shu and, as a power of nature, typified moisture or some aspect of the sun's heat.

claims.quote: I know the Souls of Annu, namely, Rā, Shu, and Tefnut.

statement.id: Dalam sebuah pasal Kitab Orang Mati, sang penutur menyatakan bahwa ia mengenal Jiwa-jiwa Annu, yaitu Ra, Shu, dan Tefnut.
statement.en: In a Book of the Dead chapter, the speaker declares that he knows the Souls of Annu, namely Ra, Shu and Tefnut.

claims.quote: I was [then] one by myself, for I had not emitted from myself the god Shu, and I had not spit out from myself the goddess Tefnut; and there existed no other who could work with me.
claims.locator: The Legend of the God Neb-er-tcher, and the History of Creation

statement.id: Dalam legenda penciptaan terjemahan Budge, dewa yang berbicara mengatakan bahwa pada waktu itu ia sendirian karena belum mengeluarkan Shu dari dirinya dan belum meludahkan Tefnut, dan tidak ada yang lain yang dapat bekerja bersamanya.
statement.en: In the creation legend translated by Budge, the god who speaks says that he was then alone, for he had not yet emitted Shu from himself nor spit out Tefnut, and no other existed who could work with him.

claims.quote: Thy right eye is like Shu, and thy left eye like Tefnut, who are the children of Ra.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Death and Resurrection of Horus, and other magical texts: the narrative of Isis

statement.id: Dalam sebuah mantra terjemahan Budge, yang dituju diberi tahu bahwa mata kanannya seperti Shu dan mata kirinya seperti Tefnut, yang adalah anak-anak Ra.
statement.en: In a spell translated by Budge, the person addressed is told that his right eye is like Shu and his left eye like Tefnut, who are the children of Ra.

claims.quote: Thus Temu transferred the magical power of his life to Shu and Tefnut by embracing them
claims.locator: The Legend of Khensu Nefer-hetep and the Princess of Bekhten, Budge's commentary

statement.id: Budge menulis bahwa Temu memindahkan daya magis hidupnya kepada Shu dan Tefnut dengan memeluk mereka.
statement.en: Budge writes that Temu transferred the magical power of his life to Shu and Tefnut by embracing them.

claims.quote: During the 18th and 19th Dynasties, particularly during the Amarna Period, Tefnut was depicted in human form wearing a low flat headdress, topped with sprouting plants.

statement.id: Pada masa Dinasti ke-18 dan ke-19, terutama pada Periode Amarna, Tefnut digambarkan berwujud manusia dengan penutup kepala datar rendah yang dihiasi tanaman bertunas.
statement.en: During the 18th and 19th Dynasties, particularly during the Amarna Period, Tefnut was depicted in human form wearing a low flat headdress topped with sprouting plants.

summary.en: According to this entry's first source, Tefnut was born of Atum's act of self-pleasuring.

summary.id: Menurut sumber pertama entri ini, Tefnut yang bosan di istana pergi dari rumah ke gurun Nubia sebelum menjadi istri Shu, lalu dibawa pulang oleh Shu dan Thoth.
summary.en: According to this entry's first source, Tefnut, bored in the palace, ran away to the Nubian desert before becoming Shu's wife and was brought back by Shu and Thoth.

summary.id: Sumber lain menyebut Tefnut melarikan diri ke Nubia dalam kemarahan karena cemburu pada pemujaan yang lebih tinggi bagi cucu-cucunya, dan kembali setelah menerima gelar "terhormat" dari Thoth.
summary.en: Another source says Tefnut escaped to Nubia in a rage, jealous of her grandchildren's higher worship, and returned after receiving the title "honorable" from Thoth.

short_description.id: Apis adalah banteng suci yang dipuja di daerah Memphis dalam agama Mesir.
short_description.en: Apis is a sacred bull worshipped in the Memphis region of Egyptian religion.

long_description.id: Apis adalah banteng suci yang dipuja di daerah Memphis dalam agama Mesir. Ia dikenal sebagai putra Hathor. Ia menjadi perantara manusia dengan dewa, awalnya Ptah.
long_description.en: Apis is a sacred bull worshipped in the Memphis region of Egyptian religion. He is known as Hathor’s son. He mediates between humans and gods, originally Ptah.

long_description.id: Penggalian Serapeum Saqqara menemukan makam lebih dari enam puluh hewan. Pemujaan banteng Apis diketahui sejak Dinasti Pertama di Memphis. Setelah mati, Apis menjadi Osorapis atau Osiris-Apis. Kultus Apis termasuk tiga kultus banteng besar bersama Mnevis dan Buchis. Banteng melambangkan keberanian, kekuatan, dan daya juang raja.
long_description.en: Excavation of Saqqara’s Serapeum reveals tombs of over sixty animals. Worship of an Apis bull is known from the First Dynasty at Memphis. After death Apis becomes Osorapis or Osiris-Apis. The Apis cult belongs to three major bull cults with Mnevis and Buchis. The bull symbolizes the king’s courage, strength and fighting spirit.

long_description.id: Ia kadang digambarkan dengan cakram matahari di antara tanduknya. Banteng terpilih dikenali melalui tanda khusus termasuk segitiga putih di dahi. Kultus Apis disebut salah satu yang penting dan berumur panjang dalam sejarah Mesir. Plutarch, dalam kutipan Mackenzie, menyebut Apis lahir melalui cahaya generatif bulan. Gerakan Apis ditafsirkan sebagai nubuat di kuil. Napas Apis dipercaya menyembuhkan penyakit. Pada hari tertentu ia diarak dengan perhiasan dan bunga.
long_description.en: He is sometimes shown with the solar disk between his horns. The chosen bull is identified by special markings including a white forehead triangle. The Apis cult is described as an important and long-lived cult in Egyptian history. Plutarch, as quoted by Mackenzie, describes Apis as begotten through generative moonlight. Apis’s movements are interpreted as prophecies at the temple. Apis’s breath is believed to cure disease. On certain holidays he is paraded with jewellery and flowers.

cultural_context.en: On certain holidays he is paraded with jewellery and flowers.

note.en: He is known as Hathor’s son.

statement.en: He mediates between humans and gods, originally Ptah.

statement.en: Excavation of Saqqara’s Serapeum reveals tombs of over sixty animals.

claims.quote: Worship of an Apis bull, experienced by ancient Egyptians as holy, has been known since the First Dynasty in Memphis, while worship of the Apis as a proper god, at least according to Manetho's Aegyptiaca, seems to be a later adoption, purportedly started during the reign of king Kaiechos (possibly Nebra) of the Second Dynasty.

statement.id: Pemujaan banteng Apis diketahui sejak Dinasti Pertama di Memphis.
statement.en: Worship of an Apis bull is known from the First Dynasty at Memphis.

claims.quote: after death, he became Osorapis, i.e. the Osiris Apis

statement.id: Setelah mati, Apis menjadi Osorapis atau Osiris-Apis.
statement.en: After death Apis becomes Osorapis or Osiris-Apis.

claims.quote: Apis was the most popular of three great bull cults of ancient Egypt, the others being the cults of Mnevis and Buchis. All are related to the worship of Hathor or Bat, similar primary goddesses separated by region until unification that eventually merged as Hathor. The worship of Apis was continued by the Greeks and after them by the Romans, and lasted until almost 400 CE.

statement.id: Kultus Apis termasuk tiga kultus banteng besar bersama Mnevis dan Buchis.
statement.en: The Apis cult belongs to three major bull cults with Mnevis and Buchis.

claims.quote: This animal was chosen because it symbolized the courageous heart, great strength, and fighting spirit of the king. Apis came to be considered a manifestation of the king, as bulls were symbols of strength and fertility, qualities that are closely linked with kingship.

statement.id: Banteng melambangkan keberanian, kekuatan, dan daya juang raja.
statement.en: The bull symbolizes the king’s courage, strength and fighting spirit.

claims.quote: Occasionally, Apis was pictured with the sun-disk symbol of his mother, Hathor, between his horns, being one of few deities ever associated with her symbol. When the disk was depicted on his head with his horns below and the triangular marking on his forehead, an ankh was suggested. That symbol always was closely associated with Hathor.

statement.id: Ia kadang digambarkan dengan cakram matahari di antara tanduknya.
statement.en: He is sometimes shown with the solar disk between his horns.

claims.quote: It was required to have a white triangular marking upon its forehead

statement.id: Banteng terpilih dikenali melalui tanda khusus termasuk segitiga putih di dahi.
statement.en: The chosen bull is identified by special markings including a white forehead triangle.

claims.quote: The Apis Cult was one of the most important and long-lived in the history of Egyptian culture.

statement.id: Kultus Apis disebut salah satu yang penting dan berumur panjang dalam sejarah Mesir.
statement.en: The Apis cult is described as an important and long-lived cult in Egyptian history.

claims.quote: His breath was believed to cure disease and his presence to bless those around with strength.

short_description.id: Ahriman adalah roh jahat dalam tradisi Iran, Zoroastrianisme, dan Zurvanisme, yang dikaitkan dengan kegelapan serta kekacauan.
short_description.en: Ahriman is an evil spirit in Iranian tradition, Zoroastrianism, and Zurvanism, associated with darkness and chaos.

long_description.id: Ahriman adalah roh jahat dalam tradisi Iran, Zoroastrianisme, dan Zurvanisme, yang dikaitkan dengan kegelapan serta kekacauan. Angra Mainyu menjadi nama lain Ahriman.
long_description.en: Ahriman is an evil spirit in Iranian tradition, Zoroastrianism, and Zurvanism, associated with darkness and chaos. Angra Mainyu is another name for Ahriman.

long_description.id: Sumber menjelaskan Ahriman berlawanan dengan Spenta Mainyu dan Ahura Mazda. Dalam Zurvanisme, Zurvan melahirkan Ahura Mazda dan Ahriman. Dalam uraian Hinnells yang dikutip, Ahriman mendiami jurang kegelapan tanpa akhir di utara. Ahriman dapat berubah bentuk menjadi kadal, ular, atau pemuda. Tujuan Ahriman dijelaskan sebagai menghancurkan ciptaan Ahura Mazda. Ahriman membalas kehidupan dengan kematian dan kesehatan dengan penyakit. Kisah yang dibahas melibatkan Gavaevodta, Banteng Primordial. Gayomartan juga dibunuh oleh Ahriman dalam kisah itu. Ahriman membisikkan kebohongan kepada pasangan manusia pertama bahwa dialah pencipta mereka. Nama Avestanya adalah Angra Mainyu. Dalam Gatha, angra mainyu belum diperlakukan sebagai nama diri. Pembacaan Ahuna Vairya oleh Ahura Mazda disebut membuat Angra Mainyu terpana. Pengantar terjemahan Vendidad I menjelaskan enam belas negeri ciptaan Ahura Mazda dan wabah tandingannya dari Angra Mainyu.
long_description.en: The source places Ahriman in opposition to Spenta Mainyu and Ahura Mazda. In Zurvanism, Zurvan gives birth to Ahura Mazda and Ahriman. In the quoted account by Hinnells, Ahriman inhabits an abyss of endless northern darkness. Ahriman can change form into a lizard, snake, or young man. Ahriman’s aim is described as destroying Ahura Mazda’s creation. Ahriman counters life with death and health with disease. The account includes Gavaevodta, the Primordial Bull. Gayomartan is also killed by Ahriman in that account. Ahriman lies to the first human couple by claiming to be their creator. His Avestan name is Angra Mainyu. In the Gathas, angra mainyu is not yet a proper name. Angra Mainyu falls into a stupor when Ahura Mazda recites Ahuna Vairya. The introduction to Vendidad I describes sixteen lands created by Ahura Mazda and opposing plagues created by Angra Mainyu.

short_description.id: Apsara adalah kelompok makhluk perempuan surgawi dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha.
short_description.en: Apsaras are a class of celestial female beings in Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

long_description.id: Apsara adalah kelompok makhluk perempuan surgawi dalam tradisi Hindu dan Buddha. Mereka dikenal sebagai penari istana Indra.
long_description.en: Apsaras are a class of celestial female beings in Hindu and Buddhist traditions. They are known as dancers at Indra's court.

long_description.id: Gandharva berhubungan dengan mereka sebagai musisi dan pasangan. Sebagian kisah memberi mereka kemampuan mengubah wujud. Indra mengirim apsara menggoda resi yang bertapa dalam sejumlah cerita. Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, dan Ghritachi termasuk apsara yang dikenal. Di Jepang, nama Tennin dan Tennyo digunakan untuk sosok terkait apsara. Etimologi Monier-Williams menghubungkan namanya dengan bergerak di air atau di antara air awan. Uraian awal membandingkan apsara dengan nimfa air. Rigveda memuat dialog Urvashi dengan kekasih manusia Pururavas. Kaushitaki Upanishad mengaitkan apsara dengan minyak wangi, rangkaian bunga, pakaian, dan wewangian bubuk. Ramayana dan Purana menghubungkan asal apsara dengan pengadukan lautan. Mahabharata menuturkan Tilottama menyelamatkan dunia dari Sunda dan Upasunda. Mackenzie menuturkan apsara menari ketika Gandharva memainkan alat musik ilahi.
long_description.en: Gandharvas are associated with them as musicians and partners. Some accounts give them the ability to change shape. Indra sends apsaras to tempt ascetic sages in several stories. Urvashi, Menaka, Rambha, Tilottama, and Ghritachi are among the known apsaras. In Japan, the names Tennin and Tennyo are used for figures associated with apsaras. Monier Williams's etymology connects the name with moving in water or among cloud waters. Early descriptions compare apsaras to water nymphs. The Rigveda contains Urvashi's dialogue with her mortal lover Pururavas. The Kaushitaki Upanishad associates apsaras with ointments, garlands, clothes, and powdered aromatics. The Ramayana and Puranas connect the origin of apsaras with the churning of the ocean. The Mahabharata recounts Tilottama saving the world from Sunda and Upasunda. Mackenzie recounts apsaras dancing when Gandharvas play divine instruments.

short_description.id: Enki atau Ea adalah dewa kebijaksanaan, air tawar, dan kecerdasan Sumeria.
short_description.en: Sumerian tradition associates Enki, also named Ea, with wisdom, intelligence, and freshwater.

long_description.id: Enki atau Ea adalah dewa kebijaksanaan, air tawar, dan kecerdasan Sumeria. Penggambaran Enki menunjukkan pria berjanggut dengan tutup kepala bertanduk dan jubah panjang.
long_description.en: Sumerian tradition associates Enki, also named Ea, with wisdom, intelligence, and freshwater. Images show Enki with a beard, long robes, and a cap bearing horns.

long_description.id: Aliran air digambarkan keluar dari bahu Enki. Nama Enki diartikan sebagai Penguasa Bumi. Ikan dan kambing menjadi simbol Enki yang dijelaskan sebagai lambang kesuburan. Enki menjadi pelindung Eridu, kota yang dianggap pertama didirikan. Catatan tertulisnya ditelusuri ke Periode Dinasti Awal III. Dalam mitologi Sumeria dan Akkadia, Anu disebut sebagai ayah Enki. Teks Babilonia menyebut Enki sebagai putra Apsu. Versi lain menyebut Nammu sebagai ibunya. Enki membentuk triad Mesopotamia bersama Anu dan Enlil. Dalam Enuma Elish, Enki menidurkan ayahnya sebelum membunuhnya. Dalam Turunnya Inanna, dewi itu mempercayai Enki dapat menghidupkannya kembali. Damgalnuna disebut sebagai istri Enki. Kambing-ikan, tongkat berkepala domba, dan kura-kura adalah simbol Enki.
long_description.en: Streams of water are depicted flowing from Enki’s shoulders. Enki’s name is interpreted as Lord of the Earth. Fish and goats are Enki’s symbols, explained as representing fertility. Enki protects Eridu, regarded as the first established city. Written references to Enki are traced to Early Dynastic Period III. Sumerian and Akkadian mythology identifies Anu as Enki’s father. Babylonian texts identify Enki as Apsu’s son. Enki is also referred to as the goddess Nammu’s son. Enki forms an early Mesopotamian triad with Anu and Enlil. In the Enuma Elish, Enki puts his father into a deep sleep before killing him. In the Descent of Inanna, the goddess trusts Enki to restore her to life. Damgalnuna is identified as Enki’s wife. Enki’s primary symbols include the goat-fish, a ram-headed staff, and the turtle.

short_description.id: Kematian adalah personifikasi kematian dalam berbagai mitologi dunia, kerap digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit atau pemandu jiwa.
short_description.en: Death is the personification of dying in global mythologies, often portrayed as a cloaked skeleton wielding a scythe or as a guiding psychopomp.

long_description.id: Personifikasi kematian hadir dalam banyak mitologi dan agama di dunia, serta digambarkan sebagai salah satu dari Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Dalam kisah modern, sosok ini sering dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper berwujud kerangka berjubah yang membawa sabit untuk menjemput jiwa. Pandangan lain menganggap sosok kematian adalah psychopomp atau pemandu yang bertugas mengantar orang yang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan saat terjadinya ajal.
long_description.en: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies, portrayed among the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. In modern stories, this figure is known as the Grim Reaper, depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls. Other beliefs describe death as a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when a person dies.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Greek, Thanatos dipandang sebagai perwujudan roh kematian tanpa kekerasan, bertangan lembut mendampingi saudaranya Hypnos, sedangkan kematian akibat kekerasan berada di ranah saudari-saudarinya, Keres. Seni lukis vas Greek dan relief Roman menggambarkan sosoknya bersayap atau membawa obor dan kupu-kupu penanda jiwa. Di berbagai belahan dunia sosok kematian juga berwujud perempuan seperti Santa Muerte di Mexico, sebutan la Parca di Latin America, serta kostucha di Poland dengan jubah putih.
long_description.en: In Greek traditions, Thanatos was regarded as the personified spirit of non-violent death with a gentle touch alongside his brother Hypnos, while violent death belonged to his sisters, the Keres. Greek vase painting and Roman reliefs depicted him with wings or holding a torch and butterfly. Worldwide, death also takes female forms such as Santa Muerte in Mexico, la Parca across Latin America, and kostucha in Poland with a white robe.

literal_meaning.en: the guide of souls

note.id: Hypnos adalah saudara kembar Thanatos.
note.en: Hypnos is the twin brother of Thanatos.

statement.en: Other beliefs hold that death is a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when or how they die.

short_description.id: Perun adalah dewa tertinggi dalam mitologi Slavia, penguasa langit, guruh, dan petir, yang juga dikaitkan dengan perang, hukum, dan pohon ek.
short_description.en: Perun is the highest god of Slavic mythology, lord of the sky, thunder and lightning, also linked with war, law and oak trees.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Perun menempati puncak jajaran dewa. Ia memerintah langit, guruh, petir, badai, dan hujan, serta berkaitan dengan hukum, perang, kesuburan, dan pohon ek. Lambang lain yang melekat padanya antara lain api, gunung, angin, bunga iris, elang, kuda dan kereta, serta senjata berupa palu, kapak, dan anak panah. Para peneliti juga menggambarkannya sebagai dewa badai tertinggi yang dihubungkan dengan batu, guruh, kilat, hujan, perang, dan keadilan.
long_description.en: In Slavic mythology Perun stands at the top of the pantheon. He rules the sky, thunder, lightning, storms and rain, and is tied to law, war, fertility and oak trees. Other emblems attached to him include fire, mountains, wind, the iris, the eagle, horses and carts, and weapons such as the hammer, the axe and the arrow. Scholars also describe him as a supreme storm god connected with rock, thunder, lightning, rain, war and justice.

long_description.id: Di Rus Kiev pada abad ke-9 sampai ke-10 ia adalah dewa tertinggi, mula-mula dikaitkan dengan senjata batu lalu dengan senjata logam. Ia sudah disebut pada abad ke-6 oleh sejarawan Romawi Timur Procopius dalam De Bello Gothico. Pada tahun 980 Vladimir mendirikan arca lima dewa pagan di depan istananya, dan Perun menjadi yang utama, dengan kepala perak dan kumis emas. Hari rayanya dirayakan dengan persembahan pada bulan Juli.
long_description.en: In Kievan Rus during the 9th and 10th centuries he was the supreme god, associated first with stone weapons and later with metal ones. He was already mentioned in the 6th century by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius in De Bello Gothico. In 980 Vladimir set up statues of five pagan gods before his palace, with Perun foremost among them, bearing a silver head and a golden moustache. His feast was celebrated with sacrifices in July.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, kilat Perun berupa batu dan anak panah batu, sehingga fulgurit, belemnit, dan perkakas batu prasejarah yang ditemukan di tanah dianggap sisa senjatanya. Senjata itu dipercaya melindungi dari nasib buruk, sihir jahat, penyakit, dan petir. Satu sumber menggambarkannya sebagai lelaki paruh baya berjanggut yang terbang di atas batu gilingan sambil melepaskan kilat dan guruh.
long_description.en: In folk belief Perun's lightning bolts were stones and stone arrows, so fulgurites, belemnites and prehistoric stone tools found in the ground were taken as remains of his weapons. These weapons were thought to guard against bad luck, evil magic, disease and lightning. One source pictures him as a bearded middle-aged man flying on a millstone while hurling lightning and thunder.

long_description.id: Perun dikatakan menikahi Matahari, tetapi berbagi istri dengan musuhnya Veles, karena Matahari setiap malam turun ke dunia bawah yang dikuasai Veles. Tempat pemujaannya berada di puncak gunung atau bukit, atau di hutan keramat di bawah pohon ek tua, dengan persembahan banteng, sapi, domba jantan, dan telur. Ia juga dihubungkan dengan hari Kamis dan dengan logam timah.
long_description.en: Perun was said to be married to the Sun, but he shared his wife with his enemy Veles, since the Sun sank each night into the underworld ruled by Veles. His shrines stood on mountain tops or hills, or in sacred groves under ancient oaks, with offerings of a bull, an ox, a ram and eggs. He was also linked with Thursday and with tin.

long_description.id: Setelah masuk Kristen, Vladimir memerintahkan arca-arca Perun dirobohkan, diseret, dipukuli, lalu dibuang ke sungai; menurut satu sumber arcanya dilempar ke Sungai Dnipro dan di tempatnya dibangun Gereja Santo Basil. Gereja menggantikan pemujaan Perun dengan pemujaan Santo Elia, yang mewarisi semua sifat Perun, tetapi orang Lemko masih menganggap ungkapan "Semoga Perun menyambarmu mati" sebagai kutukan paling mengerikan. Kini Perun termasuk dewa yang paling dihormati dalam neopaganisme Slavia (rodnovery), sebagai dewa pejuang dan saingan Veles.
long_description.en: After his conversion Vladimir had the statues of Perun torn down, dragged, beaten and thrown into rivers; one source says the statue was cast into the Dnipro River and Saint Basil's Church was built on its site. The Church replaced the cult of Perun with that of Saint Elijah, who inherited all his qualities, yet the Lemkos still regard "May Perun strike you dead" as the most terrible curse. Today Perun is among the most revered gods of Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery), as a god of warriors and a rival of Veles.

literal_meaning.en: to strike, to slay

claims.quote: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Cyrillic: Перун ) is the highest god of the pantheon and the god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Perun (Перун) adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa, dewa langit, guruh, petir, badai, hujan, hukum, perang, kesuburan, dan pohon ek.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Перун) is the highest god of the pantheon and god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

claims.quote: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament ... horses and carts, and weapons (hammer, axe (Axe of Perun), and arrow).

statement.id: Atribut lain Perun adalah api, gunung, angin, bunga iris, elang, cakrawala, kuda dan kereta, serta senjata berupa palu, kapak (Kapak Perun), dan anak panah.
statement.en: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament, horses and carts, and weapons: hammer, axe (Axe of Perun) and arrow.

claims.quote: The supreme god in the Kievan Rus' during the 9th-10th centuries, Perun was first associated with weapons made of stone and later with those of metal.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa tertinggi di Rus Kiev pada abad ke-9 sampai ke-10, Perun mula-mula dikaitkan dengan senjata dari batu, kemudian dengan senjata logam.
statement.en: The supreme god in Kievan Rus in the 9th-10th centuries, Perun was first associated with stone weapons and later with metal ones.

claims.quote: To this day, the word perun in a number of Slavic languages means "thunder," or "lightning bolt".

statement.id: Hingga kini, dalam sejumlah bahasa Slavia kata perun berarti "guruh" atau "sambaran petir".
statement.en: To this day, in a number of Slavic languages the word perun means "thunder" or "lightning bolt".

claims.quote: As early as the 6th century, he was mentioned in De Bello Gothico, a historical source written by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius.

statement.id: Sejak abad ke-6 ia sudah disebut dalam De Bello Gothico, sumber sejarah karya sejarawan Romawi Timur Procopius.
statement.en: As early as the 6th century he was mentioned in De Bello Gothico, a historical source by the Eastern Roman historian Procopius.

claims.quote: In 980, when prince Vladimir the Great came to the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods in front of his palace which he soon thereafter discarded after his Christianization in 988. Perun was chief among these, represented with a silver head and a golden moustache.

statement.id: Pada tahun 980, ketika pangeran Vladimir Agung naik takhta di Kiev, ia mendirikan arca lima dewa pagan di depan istananya, yang kemudian ia singkirkan setelah masuk Kristen pada 988; Perun adalah yang utama, digambarkan berkepala perak dan berkumis emas.
statement.en: In 980, when Prince Vladimir the Great took the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods before his palace, discarding them after his Christianization in 988; Perun was chief among them, with a silver head and a golden moustache.

claims.quote: Perun is strongly correlated with the near-identical Perkūnas/Pērkons from Baltic mythology, suggesting either a common derivative of the Proto-Indo European thunder god

statement.id: Perun sangat berkaitan dengan Perkūnas/Pērkons yang hampir identik dari mitologi Baltik, yang menunjukkan asal bersama dari dewa guruh Proto-Indo-Eropa atau peminjaman.
statement.en: Perun is strongly correlated with the near-identical Perkūnas/Pērkons of Baltic mythology, suggesting a common Proto-Indo-European thunder god origin or borrowing.

claims.quote: The root *perkwu originally probably meant oak, but in Proto-Slavic this evolved into *per- meaning "to strike, to slay".

statement.id: Akar *perkwu semula mungkin berarti pohon ek, tetapi dalam bahasa Proto-Slavia berkembang menjadi *per- yang berarti "memukul, membunuh".
statement.en: The root *perkwu probably first meant oak, but in Proto-Slavic it became *per-, meaning "to strike, to slay".

claims.quote: Perun's lightning bolts were believed to be stones and stone arrows. According to folk beliefs, fulgurites, belemnites, and sometimes even the remains of prehistoric stone tools found in the ground are remains of these weapons.

statement.id: Kilat Perun dipercaya berupa batu dan anak panah batu; menurut kepercayaan rakyat, fulgurit, belemnit, dan kadang perkakas batu prasejarah yang ditemukan di tanah adalah sisa senjata itu.
statement.en: Perun's lightning bolts were believed to be stones and stone arrows; folk belief held fulgurites, belemnites and sometimes prehistoric stone tools found in the ground to be remains of these weapons.

claims.quote: The weapons of Perun protected against bad luck, evil magic, disease, and – naturally enough – lightning itself.

statement.id: Senjata Perun melindungi dari nasib buruk, sihir jahat, penyakit, dan juga dari petir itu sendiri.
statement.en: The weapons of Perun protected against bad luck, evil magic, disease and lightning itself.

claims.quote: it can also be shown that Perun was married to the Sun. He, however, shared his wife with his enemy Veles, as each night the Sun was thought of as diving behind the horizon and into the underworld, the realm of the dead over which Veles ruled.

statement.id: Perun dapat ditunjukkan menikahi Matahari, tetapi ia berbagi istri dengan musuhnya Veles, karena setiap malam Matahari dianggap terbenam ke dunia bawah, alam orang mati yang dikuasai Veles.
statement.en: Perun can be shown to have been married to the Sun, but he shared his wife with his enemy Veles, as each night the Sun was thought to dive into the underworld, the realm of the dead ruled by Veles.

claims.quote: Shrines of Perun were located either on top of mountains or hills, or in sacred groves underneath ancient oaks. These were general places of worship and sacrifices (with a bull, an ox, a ram, and eggs).

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Perun berada di puncak gunung atau bukit, atau di hutan keramat di bawah pohon ek tua; di sana dilakukan ibadah dan persembahan berupa banteng, sapi, domba jantan, dan telur.
statement.en: Perun's shrines stood on mountain tops or hills, or in sacred groves under ancient oaks, as places of worship and sacrifice (a bull, an ox, a ram and eggs).

claims.quote: In addition to the tree association, Perun had a day association (Thursday) as well as the material association (tin).

statement.id: Selain pohon, Perun juga dikaitkan dengan satu hari, yaitu Kamis (Thursday), dan dengan satu bahan, yaitu timah.
statement.en: Besides the tree, Perun was associated with a day (Thursday) and a material (tin).

claims.quote: He ordered that the statues of Perun which he himself had erected formerly, be dethroned, torn down with great dishonor and dragged through the streets as they were beaten with sticks. The idols were then cast into rivers and not permitted to land on the shore.

statement.id: Ia memerintahkan agar arca-arca Perun yang dulu didirikannya sendiri dirobohkan dengan hina dan diseret di jalan sambil dipukuli tongkat, lalu dibuang ke sungai dan tidak dibiarkan terdampar di tepi.
statement.en: He ordered the statues of Perun he had once erected to be torn down in disgrace and dragged through the streets while beaten with sticks, then cast into rivers and not allowed to land on the shore.

claims.quote: Perun is one of the most revered gods in Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery). He is considered a thunderer, the god of warriors, and a rival of Veles, also embodying spring thunderstorms that fertilize the earth.

statement.id: Perun adalah salah satu dewa yang paling dihormati dalam neopaganisme Slavia (rodnovery); ia dianggap dewa guruh, dewa para pejuang, dan saingan Veles, serta perwujudan badai musim semi yang menyuburkan bumi.
statement.en: Perun is one of the most revered gods of Slavic neopaganism (rodnovery), seen as a thunderer, god of warriors and rival of Veles, embodying spring storms that fertilize the earth.

claims.quote: The Baltic tribes had a widespread cult of the thunderer Perkunas, one of the main deities of the Baltic pantheon. With Perun, this deity also shares common attributes (amulets in the form of an axe, a fiery four-pointed symbol, oak as the main tree)
claims.locator: The cult of Perun among neighboring tribes

statement.id: Suku-suku Baltik memuja dewa guruh Perkunas, salah satu dewa utama mereka, yang memiliki atribut sama dengan Perun: jimat berbentuk kapak, simbol api berujung empat, dan pohon ek sebagai pohon utama.
statement.en: The Baltic tribes widely worshipped the thunderer Perkunas, a main Baltic deity sharing attributes with Perun: axe amulets, a fiery four-pointed symbol and the oak as chief tree.

claims.quote: Among South Slavs, a mountain plant Iris germanica is known in folklore as perunika ("Perun's plant") and sometimes also as bogisha ("god's plant"), and was believed to grow from ground that had been struck by lightning.

statement.id: Di kalangan Slavia Selatan, tanaman gunung Iris germanica dikenal dalam cerita rakyat sebagai perunika ("tanaman Perun") dan kadang bogisha ("tanaman dewa"), dan dipercaya tumbuh dari tanah yang tersambar petir.
statement.en: Among South Slavs the mountain plant Iris germanica is known in folklore as perunika ("Perun's plant") and sometimes bogisha ("god's plant"), believed to grow from ground struck by lightning.

claims.quote: The Bulgarian and Macedonian people believe that the name of the Bulgarian mountain Pirin, one of the highest mountains of the Balkan Peninsula, was named after Perun.

statement.id: Orang Bulgaria dan Makedonia percaya bahwa Pirin, salah satu gunung tertinggi di Semenanjung Balkan, dinamai menurut Perun.
statement.en: Bulgarians and Macedonians believe the Bulgarian mountain Pirin, one of the highest in the Balkan Peninsula, was named after Perun.

claims.quote: Perun. One of the principal deities in eastern and northern Slavic mythology. In pre-Christian Kyivan Rus’ this was the chief god—the god of thunder, lightning, and rain, the ruler of the heavens, and, later, the god of war.

statement.id: Perun adalah salah satu dewa utama dalam mitologi Slavia timur dan utara; di Rus Kyiv sebelum Kristen ia dewa tertinggi, dewa guruh, kilat, dan hujan, penguasa langit, dan kemudian dewa perang.
statement.en: Perun is one of the principal deities of eastern and northern Slavic mythology; in pre-Christian Kyivan Rus he was the chief god, god of thunder, lightning and rain, ruler of the heavens and later god of war.

claims.quote: In 980 a wooden statue of Perun with a silver head and golden moustache stood on Perun Hill in Kyiv. Perun's feast, celebrated with sacrifices, took place in July.

statement.id: Pada tahun 980 arca kayu Perun berkepala perak dan berkumis emas berdiri di Bukit Perun di Kyiv; hari raya Perun dirayakan dengan persembahan pada bulan Juli.
statement.en: In 980 a wooden statue of Perun with a silver head and golden moustache stood on Perun Hill in Kyiv; his feast, with sacrifices, took place in July.

claims.quote: After adopting Christianity Prince Volodymyr the Great ordered Perun's statue to be cast into the Dnipro River and on its site built Saint Basil's Church.

statement.id: Setelah memeluk Kristen, Pangeran Volodymyr (Vladimir) Agung memerintahkan arca Perun dilempar ke Sungai Dnipro dan membangun Gereja Santo Basil di tempatnya.
statement.en: After adopting Christianity, Prince Volodymyr the Great had Perun's statue cast into the Dnipro River and built Saint Basil's Church on its site.

claims.quote: The Christian church replaced the cult of Perun with the cult of Saint Elijah (feast day: 2 August, or 20 July OS), to whom all of Perun's qualities were transferred.

statement.id: Gereja Kristen menggantikan pemujaan Perun dengan pemujaan Santo Elia, yang menerima semua sifat Perun.
statement.en: The Christian church replaced the cult of Perun with that of Saint Elijah, to whom all of Perun's qualities were transferred.

claims.quote: The Lemkos still consider the expression ‘May Perun strike you dead’ as the most terrible curse.

statement.id: Orang Lemko masih menganggap ungkapan "Semoga Perun menyambarmu mati" sebagai kutukan paling mengerikan.
statement.en: The Lemkos still regard the expression "May Perun strike you dead" as the most terrible curse.

claims.quote: The author analyses Perun, a supreme Storm-God in Old-Slavic pagan religion and mythology, which is correlated to rock, thunder, lightning and rain, war and justice.

statement.id: Penulis menganalisis Perun sebagai dewa badai tertinggi dalam agama dan mitologi pagan Slavia Kuno, yang berkaitan dengan batu, guruh, kilat, hujan, perang, dan keadilan.
statement.en: The author analyses Perun as a supreme storm god of Old Slavic pagan religion and mythology, correlated with rock, thunder, lightning, rain, war and justice.

claims.quote: For more than a century, scholars of Slavic mythology have adopted the assumption connecting the German iris (Iris germanica) plant and the cult of the god Perun.

statement.id: Selama lebih dari seabad, para ahli mitologi Slavia menerima anggapan yang menghubungkan tanaman iris Jerman (Iris germanica) dengan pemujaan dewa Perun.
statement.en: For more than a century, scholars of Slavic mythology have assumed a connection between the German iris (Iris germanica) and the cult of Perun.

claims.quote: the author concludes that there are no grounds for linking the plant to the cult of Perun, the god of thunder. The motivation for the name “perunika” comes from its dominant feather-like (perasti) leaves

statement.id: Penulis menyimpulkan tidak ada dasar untuk mengaitkan tanaman itu dengan pemujaan Perun, dewa guruh; nama "perunika" berasal dari daunnya yang mirip bulu (perasti).
statement.en: The author concludes there are no grounds for linking the plant to the cult of Perun, the thunder god; the name "perunika" comes from its feather-like (perasti) leaves.

short_description.id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, oleh sebagian digolongkan sebagai peri penyendiri, yang digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut yang suka berbuat usil.
short_description.en: The leprechaun is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a solitary fairy, pictured as a little bearded man fond of mischief.

long_description.id: Leprechaun (bahasa Irlandia: leipreachán) adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), yang oleh sebagian orang digolongkan sebagai sejenis peri penyendiri. Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut bermantel dan bertopi yang suka berbuat usil; belakangan ia digambarkan sebagai pembuat sepatu yang menyimpan sepanci emas di ujung pelangi. Kata leprechaun berasal dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno luchorpán atau lupracán.
long_description.en: The leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. It is usually pictured as a small bearded man in a coat and hat who gets up to mischief; in later times it became a shoemaker with a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. The word comes from Old Irish luchorpán or lupracán.

long_description.id: Rujukan tertua tentang leprechaun terdapat dalam kisah abad pertengahan Echtra Fergus mac Léti: Fergus mac Léti, raja Ulster, tertidur di pantai dan terbangun ketika diseret ke laut oleh tiga lúchorpáin; ia menangkap mereka, dan mereka memberinya tiga permintaan agar dilepaskan. Dalam cerita rakyat, leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu dan yang gemar bercanda; manusia yang menangkapnya dapat menolak melepaskannya sampai diberi kekayaan gaib.
long_description.en: The earliest known reference to the leprechaun is in the medieval tale Echtra Fergus mac Léti: the Ulster king Fergus mac Léti dozes off on the shore and awakes to find three lúchorpáin hauling him into the waves; he captures them, and they grant him three wishes for their release. In folklore the leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who loves practical jokes; a human who catches one may refuse to free it until given supernatural wealth.

long_description.id: William Butler Yeats menggolongkan leprechaun sebagai "peri penyendiri" dan menyebut kekayaannya berasal dari guci harta yang dikubur pada masa perang. Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dibayangkan berbaju merah, bukan hijau; gambaran modern dengan topi hijau dan janggut merah adalah ciptaan yang lebih baru. Menurut artikel id, leprechaun adalah sebangsa peri jantan yang mendiami Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt, dan siapa pun yang mencuri gentong emasnya dapat meminta tiga permintaan sebagai ganti gentong itu; ia juga dikaitkan dengan perayaan Hari Santo Patrick.
long_description.en: William Butler Yeats classed the leprechaun as a "solitary fairy" and said its wealth came from treasure-crocks buried in wartime. Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green; the modern image with green hat and red beard is a later invention. According to the id article, the leprechaun is a male fairy folk dwelling in Ireland before the coming of the Celts, and whoever steals its pot of gold may claim three wishes in exchange for its return; it is also linked with Saint Patrick's Day.

statement.en: The word leprechaun descends from Old Irish luchorpán or lupracán.

claims.quote: The text contains an episode in which Fergus mac Léti, King of Ulster, falls asleep on the beach and wakes to find himself being dragged into the sea by three lúchorpáin. He captures his abductors, who grant him three wishes in exchange for release.

statement.id: Dalam Echtra Fergus mac Léti, Fergus mac Léti, raja Ulster (King of Ulster), diseret ke laut oleh tiga lúchorpáin yang lalu memberinya tiga permintaan (three wishes).
statement.en: In Echtra Fergus mac Léti, Fergus mac Léti, King of Ulster, is dragged into the sea by three lúchorpáin who grant him three wishes.

claims.quote: The leprechaun is said to be a solitary creature, whose principal occupation is making and cobbling shoes, and who enjoys practical jokes.

statement.id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri (solitary) yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu (shoes) dan gemar bercanda.
statement.en: The leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who enjoys practical jokes.

claims.quote: This is, he claims, the perfect opportunity for a human being to capture the Leprechaun, refusing to release him until the Leprechaun gives his captor supernatural wealth.

statement.id: Menurut McAnally, manusia dapat menangkap Leprechaun dan menolak melepaskannya sampai diberi kekayaan gaib (supernatural wealth).
statement.en: Per McAnally, a human can capture the Leprechaun and refuse to release him until given supernatural wealth.

claims.quote: The leprechaun has been classed as a "solitary fairy" by the writer and amateur folklorist William Butler Yeats.

statement.id: William Butler Yeats menggolongkan leprechaun sebagai peri penyendiri (solitary fairy).
statement.en: William Butler Yeats classed the leprechaun as a solitary fairy.

claims.quote: According to William Butler Yeats, the great wealth of the leprechauns comes from the "treasure-crocks, buried of old in war-time", which they have uncovered and appropriated.

statement.id: Menurut William Butler Yeats, kekayaan leprechaun berasal dari guci harta (treasure-crocks) yang dikubur pada masa perang (war-time).
statement.en: According to William Butler Yeats, leprechauns' wealth comes from treasure-crocks buried in war-time.

claims.quote: Before the 20th century, it was generally held that the leprechaun wore red, not green.

statement.id: Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dianggap berpakaian merah (red), bukan hijau (green).
statement.en: Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green.

claims.quote: Leprechaun (bahasa Irlandia: leipreachán) dalam mitologi Irlandia adalah sebangsa peri jantan yang mendiami daratan Irlandia. Bersama peri-peri lainnya, Leprechaun mendiami daratan Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt.

statement.id: Leprechaun (leipreachán) dalam mitologi Irlandia adalah peri jantan yang mendiami Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt.
statement.en: The Leprechaun (leipreachán) in Irish (Irlandia) mythology is a male fairy (peri jantan) dwelling in Ireland before the Celts (bangsa Kelt).

claims.quote: Menurut legenda, leprechaun memiliki sebuah gentong yang berisi emas. Gentong tersebut dikatakan di letakkan di ujung pelangi. Dikatakan bahwa siapapun yang berhasil mencuri gentong emas tersebut, maka sang dewa muslihat tersebut harus mengabulkan 3 permintaan jika gentongnya ingin dikembalikan.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, leprechaun punya gentong emas di ujung pelangi; pencurinya mendapat 3 permintaan sebagai ganti gentong itu.
statement.en: By legend the leprechaun has a pot of gold (gentong emas) at the rainbow's end (ujung pelangi); its thief gets 3 wishes (permintaan) for its return.

claims.quote: Pada saat perayaan Hari Hijau atau hari untuk mengingat Santo Patrick, dikatakan leprechaun akan datang kerumah seseorang.

statement.id: Pada perayaan Hari Santo Patrick (Santo Patrick), leprechaun dikatakan datang ke rumah orang.
statement.en: On Saint Patrick's Day (Santo Patrick), the leprechaun is said to visit people's homes.

claims.quote: It is stressed that the leprechaun, though some may call it fairy, is clearly to be distinguished from the Aos Sí (or the 'good people') of the fairy mounds (sidhe) and raths.

statement.id: Leprechaun dibedakan dari Aos Sí penghuni gundukan peri (fairy mounds).
statement.en: The leprechaun is distinguished from the Aos Sí of the fairy mounds.

short_description.id: Goblin adalah makhluk humanoid kecil, aneh, dan sering jahat yang menonjol dalam cerita rakyat Eropa, terkenal karena sifatnya yang usil atau iblis dan kemampuannya berubah wujud.
short_description.en: A goblin is a small, grotesque and often malevolent humanoid creature prominent in European folklore, known for its mischievous or demonic nature and ability to shapeshift.

long_description.id: Goblin adalah makhluk humanoid yang kecil, aneh rupanya, dan sering jahat, yang menonjol dalam cerita rakyat Eropa (European folklore). Ia dikenal usil atau bersifat iblis, bertubuh kecil (dalam sebagian tradisi sekitar 30 cm), berbulu atau berkulit seperti kulit samak, dan dapat berubah wujud. Goblin dipercaya tinggal di bawah tanah atau di rumah-rumah, tempat mereka melakukan apa saja dari lelucon hingga pembunuhan. Kata ini juga sering dipakai sebagai sebutan umum untuk semua makhluk peri kecil.
long_description.en: A goblin is a small, grotesque and often malevolent humanoid creature prominent in European folklore. It is known for a mischievous or demonic nature, small stature (about 30 cm in some traditions), a furry or leathery look and the power to change shape. Goblins are believed to live underground or in households, where they do anything from pranks to murder. The word is also often used as a blanket term for all small fay creatures.

long_description.id: Kata goblin masuk ke bahasa Inggris pada awal abad ke-14 dari bahasa Prancis Kuno gobelin, yang pertama tercatat pada 1195 dalam kronik L'Estoire de la guerre sainte karya rahib Ambroise; bentuk Latin Abad Pertengahannya, gobelinus, muncul sekitar 1140 dalam Historia ecclesiastica karya Orderic Vitalis untuk iblis yang diusir dari sebuah gereja di Évreux. Para sarjana mengaitkannya dengan kata Yunani kóbalos ("bajingan" atau "roh usil") atau dengan kobold, roh rumah Jermanik. Kata Wales coblyn, sejenis knocker, berasal dari gobelin melalui kata Inggris goblin.
long_description.en: The word goblin entered English in the early 14th century from Old French gobelin, whose earliest known use, in 1195, is in Ambroise's chronicle L'Estoire de la guerre sainte; its Medieval Latin form gobelinus appears around 1140 in Orderic Vitalis's Historia ecclesiastica for a demon driven out of a church at Évreux. Scholars link it to Greek kóbalos ("rogue" or "mischievous sprite") or to the Germanic household spirit kobold. The Welsh coblyn, a kind of knocker, comes from gobelin through English goblin.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Inggris dan Skotlandia, goblin sering muncul sebagai brownie, roh rumah yang baik hati yang mengerjakan tugas rumah pada malam hari asal diberi bubur atau susu; boggart dari Yorkshire adalah varian yang lebih jahat. Menurut artikel id, goblin digambarkan sebagai makhluk kecil hijau bertelinga runcing yang serakah dan cinta emas; dalam versi fantasi lain mereka makhluk buas yang tinggal di gua-gua gelap atau di bawah tanah.
long_description.en: In English and Scottish folklore goblins often appear as brownies, kindly house spirits doing chores at night if given porridge or milk; the boggarts of Yorkshire are a more malevolent variant. According to the id article, goblins are pictured as small green beings with pointed ears who are greedy and love gold; in other fantasy versions they are savage creatures living in dark caves or underground.

short_description.id: Vamana (Wamana) adalah awatara kelima Dewa Wisnu dalam agama Hindu, brahmana kerdil yang merebut kembali tiga dunia dari raja daitya Mahabali dengan tiga langkah.
short_description.en: Vamana is the fifth avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, a dwarf brahmin who won back the three worlds from the daitya king Mahabali with three steps.

long_description.id: Vamana (Sanskerta वामन, "kerdil"), juga dikenal sebagai Trivikrama ("tiga langkah"), Urukrama, dan Upendra, adalah awatara dewa Hindu Wisnu (Vishnu). Ia awatara kelima Wisnu dan Dashavatara pertama pada Treta Yuga, sesudah Narasimha. Pertama disebut dalam Weda, Vamana paling sering dikaitkan dalam epos dan Purana Hindu dengan kisah merebut kembali tiga dunia (Trailokya) dari raja daitya Mahabali dengan tiga langkah, untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmos dan mendorong Mahabali ke dunia bawah. Ia yang termuda di antara para aditya, putra Aditi dan resi Kashyapa.
long_description.en: Vamana (Sanskrit वामन, "dwarf"), also called Trivikrama ("three steps"), Urukrama and Upendra, is an avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu. Coming after Narasimha, he is the fifth of Vishnu's avatars and the first Dashavatara of the Treta Yuga. Already named in the Vedas, Vamana is best known in the Hindu epics and Puranas to the tale of reclaiming the three worlds (Trailokya) from the daitya king Mahabali with three steps, restoring the cosmic order and pushing Mahabali into the netherworld. He is the youngest of the adityas, sons of Aditi and the sage Kashyapa.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel id, Wamana dilukiskan sebagai brahmana berraga anak kecil yang membawa kamandalu dan payung. Kisahnya dimuat dalam Bhagawatapurana, Brahmapurana, Padmapurana, Wamanapurana, dan Mahapurana lain: Raja Bali mengundang semua brahmana untuk diberi hadiah, dan meski dinasihati Sukracarya, ia mengabulkan permintaan brahmana kecil itu atas tanah seluas tiga langkah. Brahmana itu lalu membesar; langkah pertamanya menginjak swarga, langkah kedua bumi, dan untuk langkah ketiga Bali menyerahkan kepalanya. Terkesan oleh kedermawanannya, Wamana memberinya gelar Mahabali dan berjanji ia kelak menjadi Indra pada Manwantara berikutnya.
long_description.en: According to the id article, Wamana is pictured as a brahmin in a child's body carrying a kamandalu and an umbrella. His story is in the Bhagawatapurana, Brahmapurana, Padmapurana, Wamanapurana and other Mahapuranas: King Bali invited all brahmins to receive gifts, and despite Sukracarya's warning he granted the little brahmin's request for land three strides wide. The brahmin then grew; his first stride covered heaven (swarga), the second the earth, and for the third Bali offered his head. Impressed by his generosity, Wamana gave him the title Mahabali and promised he would become Indra in the next Manwantara.

long_description.id: Kisah Wamana dan Raja Bali diperingati setiap tahun dalam perayaan Onam di Kerala, India, tempat juga terdapat kuil khusus untuknya; kuil Wamana lain antara lain ada di Kanchipuram, dekat kuil Kamakshi.
long_description.en: The story of Wamana and King Bali is commemorated every year at the Onam festival in Kerala, India, where there is also a temple devoted to him; other Wamana temples include one in Kanchipuram near the Kamakshi temple.
