short_description.id: Rusalka adalah makhluk perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Slavia yang erat dengan air dan sering memusuhi manusia, biasanya arwah perempuan muda yang mati tenggelam.
short_description.en: The rusalka is a female being of Slavic folklore, closely tied to water and often hostile to people, usually the spirit of a young woman who drowned.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Slavia, rusalka adalah sosok perempuan yang sering berbuat jahat kepada manusia dan biasanya dikaitkan dengan air. Padanannya di Eropa lain antara lain Melusine dari Prancis dan Nixie dari dunia Jermanik. Di Rusia utara ia punya banyak sebutan seperti vodyanitsa, sedangkan di Ukraina ia disebut mavka.
long_description.en: In Slavic folklore the rusalka is a female figure, frequently harmful to people and usually associated with water. Her counterparts elsewhere in Europe include the French Melusine and the Germanic Nixie. In northern Russia she had many names, such as vodyanitsa, while in Ukraine she was called a mavka.

long_description.id: Menurut kebanyakan cerita, arwah perempuan muda yang mati di atau dekat sungai atau danau kembali menghantui perairan itu. Ia tidak selalu jahat dan dapat beristirahat dengan tenang bila kematiannya dibalas, tetapi tujuan utamanya memikat pemuda dengan rupa atau suaranya, lalu menjerat kaki mereka dengan rambut panjangnya dan menenggelamkan mereka. Dalam sebagian cerita, korban dibunuh dengan digelitik sampai mati atau dipaksa ikut tarian yang liar. Rambutnya selalu terurai dan bisa pirang, hitam, kehijauan, atau hijau sama sekali.
long_description.en: In most stories the soul of a young woman who died in or near a river or lake returns to haunt those waters. She is not always malevolent and may rest in peace once her death is avenged, but her chief aim is to lure young men with her looks or voice, bind their feet with her long hair and drag them under. In some tales victims were tickled to death or forced to join a frenzied dance. Her hair is always loose and may be fair, black, greenish or entirely green.

long_description.id: Gambaran rusalka berbeda menurut daerah. Di Ukraina ia lebih sering dikaitkan dengan air, di Belarus dengan hutan dan ladang; biasanya ia digambarkan sebagai gadis cantik tanpa busana, tetapi di beberapa tempat sebagai makhluk buruk rupa dan berbulu. Rusalka dipercaya paling berbahaya pada Pekan Rusalka di awal Juni, ketika mereka keluar dari air untuk berayun di dahan pohon birch dan willow pada malam hari, sehingga berenang saat itu dilarang keras.
long_description.en: Images of the rusalka varied by region. In Ukraine she was more often tied to water, in Belarus to forest and field; she was usually a beautiful naked maiden, but in some areas a hideous, hairy creature. Rusalki were thought most dangerous during Rusalka Week in early June, when they left the water to swing on birch and willow branches at night, so swimming then was strictly forbidden.

long_description.id: Namanya berasal dari rusalija, yang masuk ke bahasa Slavia lewat bahasa Yunani Bizantium dari kata Latin Rosālia, nama untuk Pentakosta dan hari-hari di sekitarnya. Menurut Vladimir Propp, bangsa Slavia pagan semula mengaitkan rusalka dengan kesuburan: mereka keluar dari air pada musim semi untuk membawa kelembapan ke ladang dan tidak dianggap jahat sebelum abad ke-19. Dalam versi abad ke-19, rusalka menjadi makhluk mati yang gelisah dan berbahaya.
long_description.en: Her name comes from rusalija, which reached the Slavic languages through Byzantine Greek from the Latin Rosālia, a name for Pentecost and the days around it. According to Vladimir Propp, pagan Slavs first linked rusalki with fertility: they rose from the water in spring to bring moisture to the fields and were not thought evil before the 19th century. In 19th-century versions the rusalka became a restless, dangerous dead being.

short_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah satu atau lebih binatang pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan, Prancis, pada 1764–1767, yang identitasnya masih diperdebatkan sampai kini.
short_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan was one or more man-eating animals that terrorised Gévaudan, France, in 1764–1767, whose identity is still debated.

long_description.id: Binatang Gévaudan adalah nama untuk satu atau lebih pemangsa manusia yang meneror Gévaudan di Pegunungan Margeride, Prancis, sejak 30 Juni 1764; korban resmi pertamanya Jeanne Boulet, 14 tahun. Saksi menggambarkannya cokelat kemerahan bergaris gelap, sebesar anak sapi, berekor panjang berjumbai, dan bergerak seolah terbang; artikel bahasa Jepang menyebut ia sering menyasar kepala korban. Sebuah kajian tahun 1987 menghitung 210 serangan dan 113 korban tewas.
long_description.en: The Beast of Gévaudan is the name for one or more man-eaters that terrorised Gévaudan in the Margeride Mountains of France from 30 June 1764; its first official victim was 14-year-old Jeanne Boulet. Witnesses described it as russet with dark stripes, calf-sized, with a long tufted tail, moving as if flying; the Japanese article says it often went for the head. A 1987 study counted 210 attacks and 113 deaths.

long_description.id: Kerajaan Prancis mengerahkan bangsawan, tentara, dan pemburu kerajaan untuk memburunya, dan beberapa binatang dibunuh sebelum serangan berhenti, meski saksi menyebut ia berkali-kali terluka tanpa mati. Identitasnya, dubuk, serigala, anjing besar, atau anjing-serigala, masih diperdebatkan, dan sumber berbeda soal akhir masa serangan (1767 atau 1770).
long_description.en: The Kingdom of France sent nobles, soldiers and royal huntsmen after it, and several animals were killed before the attacks ceased, though witnesses said it was wounded many times without dying. Its identity, hyena, wolf, big dog or wolfdog, is still debated, and sources differ on when the attacks ended (1767 or 1770).

short_description.id: Incubus adalah iblis lelaki dalam cerita rakyat yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya, menguras kesehatannya, dan konon menjadi ayah Merlin.
short_description.en: The incubus is a male demon of folklore who appears in women's dreams to seduce them, drains their health and is said to have fathered Merlin.

long_description.id: Incubus, dari bahasa Latin incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", adalah iblis lelaki yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya; hubungan berulang dengannya dapat melahirkan kambion tetapi merusak kesehatan bahkan membunuh. Ia konon dapat menyusup sebagai kelelawar, dan penyihir Merlin dikatakan anaknya. Kepercayaan ini didorong mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur; kini ia sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tampan.
long_description.en: The incubus, from Latin incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', is a male demon who appears in women's dreams to seduce them; repeated unions can produce a cambion but ruin health or kill. He is said to slip in as a bat, and the magician Merlin was called his son. The belief was driven by wet dreams and sleep paralysis; today he is often drawn as a handsome man.

long_description.id: Jejaknya sudah ada di Mesopotamia: Daftar Raja Sumeria sekitar 2400 SM menyebut Lilu, perayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah Gilgamesh, dan Idlu lili mendatangi perempuan pada malam hari. Agustinus mencatat bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi.
long_description.en: Its roots reach Mesopotamia: the Sumerian King List of c. 2400 BC names Lilu, seducer of sleeping women, as Gilgamesh's father, and Idlu lili visits women by night. Augustine records that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi.

literal_meaning.en: what lies on one while asleep

who.en: A male dream-seducing demon.

origin.en: Folklore with Mesopotamian roots.

note.en: A similar Mesopotamian demon.

claims.quote: An incubus ... incubi) is a male demon who is described in various folklore as appearing in the dreams of female humans in order to seduce them.

statement.id: Incubus (jamak: incubi) adalah iblis lelaki yang dalam berbagai cerita rakyat muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayu mereka.
statement.en: An incubus (plural incubi) is a male demon said in various folklore to appear in women's dreams to seduce them.

claims.quote: Pembentukan dan kelestarian hubungan semacam itu memungkinkan lahirnya anak hibrida yang dikenal sebagai kambion

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Indonesia, hubungan yang berulang dengan incubus dapat melahirkan anak hibrida yang disebut kambion.
statement.en: According to the Indonesian article, a lasting relationship with an incubus can produce a hybrid child called a cambion.

claims.quote: In modern representations, an incubus is often depicted as a handsome man seducer or charming, rather than as demonic or frightening, to attract people instead of repulsing them. The female counterpart of the incubus is the succubus.

statement.id: Dalam gambaran modern, incubus sering tampil sebagai lelaki tampan penggoda, bukan iblis menakutkan; padanan perempuannya adalah succubus.
statement.en: In modern depictions the incubus is often a handsome seducer rather than a frightening demon; his female counterpart is the succubus.

claims.quote: Historically, folkloric belief in incubi was motivated by distressing nighttime phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

statement.id: Kepercayaan pada incubi didorong gejala malam yang meresahkan, terutama mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur.
statement.en: Belief in incubi was driven by distressing night phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

claims.quote: Legendary magician Merlin was said to have been fathered by an incubus. Walter Stephens writes in his book Demon Lovers that some traditions hold that repeated sexual activity with an incubus or succubus may result in the deterioration of health, an impaired mental state, or even death.

statement.id: Penyihir legendaris Merlin konon anak incubus, dan Walter Stephens dalam Demon Lovers menulis bahwa menurut sebagian tradisi hubungan berulang dengan incubus atau succubus dapat merusak kesehatan, jiwa, bahkan menyebabkan kematian.
statement.en: The legendary magician Merlin was said to be an incubus's son, and Walter Stephens writes in Demon Lovers that some traditions hold repeated relations with an incubus or succubus may ruin health and mind or even kill.

claims.quote: The Late Latin word incubus ("a nightmare induced by a demon") is derived from Latin incubō ("nightmare, what lies down on one whilst one sleeps") and further from incubāre ("to lie upon, to hatch").

statement.id: Kata Latin Akhir incubus, "mimpi buruk yang ditimbulkan iblis", berasal dari incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", dan incubāre, "berbaring di atas".
statement.en: The Late Latin incubus, 'a demon-induced nightmare', comes from incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', and incubāre, 'to lie upon'.

claims.quote: One of the earliest evident mentions of a demon sharing qualities with an incubus comes from Mesopotamia on the Sumerian King List, circa 2400 BC, where the hero Gilgamesh's father is listed as Lilu. Lilu is described as "disturbing" and "seducing" women in their sleep

statement.id: Salah satu sebutan tertua iblis mirip incubus ada dalam Daftar Raja Sumeria dari Mesopotamia sekitar 2400 SM, yang mencantumkan Lilu, iblis yang mengganggu dan merayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah pahlawan Gilgamesh.
statement.en: One of the earliest mentions of an incubus-like demon is on the Sumerian King List from Mesopotamia, c. 2400 BC, naming Lilu, who 'disturbs' and 'seduces' sleeping women, as the father of the hero Gilgamesh.

claims.quote: Two other corresponding demons also appear in Mesopotamian accounts: Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, a male counterpart to Ardat lili who visits women by night and begets from them.

statement.id: Catatan Mesopotamia juga menyebut Ardat lili yang mendatangi lelaki pada malam hari dan Idlu lili, padanan lelakinya, yang mendatangi perempuan dan membuat mereka hamil.
statement.en: Mesopotamian accounts also name Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, her male counterpart, who visits women by night and begets on them.

claims.quote: 古くはアウグスティヌス『神の国』第15巻23章に、森の精霊シルウァーヌスやファウヌスはインキュバスと呼ばれ、しばしば女性を襲って欲望を満たす、という当時の俗信についての記述がある。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, Agustinus dalam De Civitate Dei buku 15 bab 23 mencatat kepercayaan masa itu bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi dan sering menyerang perempuan.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article, Augustine in The City of God (book 15, chapter 23) records the belief of his time that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi and often assailed women.

claims.quote: どちらも、自分と性交したくてたまらなくさせるために、襲われる人の理想の異性像で、服を着ず下半身は裸で現れる。そのため、その誘惑を拒否することは非常に困難だった。人の形態をとるだけでなく、標的となった人間の寝室には蝙蝠に化けて侵入するともされている。

statement.id: Incubus dan succubus muncul sebagai sosok lawan jenis idaman korbannya sehingga godaannya sangat sulit ditolak, dan selain berwujud manusia mereka konon menyusup ke kamar korban dalam wujud kelelawar.
statement.en: Incubi and succubi appear as their victim's ideal partner, so their temptation is very hard to refuse, and besides human form they are said to slip into the victim's bedroom as bats.

claims.quote: Heqet (Egyptian ḥqt, also ḥqtyt "Heqtit"), sometimes spelled Heket, is an Egyptian goddess of fertility, identified with Hathor, represented in the form of a frog.

claims.quote:
To the Egyptians, the frog was an ancient symbol of fertility, related to the annual flooding of the Nile. 
Heqet was originally the female counterpart of Khnum, or the wife of Khnum, and eventually she also became the mother of Heru-ur.
It has been proposed that her name is the origin of the name of Hecate, the Greek goddess of witchcraft.

Early frog statuettes are often thought to be depictions of her.

short_description.id: Pangu adalah tokoh penciptaan purba dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang memisahkan langit dan bumi.
short_description.en: Pangu is a primordial creation figure in Chinese mythology who separates heaven from earth.

long_description.id: Pangu (盤古, juga ditulis Pan Gu, Peng Gu, atau P'an Ku) adalah makhluk purba dan tokoh penciptaan dalam mitologi Tiongkok dan Taoisme. Menurut legenda, Pangu memisahkan langit dan bumi, dan tubuhnya kemudian menjadi bentang alam seperti gunung dan aliran air. Werner menyebutnya tokoh paling menonjol dalam kosmogoni Tiongkok, yang memahat alam semesta dari Kekacauan. Penulis paling awal yang diketahui mencatat mitos ini diyakini adalah Xu Zheng pada periode Tiga Kerajaan.
long_description.en: Pangu (盤古; also Pan Gu, Peng Gu or P'an Ku) is an ancient being at the origin of Chinese creation stories, found in Chinese mythology and in Taoism. Legend holds that he pulled heaven and earth apart and that his body then turned into landforms such as mountains and rivers. Werner ranks him as the foremost figure of Chinese cosmogony, the one who carved the universe out of Chaos. The earliest writer known to have set the myth down is thought to be Xu Zheng, in the Three Kingdoms period.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah telur kosmik, alam semesta mula-mula tanpa bentuk dan menyatu menjadi telur selama sekitar 18.000 tahun; yin dan yang di dalamnya menjadi seimbang, lalu Pangu muncul. Menurut Werner, 'P'an' berarti 'cangkang telur'. Sebagian versi menyebut Pangu dibantu Empat Makhluk Bertuah. Menurut satu sumber ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai raksasa berbulu bertanduk, sedangkan Werner menggambarkannya sebagai pria kerdil bertanduk dua yang memegang palu dan pahat.
long_description.en: In the cosmic-egg story the universe begins as a featureless void that gathers into an egg over roughly 18,000 years; the yin and yang inside balance out and Pangu comes forth. Werner explains 'P'an' as 'the shell of an egg'. Some tellings have the Four Auspicious Beasts help him. One source says he is usually shown as a hairy, horned giant, while Werner pictures a dwarfish man with two horns holding a hammer and chisel.

long_description.id: Menurut Werner, pekerjaan Pangu memakan delapan belas ribu tahun, dan ia bertambah tinggi setiap hari sampai wafat. Setelah ia wafat, napasnya menjadi angin dan awan, suaranya guntur, dan matanya matahari dan bulan; dalam catatan Werner kepalanya menjadi gunung dan darahnya sungai. Werner menyatakan kisah ini berasal dari Tao dan bahwa versi umat Buddha adalah adaptasi belakangan, sedangkan legenda lain menyebut Pangu berkepala naga dan bertubuh ular.
long_description.en: By Werner's account Pangu's labour lasted eighteen thousand years, and he kept growing taller until he died. After his death his breath turned into wind and cloud, his voice into thunder, and his eyes into the sun and moon; in Werner's version his head became the mountains and his blood the rivers. Werner says the story is of Taoist origin and that the Buddhists' version is a later adaptation, while other legends give him a dragon's head and a serpent's body.

literal_meaning.id: 'P'an' berarti 'cangkang telur' dan 'Ku' berarti 'mengamankan' atau 'padat' (menurut Werner)
literal_meaning.en: 'P'an' means 'the shell of an egg' and 'Ku' 'to secure' or 'solid' (according to Werner)

description.id: Werner menyebut umat Buddha memberi kisah yang agak berbeda tentang P'an Ku, yang merupakan adaptasi belakangan dari mitos Tao.
description.en: Werner says the Buddhists gave a somewhat different account of P'an Ku, a late adaptation of the Taoist myth.

description.id: Dalam legenda lain, P'an Ku berkepala naga dan bertubuh ular.
description.en: In other legends P'an Ku has the head of a dragon and the body of a serpent.

claims.quote:
Pangu or Pan Gu (also sometimes spelled Peng Gu and P’an-ku)
(Chinese: 盤古; pinyin: Pángǔ ; PAN-koo) is a primordial being and creation figure in Chinese mythology and in Taoism. According to legend, Pangu separated heaven and earth, and his body later became geographic features such as mountains and flowing water.

statement.id: Pangu adalah makhluk purba dan tokoh penciptaan dalam mitologi Tiongkok dan Taoisme; menurut legenda ia memisahkan langit dan bumi.
statement.en: Pangu is a primordial being and creation figure in Chinese mythology and Taoism; according to legend he separated heaven and earth.

claims.quote: The earliest known writer to record the myth of Pangu is believed to have been Xu Zheng during the Three Kingdoms period. However, his name was found in a tomb predating the Three Kingdoms period.

statement.id: Xu Zheng dianggap sebagai penulis awal yang mencatat mitos Pangu, pada periode Tiga Kerajaan.
statement.en: Xu Zheng is regarded as an early writer who recorded the Pangu myth, during the Three Kingdoms period.

claims.quote: In the beginning, there was nothing and the universe was in a featureless, formless primordial state. This primordial state coalesced into a cosmic egg over the course of about 18,000 years. Within it, the perfectly opposed principles of yin and yang became balanced and Pangu emerged (or woke up) from the egg. Pangu inside the cosmic egg symbolizes Taiji.

statement.id: Dalam kisah telur kosmis, Pangu muncul setelah yin dan yang mencapai keseimbangan.
statement.en: In the cosmic-egg tale, Pangu emerges once yin and yang reach balance.

claims.quote: Pangu inside the cosmic egg symbolizes Taiji. Pangu is usually depicted as a primitive, hairy giant with horns on his head.

statement.id: Pangu lazim digambarkan sebagai raksasa berbulu dengan tanduk di kepala.
statement.en: Depictions commonly present Pangu as a hairy giant bearing horns.

claims.quote: In some versions of the story, Pangu is aided in this task by the Four Auspicious Beasts (四靈獸). There are many different legends about Pangu's  creation of the world, with some saying that this task took 18,000 years, while others say that he lived for millions of years.

statement.id: Sebagian versi menyebut Pangu dibantu Empat Makhluk Bertuah dalam penciptaan dunia.
statement.en: Some versions say Pangu is aided by the Four Auspicious Beasts in creating the world.

claims.quote: When Pangu died, his breath became the wind, mist and clouds; his voice, thunder; his left eye, the Sun; his right eye, the Moon; his head, the mountains and extremes of the world; his blood, rivers; his muscles, fertile land; his facial hair, the stars and Milky Way; his fur, bushes and forests; his bones, valuable minerals; his bone marrow, precious jewels; his sweat, rain; and the fle

statement.id: Sesudah kematiannya, napas menjadi angin dan awan, suara menjadi guntur, dan mata menjadi matahari serta bulan.
statement.en: After his death, his breath becomes wind and clouds, his voice becomes thunder, and his eyes become sun and moon.

claims.quote: The most conspicuous figure in Chinese cosmogony is P'an Ku. He it was who chiselled the universe out of Chaos.
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Fashioner of the Universe"

statement.id: Werner menyebut P'an Ku (Pangu) sebagai tokoh paling menonjol dalam kosmogoni Tiongkok, yang memahat alam semesta dari Kekacauan.
statement.en: Werner calls P'an Ku (Pangu) the most conspicuous figure in Chinese cosmogony, the one who chiselled the universe out of Chaos.

claims.quote: 'P'an' means 'the shell of an egg,' and 'Ku' 'to secure,' 'solid,' referring to P'an Ku being hatched from out of Chaos
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Fashioner of the Universe"

statement.id: Menurut Werner, 'P'an' berarti 'cangkang telur' dan 'Ku' berarti 'mengamankan' atau 'padat', merujuk pada P'an Ku yang menetas dari Kekacauan.
statement.en: According to Werner, 'P'an' means 'the shell of an egg' and 'Ku' 'to secure' or 'solid', referring to P'an Ku being hatched from out of Chaos.

claims.quote: P'an Ku is pictured as a man of dwarfish stature clothed in bearskin, or merely in leaves or with an apron of leaves. He has two horns on his head. In his right hand he holds a hammer and in his left a chisel (sometimes these are reversed)
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Fashioner of the Universe"

statement.id: Menurut Werner, P'an Ku digambarkan sebagai pria bertubuh kerdil berpakaian kulit beruang atau daun, bertanduk dua, memegang palu di tangan kanan dan pahat di tangan kiri (kadang terbalik).
statement.en: According to Werner, P'an Ku is pictured as a dwarfish man clothed in bearskin or leaves, with two horns, holding a hammer in his right hand and a chisel in his left (sometimes reversed).

claims.quote: His task occupied eighteen thousand years, during which he formed the sun, moon, and stars, the heavens and the earth, himself increasing in stature day by day, being daily six feet taller than the day before, until, his labours ended, he died that his works might live.
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Fashioner of the Universe"

statement.id: Menurut Werner, tugas P'an Ku memakan delapan belas ribu tahun; ia membentuk matahari, bulan, bintang, langit, dan bumi sambil bertambah tinggi enam kaki setiap hari, lalu wafat agar karyanya hidup.
statement.en: According to Werner, P'an Ku's task occupied eighteen thousand years, during which he formed the sun, moon, stars, heavens and earth, growing six feet taller each day until he died so that his works might live.

claims.quote: His head became the mountains, his breath the wind and clouds, his voice the thunder, his limbs the four quarters of the earth, his blood the rivers, his flesh the soil, his beard the constellations
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Fashioner of the Universe"

statement.id: Dalam penuturan Werner, kepala P'an Ku menjadi gunung, napasnya angin dan awan, suaranya guntur, anggota tubuhnya empat penjuru bumi, darahnya sungai, dagingnya tanah, dan jenggotnya rasi bintang.
statement.en: In Werner's account, P'an Ku's head became the mountains, his breath the wind and clouds, his voice thunder, his limbs the four quarters of the earth, his blood the rivers, his flesh the soil and his beard the constellations.

claims.quote: This account of P'an Ku and his achievements is of Taoist origin. The Buddhists have given a somewhat different account of him, which is a late adaptation from the Taoist myth

statement.id: Werner menyatakan bahwa kisah P'an Ku ini berasal dari Tao, sedangkan umat Buddha memberi versi yang agak berbeda sebagai adaptasi belakangan dari mitos Tao.
statement.en: Werner states that this account of P'an Ku is of Taoist origin, while the Buddhists gave a somewhat different account that is a late adaptation of the Taoist myth.

claims.quote: Other legends recount that P'an Ku had the head of a dragon and the body of a serpent; and that by breathing he caused the wind
claims.locator: Chapter III, "The Sun and the Moon"

statement.id: Menurut Werner, legenda lain menyebut P'an Ku berkepala naga dan bertubuh ular, dan napasnya menimbulkan angin.
statement.en: According to Werner, other legends say P'an Ku had the head of a dragon and the body of a serpent, and that his breathing caused the wind.

long_description.en: The manticore also appears in medieval bestiaries. The quoted account of Ctesias gives it three rows of teeth, human ears, and light-blue eyes. That account depicts a scorpion-like tail with a long sting. Pausanias writes that he is inclined to think the reported creature is a tiger. The manticore is believed to inhabit lonely places outside communities.

short_description.id: Tengu adalah yōkai dalam tradisi Jepang yang diasosiasikan dengan hutan pegunungan dan memiliki wujud manusia berciri burung.
short_description.en: Tengu are yōkai of Japanese tradition associated with mountain forests and depicted with human and birdlike features.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Jepang, tengu ditempatkan di hutan pegunungan. Gambaran yang umum menunjukkan tubuh menyerupai manusia dan sayap. Karasu Tengu berkepala burung dengan paruh, sedangkan Ko no ha Tengu berwajah manusia dengan hidung sangat panjang.
long_description.en: In Japanese folk belief, tengu inhabit mountain woodlands. Common depictions give them humanlike bodies and wings. Karasu Tengu have bird heads and beaks, while Ko no ha Tengu have human faces with very long noses.

long_description.id: Kisah tengu telah berubah dari masa ke masa. Cerita lama menggambarkan mereka sebagai musuh agama Buddha yang menipu pendeta. Mereka juga dikisahkan memiliki kekuatan luar biasa, dapat terbang, berubah bentuk, dan merasuki manusia. Meski sering digambarkan berbahaya, ada pula kisah tentang tengu yang melindungi orang atau kuil.
long_description.en: Tengu stories have changed over time. Older tales portray them as enemies of Buddhism who deceive priests. They are also credited with great strength, flight, changing shape, and possessing people. Although often depicted as dangerous, some accounts describe tengu protecting people or temples.

long_description.id: Ia sering berupa elang bermumi atau kepala elang yang muncul dari bukit. Amduat menggambarkannya berdiri di atas ular di antara dua sayap. Kitab Orang Mati menyebutnya membuat mangkuk perak. Sumber pendamping menempatkan Sokar sebagai penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah.
long_description.en: He is often a mummified hawk or a hawk’s head emerging from a mound. The Amduat shows him standing on a serpent between two wings. The Book of the Dead says he fashions silver bowls. The accompanying source places Sokar as guardian of the underworld entrance.

short_description.id: Rå adalah roh penjaga tempat atau bentang alam tertentu dalam cerita rakyat Skandinavia dan Sami, yang bisa membawa untung atau sial bagi manusia.
short_description.en: A rå is a spirit that keeps a particular place or landform in Scandinavian and Sami folklore, able to bring good or bad luck to people.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skandinavia, rå (jamak rår), kependekan dari rådare ("penguasa"), dari kata råda ("memerintah, menasihati") dan Nordik Kuno ráða, adalah roh penjaga suatu tempat atau bentang alam. Rå dikenal dalam budaya Nordik maupun Sami, tempat ia disebut radie. Manusia perlu menjaga hubungan baik dengannya, karena ia menguasai kekuatan alam dan hewan di bawah asuhannya serta dapat membawa untung atau sial bagi siapa pun yang mengganggu wilayahnya.
long_description.en: In Scandinavian folklore a rå (plural rår), short for rådare ('ruler'), from råda ('to rule, to advise') and Old Norse ráða, is the keeper of a particular place or landform. It is known in Nordic and Sami culture alike, the Sami calling it radie. People had to keep on good terms with it, since it ruled the natural forces and animals in its care and could bring good or bad luck to anyone meddling with its domain.

long_description.id: Rår dibedakan menurut wilayah alam yang dijaganya, seperti skogsrå atau hulder untuk hutan, sjörå untuk air tawar, havsrå untuk air asin, dan bergsrå untuk gunung. Menurut kepercayaan lama, setiap benda, hewan, dan tumbuhan punya rå pelindungnya sendiri, dan rå juga bisa menjaga tempat dan benda milik manusia, seperti skeppsrået (rå kapal) dan gruvrået (rå tambang). Rår dapat tampil berwujud hewan atau manusia; skogsrå dan bergsrå biasanya digambarkan perempuan.
long_description.en: Rår are distinguished by the sphere of nature they keep, such as the skogsrå or hulder of the forest, the sjörå of fresh water, the havsrå of salt water and the bergsrå of mountains. In old belief every object, animal and plant had its own protecting rå, and a rå might also oversee human places and things, such as the skeppsrået (ship's rå) and gruvrået (mine's rå). Rår may appear as animals or as men or women; the skogsrå and bergsrå are usually described as female.

short_description.id: Medusa adalah sosok berambut ular dalam mitologi Yunani yang berkuasa mengubah siapa pun yang memandangnya menjadi batu.
short_description.en: Medusa is a snake-haired figure from Greek mythology capable of turning anyone who beholds her into stone.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, Medusa adalah salah satu dari tiga Gorgon dan satu-satunya yang berstatus fana di antara kedua saudarinya yang abadi, Stheno dan Euryale. Menurut penyair awal seperti Hesiodos dalam Theogonia, ketiga saudari tersebut merupakan putri dari dewa laut Phorcys dan Ceto yang tinggal di seberang samudra luas di tepi dunia dekat Hesperides.
long_description.en: In Greek mythology, Medusa is one of three Gorgons and the only mortal sister alongside her immortal siblings, Stheno and Euryale. According to early poets like Hesiod in the Theogony, the sisters were daughters of sea deities Phorcys and Ceto living beyond Oceanus at the world's edge by the Hesperides.

long_description.id: Terdapat perbedaan penuturan mengenai asal-usul wujud Medusa. Penyair awal menggambarkannya sebagai monster sejak lahir bersama saudari-saudarinya. Namun penulis kemudian, seperti penyair Romawi Ovidius, menuturkan bahwa Medusa awalnya adalah gadis cantik berambut indah yang dinodai oleh Neptunus di kuil Minerva, lalu Minerva menghukumnya dengan mengubah rambut indahnya menjadi ular.
long_description.en: Divergent accounts exist regarding Medusa's origin. Earlier poets depicted her as a monster from birth alongside her sisters. Later writers like Roman poet Ovid relate that she was initially a maiden with lovely hair violated by Neptune in Minerva's shrine, after which Minerva punished her by transforming her hair into snakes.

long_description.id: Kisah kematian Medusa dicatat dalam Theogonia karya Hesiodos, saat pahlawan Perseus memenggal kepalanya dengan bantuan Hermes dan Athena. Dari lehernya yang terpenggal kemudian lahir kuda bersayap Pegasus dan ksatria Chrysaor yang merupakan keturunannya bersama Poseidon.
long_description.en: Medusa's death is recounted in Hesiod's Theogony, where hero Perseus decapitated her with assistance from Hermes and Athena. From her severed neck sprang winged horse Pegasus and warrior Chrysaor, fathered by Poseidon.

long_description.id: Di antara tiga Gorgon, Medusa adalah yang fana dan paling sering digambarkan dalam seni dan sastra Yunani Kuno [medusa-c01, medusa-c15, medusa-c16]. Medusa awalnya perawan cantik pendeta kuil Athena sebelum dikutuk [medusa-c11], dan kepalanya diabadikan dalam motif pelindung Gorgoneion [medusa-c08, medusa-c14].
long_description.en: Among the three Gorgons, Medusa was mortal and most commonly depicted in Greek art and literature [medusa-c01, medusa-c15, medusa-c16]. Medusa was originally a lovely priestess in Athena temple before the curse [medusa-c11], and her head was preserved in Gorgoneion motifs [medusa-c08, medusa-c14].

cultural_context.id: Nama Medusa berakar dari kata kerja Yunani kuno yang berarti menjaga atau melindungi, berkaitan erat dengan sifat penolak bala dari motif wajah Gorgon yang dikenal sebagai Gorgoneion dalam seni Yunani kuno.
cultural_context.en: The name Medusa derives from the ancient Greek verb meaning to guard or protect, closely fitting the apotropaic qualities of the Gorgon face known as the Gorgoneion in ancient Greek art.

literal_meaning.en: to guard or protect

short_description.id: Sun Wukong, si Raja Kera, adalah tokoh novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West: kera yang lahir dari batu, belajar kesaktian dan keabadian, memberontak melawan surga, lalu mengawal biksu Tang Sanzang dalam perjalanan mengambil sutra.
short_description.en: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, is a character of the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West: a monkey born from a stone who learns magic and immortality, rebels against heaven, and then escorts the monk Tang Sanzang on his journey to fetch scriptures.

long_description.id: Sun Wukong adalah tokoh sastra: ia salah satu tokoh utama novel Journey to the West, yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en. Ia disebut tokoh sastra sekaligus keagamaan; julukan yang paling dikenal adalah Raja Kera.
long_description.en: Sun Wukong is a literary character: he is one of the main characters of Journey to the West, a novel that appeared in the 16th century under the Ming dynasty and is credited to Wu Cheng'en. Both a literary and a religious figure by description, he is best known by the nickname Monkey King.

long_description.id: Menurut teks novel, ia lahir dari telur batu di Gunung Bunga dan Buah, lalu diangkat menjadi raja para kera dan tinggal di Gua Tirai Air. Setelah dinamai Sun Wukong oleh gurunya, ia mempelajari 72 perubahan wujud dan salto awan yang menempuh seratus delapan ribu li sekali lompat.
long_description.en: According to the novel he is born from a stone egg on Flower Fruit Mountain and becomes king of the monkeys, living in the Water Curtain Cave. After his teacher names him Sun Wukong he learns the 72 transformations and a cloud somersault that covers 108,000 li in one leap.

long_description.id: Ia memperoleh tongkat Ruyi Jingu Bang, diberi jabatan pengurus kuda dan penjaga kebun persik di surga, lalu memberontak. Setelah Buddha menahannya di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur selama lima ratus tahun, ia menjadi murid Tang Sanzang bersama Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang; sebuah lingkaran gaib di kepalanya mengetat bila Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu.
long_description.en: He obtains the staff Ruyi Jingu Bang, is given posts as keeper of the horses and guardian of the peach garden in heaven, and then rebels. After the Buddha confines him under the Five Elements Mountain for five hundred years he becomes a disciple of Tang Sanzang with Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang; a magical circlet on his head tightens when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra.

long_description.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menganugerahinya gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran. Para peneliti menelusuri asal-usulnya ke tokoh Monkey Pilgrim dalam teks dinasti Song, dan memperdebatkan pengaruh Hanuman, Wuzhiqi, serta tradisi kera di Tiongkok selatan.
long_description.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha gives him the title Buddha Victorious in Fighting. Scholars trace his origins to the Monkey Pilgrim of a Song dynasty text and debate the influence of Hanuman, Wuzhiqi and ape traditions of southern China.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menafsirkan Sun Wu Kung sebagai kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, dan jenius pencipta; ini tafsiran penerjemah, bukan pernyataan novel itu sendiri.
cultural_context.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard interprets Sun Wu Kung as a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer and the inventive genius; this is the translator's interpretation, not a statement of the novel itself.

literal_meaning.id: Marga Sūn mengacu pada kata húsūn (猢猻) yang berarti kera; nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan".
literal_meaning.en: The surname Sūn plays on húsūn (猢猻), "monkey"; the given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness".

who.id: Kera sakti yang lahir dari batu dalam novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West.
who.en: A magical monkey born from a stone in the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West.

origin.id: Tokoh sastra dari novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 yang dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en, dengan prototipe dalam teks dinasti Song.
origin.en: A literary character from a 16th-century Chinese novel attributed to Wu Cheng'en, with a prototype in a Song dynasty text.

role.id: Murid dan pengawal Tang Sanzang dalam perjalanan mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
role.en: Disciple and escort of Tang Sanzang on the journey to fetch Buddhist sutras in the West.

famous_for.id: Memberontak melawan surga dengan tongkat sakti, 72 perubahan wujud, dan salto awan, lalu menjadi Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran.
famous_for.en: Rebelling against heaven with a magic staff, 72 transformations and a cloud somersault, and later becoming the Buddha Victorious in Fighting.

did_you_know.id: Menurut teks novel, tongkat Ruyi Jingu Bang yang dipilih Wukong di bab 3 bertuliskan berat 13.500 kati.
did_you_know.en: According to the novel text, the Ruyi Jingu Bang that Wukong takes in chapter 3 is inscribed with a weight of 13,500 jin.

description.id: 72 Transformasi Duniawi memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk berubah menjadi hewan dan benda; novel menyebut ia menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
description.en: The 72 Earthly Transformations give him 72 unique powers, including transforming into animals and objects; the novel says he masters seventy-two transformations.

description.id: Dalam novel, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li; disebut sebagai cara terbang yang diajarkan gurunya.
description.en: In the novel one somersault covers 108,000 li; it is described as a style of flying taught by his master.

description.id: Ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
description.en: He can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

description.id: Ia dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda.
description.en: He is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances.

description.id: Tongkat berujung dua gelang emas bertuliskan berat 13.500 kati yang diambil Wukong dalam bab 3.
description.en: A staff with two gold bands at its ends inscribed with a weight of 13,500 jin, which Wukong takes in chapter 3.

description.id: Lingkaran gaib dari Buddha tidak dapat dilepas, dan mengetat serta menimbulkan sakit kepala saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu; Richard menyebut topi berduri serupa yang menusuk kepala Kera saat ia ragu menjalankan perintah sulit.
description.en: A magical circlet from the Buddha cannot be removed, and it tightens and causes a headache when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra; Richard describes a similar hat of spikes that pricks the Monkey's head when he hesitates over a hard task.

description.id: Dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song, tokoh ini disebut Monkey Pilgrim, mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri, dan menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaibnya karena Zhu Bajie dan Sha Wujing belum sepenuhnya berkembang.
description.en: In the Song dynasty storyteller's prompt-book he is called the Monkey Pilgrim, approaches Xuanzang of his own accord, and is his sole magical protector since Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing were not yet fully developed.

title.en: Birth and crowning as Monkey King

role.en: Protagonist

summary.id: Kera batu lahir dari telur batu, memasuki air terjun yang menyembunyikan gua, dan diangkat menjadi raja kera dengan nama Raja Kera Tampan.
summary.en: The stone monkey is born from a stone egg, enters the waterfall hiding a cave, and is made king of the monkeys as the Handsome Monkey King.

title.en: Learning magic and receiving his name

role.en: Student of the patriarch

summary.id: Ia meninggalkan gunung mencari keabadian, menerima nama dharma Sun Wukong, dan menguasai 72 perubahan wujud serta salto awan.
summary.en: He leaves the mountain to seek immortality, receives the dharma name Sun Wukong, and masters the 72 transformations and the cloud somersault.

role.en: Rebel

summary.id: Setelah diberi jabatan pengurus kuda dan penjaga kebun persik, Wukong memberontak melawan surga dan mengalahkan pasukan langit.
summary.en: After being made keeper of the horses and guardian of the peach garden, Wukong rebels against heaven and defeats its armies.

role.en: The one who loses the wager

summary.id: Wukong bertaruh dengan Buddha, tidak mampu keluar dari telapak tangannya, dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur.
summary.en: Wukong wagers with the Buddha, fails to leave his palm, and is pressed beneath the Five Elements Mountain.

role.en: Disciple and escort

summary.id: Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani Tang Sanzang bersama Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, dan di akhir novel menjadi Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran.
summary.en: Five hundred years later he accompanies Tang Sanzang with Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, and at the end of the novel becomes the Buddha Victorious in Fighting.

sources.title: A mission to heaven : a great Chinese epic and allegory (full text)
sources.author: Timothy Richard (translator)

claims.quote: is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

statement.id: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) adalah novel Tiongkok yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en.
statement.en: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claims.quote: The beginning part of the story deals with the earlier exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg that forms from an ancient rock created by the coupling of Heaven and Earth, who learns the art of the Tao, 72 polymorphic transformations, combat, and secrets of immortality

statement.id: Bagian awal novel menceritakan petualangan awal Sun Wukong, seekor kera yang lahir di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (Flower Fruit Mountain) dari telur batu, yang mempelajari Tao, 72 transformasi, ilmu tempur, dan rahasia keabadian.
statement.en: The opening part of the novel deals with the early exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg, who learns the Tao, 72 transformations, combat, and the secrets of immortality.

claims.quote: also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters in the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Sun Wukong, juga dikenal sebagai Raja Kera (Monkey King), adalah tokoh sastra dan keagamaan yang paling dikenal sebagai salah satu tokoh utama novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 Journey to the West.
statement.en: Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters of the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

claims.quote: In the novel, Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who acquires supernatural powers through Taoist practices and consuming heavenly victuals.

statement.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong adalah kera cerdas (kemungkinan rhesus makaka atau monyet hidung pesek emas) yang lahir dari batu dan memperoleh kekuatan gaib lewat latihan Tao serta makanan surgawi.
statement.en: In the novel Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who gains supernatural powers through Taoist practice and heavenly food.

claims.quote: After rebelling against heaven, he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later, he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang riding on the White Dragon Horse and two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, on a journey to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West or Western Paradise, where Buddha and his followers dwell.

statement.id: Setelah memberontak melawan surga, ia dipenjara di bawah gunung oleh Buddha. Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani biksu Tang Sanzang, yang menunggang White Dragon Horse, bersama dua murid lain, Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
statement.en: After rebelling against heaven he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang, who rides the White Dragon Horse, with two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong possesses many abilities. He has supernatural strength and is able to support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders

statement.id: Sun Wukong memiliki banyak kemampuan, antara lain kekuatan supernatural; ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
statement.en: Sun Wukong has many abilities, including supernatural strength; he can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which allow him to access 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

statement.id: Sun Wukong memperoleh 72 Transformasi Duniawi, yang memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk kemampuan berubah menjadi hewan dan benda.
statement.en: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which give him 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

claims.quote: The ability, oft portrayed as Wukong riding a nimbus-like cloud, requires a magic hand sign, an oral spell, a fist clench, and a body shake. Wukong's master Puti Zushi taught this ability to the monkey to give him a style of flying that complements his penchant for jumping.

statement.id: Kemampuan salto awan sering digambarkan sebagai Wukong menunggang awan; guru Puti Zushi mengajarkannya agar Wukong memiliki cara terbang yang cocok dengan kegemarannya melompat.
statement.en: The cloud somersault is often portrayed as Wukong riding a cloud; his master Puti Zushi taught it to give him a style of flying suited to his love of jumping.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, which together made him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

statement.id: Sun Wukong dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda, yang menjadikannya salah satu makhluk paling abadi dan kebal di seluruh ciptaan.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, making him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

claims.quote: a magical circlet which, once the Monkey King is tricked into putting it on, can never be removed. When Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra, the band will tighten and cause an unbearable headache.

statement.id: Guanyin memberi Tang Sanzang sebuah lingkaran gaib dari Buddha yang tidak dapat dilepas setelah Raja Kera dibujuk memakainya; saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu, lingkaran itu mengetat dan menimbulkan sakit kepala tak tertahankan.
statement.en: Guanyin gives Tang Sanzang a magical circlet from the Buddha that can never be removed once the Monkey King is tricked into wearing it; when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra the band tightens and causes an unbearable headache.

claims.quote: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, as monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), and can mean either a literal or a figurative monkey (or a macaque).

statement.id: Marga Sūn diberikan sebagai lelucon tentang kera, karena kera juga disebut húsūn (猢猻), kata yang dapat berarti kera secara harfiah maupun kiasan.
statement.en: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, since monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), a word that can mean a monkey literally or figuratively.

claims.quote: The given name, Wùkōng, means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

statement.id: Nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan", kadang diterjemahkan "sadar akan kehampaan".
statement.en: The given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

claims.quote: Son Gokū in Japanese, Sonogong in Korean ... Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese, Sun Ngokong in Thai, Wu Khone in Burmese, and Sun Gokong in Malay.

statement.id: Nama Sun Wukong dilafalkan Son Gokū dalam bahasa Jepang, Tôn Ngộ Không dalam bahasa Vietnam, Sung Ghokong atau Sung Gokhong dalam bahasa Jawa, dan Sun Gokong dalam bahasa Melayu, di antara bahasa lain.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is pronounced Son Gokū in Japanese, Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese and Sun Gokong in Malay, among other languages.

claims.quote: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in the Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures (大唐三藏取經詩話). In this 17-chapter text, the character is known as the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

statement.id: Prototipe sastra tertua yang diketahui dari Sun Wukong muncul dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song (960–1279), Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, teks 17 bab yang menyebutnya "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).
statement.en: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in a Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book, Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, a 17-chapter text that calls him the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

claims.quote: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic where the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim voluntarily approaches Xuanzang

statement.id: Berbeda dari novel dinasti Ming yang menceritakan kera dibebaskan dari bawah gunung, Monkey Pilgrim mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri.
statement.en: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic, in which the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim approaches Xuanzang of his own accord.

claims.quote: Throughout the text, the Monkey Pilgrim serves as Xuanzang's sole magical protector, as the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

statement.id: Dalam teks itu, Monkey Pilgrim menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaib Xuanzang, karena tokoh Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) dan Sha Wujing (Sandy) belum dikembangkan sepenuhnya sebagai sesama murid.
statement.en: In that text the Monkey Pilgrim is Xuanzang's sole magical protector, since the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

claims.quote: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman from the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

statement.id: Hu Shih pertama kali mengusulkan bahwa Wu Cheng'en mungkin dipengaruhi dewa Hindu Hanuman dari Ramayana dalam penggambarannya tentang Raja Kera.
statement.en: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman of the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

claims.quote: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Tiongkok abad ke-9 Wuzhiqi, yang muncul sebagai saudara Sun Wukong dalam kisah dinasti Yuan yang lebih tua, sebagai sumber inspirasinya.
statement.en: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

claims.quote: According to Li, the Monkey King in the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

statement.id: Menurut Li Tianfei, Raja Kera dalam novel akhir menggabungkan dua tradisi cerita rakyat terpisah yang bersatu pada masa dinasti Yuan (1271–1368).
statement.en: According to Li Tianfei, the Monkey King of the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

claims.quote: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian, and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

statement.id: Di beberapa bagian Tiongkok selatan, termasuk Sichuan, Fujian, dan Guangdong, cerita rakyat setempat memuat roh kera perkasa yang dipuja dan diberi gelar seperti "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).
statement.en: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

claims.quote: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王), the Saurian Demon King (蛟魔王), the Roc Demon King (鵬魔王), the Lion Spirit King (獅狔王), the Macaque Spirit King (獼猴王), and the snub-nosed monkey Spirit King (禺狨王).

statement.id: Ia membentuk persaudaraan bernama Tujuh Resi (Seven Sages, 七聖) dengan Bull Demon King (牛魔王) serta raja-raja siluman lain, antara lain Raja Roc dan Raja Singa.
statement.en: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王) and other spirit kings, among them the Roc Demon King and the Lion Spirit King.

claims.quote: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong. Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually, both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

statement.id: Guanyin menyarankan Erlang Shen, keponakan Kaisar Giok, melawan Wukong; Wukong dan Erlang sama kuat; keduanya akhirnya berubah menjadi sosok menakutkan yang membuat pasukan kera Wukong lari ketakutan.
statement.en: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong; Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son, Princes Nezha, despite the Heavenly weapons used against him.

statement.id: Sun Wukong mengalahkan 100.000 prajurit langit Army of Heaven, 28 rasi bintang, dan Empat Raja Surgawi di bawah komando Devaraja Li dan putra ketiganya, Nezha.
statement.en: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son Nezha.

claims.quote: His fellow spiritual primates are the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline

statement.id: Sesama primata rohani Wukong antara lain Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), yang menjadi salah satu lawannya dalam alur utama.
statement.en: Wukong's fellow spiritual primates include the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline.

claims.quote: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (西遊補; "Supplement to the Journey to the West"), c. 1640, follows Sun Wukong as he is trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire

statement.id: Novel satir pendek Xiyoubu (sekitar 1640) mengisahkan Sun Wukong terjebak di dunia mimpi gaib ciptaan Qing Fish Demon, perwujudan keinginan.
statement.en: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (c. 1640) follows Sun Wukong trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire.

claims.quote: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong 1995.

statement.id: A Chinese Odyssey adalah film komedi fantasi yang dibuat di Hong Kong pada 1995.
statement.en: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong in 1995.

claims.quote: Martial Arts Superstar Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King

statement.id: Donnie Yen memerankan Sun Wukong dalam film The Monkey King tahun 2014.
statement.en: Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King.

claims.quote: The character of Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as attested by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud, and name

statement.id: Tokoh Son Goku dalam Dragon Ball didasarkan pada Sun Wukong, terlihat dari ekor kera, tongkat, awan terbang, dan namanya.
statement.en: The character Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as shown by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud and name.

claims.quote: The character of Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Tokoh Monkey dalam serial televisi Jepang Monkey tahun 1978 didasarkan pada Sun Wukong.
statement.en: The character Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: Sun Wu Kung. A monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menulis bahwa Sun Wu Kung adalah kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, jenius pencipta yang penuh akal.
statement.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation, Timothy Richard writes that Sun Wu Kung is a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource.

claims.quote: On a certain day it split open and produced a stone egg, round like a big ball. After exposure to the air, this was transformed into a stone monkey with the five senses of the body complete, and able to creep and run.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), suatu hari batu hidup itu terbelah dan menghasilkan telur batu bundar; setelah terkena udara, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan kelima indra lengkap dan mampu merayap serta berlari.
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation, one day the living stone split open and produced a round stone egg; after exposure to the air it became a stone monkey with the five senses complete, able to creep and run.

claims.quote: the Master orders some very difficult work to be done, and the Monkey hesitates, the spikes enter into his head and give great pain.

statement.id: Richard menjelaskan bahwa topi berduri yang dipakai Kera menusuk kepalanya dan menimbulkan sakit hebat bila Sang Guru memerintahkan pekerjaan sulit dan Kera ragu.
statement.en: Richard explains that the hat of spikes worn by the Monkey pricks his head and gives great pain when the Master orders some very difficult work and the Monkey hesitates.

claims.quote: 內育仙胞，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢皆全。

statement.id: Dalam teks asli novel (bab 1), sebuah batu yang mengandung "kantong gaib" pecah pada suatu hari dan melahirkan telur batu sebesar bola; terkena angin, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan panca indra dan keempat anggota badan lengkap.
statement.en: In the original text (chapter 1), a stone holding an immortal "womb" split open one day and produced a stone egg the size of a ball; touched by the wind it became a stone monkey with all five senses and four limbs complete.

claims.quote: 眾猴聽說，即拱伏無違，一個個序齒排班，朝上禮拜，都稱「千歲大王」。自此，石猿高登王位，將「石」字兒隱了，遂稱「美猴王」。

statement.id: Para kera memberi hormat dan menyebutnya "千歲大王"; kera batu itu pun naik takhta, menanggalkan kata "batu" dari namanya, dan disebut Raja Kera Tampan (美猴王).
statement.en: The monkeys bow and hail him as "千歲大王"; the stone ape then ascends the throne, drops the word "stone" from his name, and is called the Handsome Monkey King (美猴王).

claims.quote: 美猴王領一群猿猴、獼猴、馬猴等，分派了君臣佐使。朝遊花果山，暮宿水簾洞

statement.id: Raja Kera Tampan memimpin sekelompok kera dan monyet; mereka berkelana di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (花果山) pada siang hari dan bermalam di Gua Tirai Air (水簾洞) pada malam hari.
statement.en: The Handsome Monkey King led a troop of apes and monkeys; by day they roamed Flower Fruit Mountain (花果山) and by night they lodged in the Water Curtain Cave (水簾洞).

claims.quote: 我明日就辭汝等下山，雲遊海角，遠涉天涯，務必訪此三者，學一個不老長生，常躲過閻君之難。

statement.id: Raja Kera memutuskan turun gunung, mengembara jauh untuk mencari tiga golongan makhluk yang luput dari kematian, agar belajar hidup abadi dan menghindari bencana dari Raja Yama.
statement.en: The Monkey King resolves to leave the mountain and wander far to find the three kinds of beings who escape death, so as to learn ageless long life and avoid the hardship of King Yama.

claims.quote: 祖師道：「乃廣、大、智、慧、真、如、性、海、穎、悟、圓、覺十二字。排到你，正當『悟』字。與你起個法名叫做『孫悟空』，好麼？」猴王笑道：「好！好！好！自今就叫做孫悟空也。」

statement.id: Sang guru (祖師) berkata bahwa urutan dua belas aksara nama perguruannya jatuh pada aksara "悟" bagi si kera, lalu memberinya nama dharma "孫悟空"; si kera menerimanya dengan gembira.
statement.en: The patriarch (祖師) says that in his school's sequence of twelve characters the monkey's turn falls on the character "悟", and gives him the dharma name "孫悟空", which the monkey gladly accepts.

claims.quote: 你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏，意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也；月者，陰也。老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也；系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。

statement.id: Sang guru menilai tubuh si kera buruk tetapi mirip kera pemakan buah pinus, lalu memberinya marga "孫" setelah membahas aksara 猢 dan 猻.
statement.en: The patriarch says the monkey's body is unlovely yet like a pine-nut-eating macaque (猢猻), and after discussing the characters 猢 and 猻 gives him the surname "孫".

claims.quote: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。

statement.id: Dalam bab 2, si Raja Kera menguasai satu hal lalu seratus hal lain menyusul; ia mempelajari rumus lisan, berlatih sendiri, dan menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
statement.en: In chapter 2 the Monkey King, once one opening is clear, finds a hundred open; he learns the oral formula, practises on his own, and masters the seventy-two transformations.

claims.quote: 這朵雲，捻著訣，念動真言，攢緊了拳，將身一抖，跳將起來，一觔斗就有十萬八千里路哩。

statement.id: Sang guru mengajarkan awan salto: dengan rumus tangan, mantra, kepalan, dan guncangan tubuh, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li.
statement.en: The patriarch teaches the somersault cloud: with a hand sign, a spell, a clenched fist and a shake of the body, one somersault covers 108,000 li.

claims.quote: 悟空十分歡喜，拿出海藏看時，原來兩頭是兩個金箍，中間乃一段烏鐵。緊挨箍有鐫成的一行字，喚做：「如意金箍棒，重一萬三千五百斤。

statement.id: Dalam bab 3, senjata yang dipilih Wukong berujung dua gelang emas dengan batang besi hitam di tengah, bertuliskan "如意金箍棒" (tongkat gelang emas sesuka hati) seberat 13.500 kati.
statement.en: In chapter 3 the weapon Wukong takes has two gold bands at its ends and a length of black iron between them, inscribed "如意金箍棒" (Ruyi Jingu Bang), weighing 13,500 jin.

claims.quote: 玉帝傳旨道：「就除他做個弼馬溫罷。」眾臣叫謝恩，他也只朝上唱個大喏。玉帝又差木德星官送他去御馬監到任。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menetapkan Wukong sebagai "弼馬溫" (pengurus kuda) dan mengirimnya ke istal kerajaan untuk menjabat.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor decrees that Wukong be made a "弼馬溫" (keeper of the horses) and sends him to the imperial stables to take up the post.

claims.quote: 就做個齊天大聖，有何不可？」猴王聞說，歡喜不勝，連道幾個「好！好！好！」教四健將：「就替我快置個旌旗，旗上寫『齊天大聖』四大字，立竿張掛。自此以後，只稱我為齊天大聖，不許再稱大王。

statement.id: Setelah menolak jabatan pengurus kuda, Wukong menyiapkan panji bertuliskan "齊天大聖" dan memerintahkan agar ia hanya disebut Sang Resi Setara Langit, bukan raja.
statement.en: After the horse-keeper post, a banner reading "齊天大聖" (Great Sage Equal to Heaven) is set up and Wukong orders that he be called by that title and no longer "king".

claims.quote: 朕見你身閑無事，與你件執事：你且權管那蟠桃園，早晚好生在意。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menugaskan Wukong mengurus Kebun Persik Panjang Umur (蟠桃園) sementara waktu.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor assigns Wukong to take charge of the Peach Garden (蟠桃園) for the time being.

claims.quote: 佛祖道：「我與你打個賭賽：你若有本事，一觔斗打出我這右手掌中，算你贏

statement.id: Buddha menantang Wukong bertaruh: bila Wukong mampu sekali salto keluar dari telapak tangan kanannya, ia dianggap menang.
statement.en: The Buddha proposes a wager: if Wukong can somersault out of his right palm in a single leap, Wukong wins.

claims.quote: 被佛祖翻掌一撲，把這猴王推出西天門外，將五指化作金、木、水、火、土五座聯山，喚名「五行山」

statement.id: Buddha membalik telapak tangannya, mendorong Raja Kera keluar dari gerbang barat surga, dan mengubah lima jarinya menjadi lima gunung berantai bernama Gunung Lima Unsur (五行山).
statement.en: The Buddha turns his palm, pushes the Monkey King out of the West Heaven Gate, and turns his five fingers into five linked mountains called the Five Elements Mountain (五行山).

claims.quote: 孫悟空，汝因大鬧天宮，吾以甚深法力，壓在五行山下，幸天災滿足，歸於釋教；且喜汝隱惡揚善，在途中煉魔降怪有功，全終全始，加陞大職正果，汝為鬥戰勝佛。

statement.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menyebut Sun Wukong pernah mengacau istana langit dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur; karena jasanya menaklukkan iblis di sepanjang jalan, ia dianugerahi gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran (鬥戰勝佛).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha recalls that Sun Wukong made havoc in the heavenly palace and was pressed under the Five Elements Mountain, and for his merit in subduing demons along the way names him the Buddha Victorious in Fighting (鬥戰勝佛).

summary.id: Hu Shih mengusulkan pengaruh Hanuman dari Ramayana.
summary.en: Hu Shih suggested the influence of Hanuman of the Ramayana.

summary.id: Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Wuzhiqi sebagai sumber inspirasi.
summary.en: Lu Xun suggested the deity Wuzhiqi as the inspiration.

summary.id: Li Tianfei berpendapat tokoh ini gabungan dua tradisi cerita rakyat yang menyatu pada masa Yuan.
summary.en: Li Tianfei argues the character combines two folklore traditions that merged in the Yuan dynasty.

gaps.searched: Sumber yang dibuka menggambarkan pemberontakan dan pengabdian sekaligus tanpa satu pernyataan sifat; dikosongkan.
Tidak ada sumber yang membandingkan secara eksplisit tradisi dan penggambaran modern.

Helen Hayes, The Buddhist Pilgrim's Progress (1930): tidak ditemukan teks daring yang bisa dibuka; sebagai gantinya dipakai terjemahan Timothy Richard 1913 (archive.org) dan teks Tionghoa asli di Wikisource. Britannica diblokir (403) dan worldhistory.org tidak merespons.

visual_requirements.description: One living furry macaque with projecting muzzle, monkey nose and ears, one head and two visible arms; normal two-legged anatomy intended, with legs outside the half-body crop.
Gold Buddhist head circlet and one continuous black iron staff with gold bands at both ends; no inscription.

Threatening intense expression, battle dust, flying stone fragments and localized physical sparks where the staff scrapes a stone edge. Contact sparks are an artistic physical consequence of battle, not a claimed magical power.

Dark ruined palace battle surroundings evoke Wukong's fighting and havoc in heaven; the circlet-wearing portrait and palace context form an illustrative composite rather than a precise chronological reconstruction.

visual_review.notes: Main agent inspected native PNG B directly: intense threatening macaque gaze, one head, two distinct arms and gripping hands, gold circlet, one readable black iron staff with both gold ends; localized sparks at stone contact and battle dust. Opaque cloth. Legs below portrait crop cannot be counted. No visible text, watermark, glowing eye aura or added magic.
observations: Half-body portrait with both hands visible; staff crosses beneath the face.
Both gold-banded ends visible, including the right end at the stone contact.
Natural amber irises have small reflected catchlights rather than emissive glow.
Plain worn cloth and original scene; no reference image or branded design supplied.
limitations: Lower legs and feet lie outside the half-body crop and cannot be visually counted.
Sparks and ruined architectural styling are artistic scene choices, not exact quoted novel details.
Sun Wukong's circlet and heavenly battle surroundings are a composite presentation, not a claim that all elements occur together chronologically.

items.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: ONE original square full-bleed realistic cinematic mythology catalogue illustration, Sun Wukong pilot variant B.
Scene: close battle view amid dark stone ruins of a heavenly palace, rough broken stone ledge at the lower foreground, drifting battle dust and a few stone chips. This is a literary composite evoking his fighting and havoc in heaven; no literal crowds needed.
Subject: Sun Wukong from the Ming novel Journey to the West, a formidable LIVING furry rhesus-like MACAQUE, not a stone statue. One head, exactly TWO arms, exactly TWO legs (legs are below the portrait crop), proper projecting macaque muzzle, recognizable monkey nose and ears, realistic ruffled coarse brown-gray battle-dust fur. Terrifyingly intense threatening fierce gaze directly at viewer, narrowed natural dark amber eyes with ordinary reflected catchlights, a tense snarling macaque mouth. This is fierce expression, not monstrous transformed anatomy.
Composition: waist-up or half-body battle portrait; head and chest prominently readable, face fully unobstructed. He twists his torso while BOTH visible hands grip and swing/spin ONE SINGLE straight black iron staff across the lower chest and foreground in a shallow diagonal. The entire staff is readable within the square, including BOTH ends, each end encircled by a SIMPLE GOLD BAND; black iron shaft between them. Both hands have coherent monkey fingers and oppose each other naturally on the same shaft. No second stick, no overlapping duplicated shaft. Motion is suggested by swirling dust and cloth only: keep face, hands, shaft and both gold ends sharp.
Physical effect: one end of the staff just scrapes the broken stone foreground edge, producing a small localized spray of real orange contact sparks and stone dust at that precise point. The sparks are physical battle contact, not supernatural flame, lightning, an aura or a magic power.
Clothing and object design: a simple tight plain GOLD BUDDHIST HEAD CIRCLET across his brow, original understated design, visible over fur. Plain opaque weathered historic Chinese wrap tunic and cloth sash, cloth sleeves, muted charcoal and earthy brown, original unarmored pilgrim clothing. No ornaments borrowed from any modern design.
Style: premium naturalistic illustration with very convincing macaque facial anatomy and tactile fur, worn iron, scratched gold, dusty fabric and stone; cinematic low-key cool side lighting, a faint warm reflection from tiny contact sparks, deep dark background but clear readable face and silhouette. Dangerous and imposing rather than cute.
Literary basis: living monkey four-limbed macaque c04/c33/c38; circlet c10; black iron staff with gold at both ends c41; fighting and heavenly havoc c23/c47. Do not add new powers.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: new original composition and character design; square 1:1; opaque background. No modern game costume, armor, recognizable game character face, game poster composition, imitation of Black Myth or any branded work. No human face, anime, extra heads/arms/legs/fingers, creature mutation, gore, glowing magical eyes, lightning, fire aura, magic rings, energy ribbons or halos. NO TEXT OF ANY KIND: no staff inscription, no letters, Chinese characters, label, logo, signature, watermark, border, decorative frame.

old_artwork.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square premium painterly naturalistic Mythics educational editorial illustration of SHIVA, respectful living Hindu religious iconography, majestic benevolent Protector in his mountain abode Kailasa, original composition. One monumental living deity fills the frame, pale ash-toned skin with a clearly BLUE THROAT, one head, exactly FOUR anatomically coherent arms and two legs. Third eye clearly in forehead; a physical serpent Vasuki loosely around his neck; crescent moon in high matted hair topknot; actual river water Ganga cascades gently from topknot; one hand holds a tall three-pronged trident, another holds a small damaru drum, other two hold calm protective gestures. Modest traditional tiger-skin cloth and drapery covers torso/lower body. View from low on the mountain with small distant peaks giving scale, composed authoritative upright active presence rather than ordinary human portrait. A narrow directed tongue of fire emerges clearly from the THIRD EYE, source-supported third-eye fire (shiva-c05,c20), distinct from the gently flowing Ganga (c05,c19). Keep face readable and beautiful, serene and awe-inspiring, no victims. Dramatic firelight and natural cool mountain dawn, rich brushwork, dignified authentic iconography. Blue throat c09,c25; mountain context c03,c29; four-arm arrangement is editorial traditional iconographic choice informed by sculpture reference, not asserted textual anatomy. Avoid cosmic generic ribbons, extra heads/limbs, weapons beyond trident, modern film/game/anime/comic designs, nakedness, gore, text, logos, labels, border or watermark.

Distinct blue throat.
