root_visual_review.notes: Third eye loosing fire, blue throat, Vasuki, crescent moon, trident, damaru and tiger skin on Kailasa; respectful and imposing.

cultural_context.id: Dalam tradisi Saiwa, Siwa dipuja sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia dewa terpenting bagi sekte Saiwa serta pelindung para yogi, brahmana, dan Weda; Wikipedia mencatatnya pula sebagai dewa pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
cultural_context.en: In the Shaiva tradition Shiva is worshipped as the Supreme Lord. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the most important god for the Shaivism sect and the patron of yogis, Brahmins and the Vedas; Wikipedia also records him as patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

literal_meaning.id: mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat
literal_meaning.en: auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly

who.id: Salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu.
who.en: One of the principal Hindu deities.

origin.id: Agama Hindu, terutama tradisi Saiwa.
origin.en: Hinduism, especially Shaivism.

role.id: Dewa pelebur sekaligus pelindung dalam Trimurti, dan Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi bagi pemuja Saiwa.
role.en: Destroyer and protector within the Trimurti, and the Supreme Lord for Shaiva devotees.

famous_for.id: Mata ketiga, Sungai Gangga di rambutnya, dan tarian kosmis Nataraja.
famous_for.en: His third eye, the Ganga in his hair and the cosmic dance of Nataraja.

did_you_know.id: Kisah Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru, punya dua versi: World History Encyclopedia menceritakan racun bisa Vasuki, sedangkan Mahabharata menyebut racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan.
did_you_know.en: The tale of Nilakantha, Blue Throat, comes in two versions: the World History Encyclopedia tells of Vasuki's venom, whereas the Mahabharata names the Kalakuta poison that appeared during the churning.

description.id: Pada akhir tiap siklus ia meleburkan alam semesta sehingga penciptaan baru dapat terjadi.
description.en: At the end of each cycle he destroys the universe so that a new creation can begin.

description.id: Dari mata ketiganya ia melepaskan api; ia menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api itu.
description.en: He looses fire from his third eye, with which he struck Surabhi's cows.

description.id: Ia memiliki senjata kesayangan yang disebut Pasuputa atau Pasupata; menurut Mahabharata, senjata itu dapat menghancurkan seluruh alam semesta bila dilepaskan, dan Arjuna memperolehnya darinya.
description.en: He has a favourite weapon called the Pasuputa or Pasupata; in the Mahabharata it may destroy the whole universe if hurled, and Arjuna obtains it from him.

description.id: Ia digambarkan membawa busur Pinaka dan disebut pemegang Pinaka dalam Mahabharata.
description.en: He is shown carrying the Pinaka bow and is called wielder of the Pinaka in the Mahabharata.

role.en: Saviour who swallows the poison

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan, dan tenggorokannya menjadi biru sehingga ia disebut Nilakantha. World History Encyclopedia menceritakan versi lain: Siwa meminum bisa yang hendak dimuntahkan Vasuki.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, at Brahman's request, Shiva swallows the Kalakuta poison that rose during the churning, for the safety of creation, and from then on is called Nilakantha. The World History Encyclopedia tells another version in which Shiva drinks the venom Vasuki threatened to spew.

role.id: Dewa yang menyamar dan menganugerahkan senjata
role.en: God in disguise who grants a weapon

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersama Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; dalam ringkasan epos itu, Arjuna memperoleh senjata Pasupata setelah menyenangkan sang dewa mata tiga yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata with Uma as a Kirata woman; a summary passage of the epic says Arjuna obtained the Pasupata weapon after pleasing the three-eyed god, disguised as a hunter, in combat.

title.en: The sacrifice of Daksha and the death of Sati

role.id: Suami Sati yang murka lalu mengampuni
role.en: Husband of Sati, wrathful and then forgiving

summary.id: Daksha mengadakan upacara kurban untuk semua dewa kecuali Siwa, dan Sati menceburkan diri ke api kurban. Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali yang memenggal Daksha, lalu menghidupkannya kembali dengan kepala domba atas permohonan para dewa.
summary.en: Daksha held a sacrifice for all gods but Shiva, and Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire. Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali, who beheaded Daksha, then revived him with a ram's head at the gods' appeal.

role.en: Father who restores his son

summary.id: Setelah menyadari kekeliruannya, Siwa mencari kepala baru bagi anak itu; kepala terdekat adalah kepala gajah, sehingga lahirlah Ganesha.
summary.en: Realising his error, Shiva sought a new head for the boy; the nearest was an elephant's, and Ganesha was born.

role.en: He who breaks the river's fall

summary.id: Siwa menangkap Gangga dalam sanggul rambutnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu ke bumi tidak menghancurkan peradaban.
summary.en: Shiva caught the Ganga in his hair topknot so that her fall to earth would not destroy civilisation.

role.en: God angered and then calmed

summary.id: Susu sapi-sapi Surabhi membanjiri tempat tinggal Siwa; ia menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya, dan para dewa menenangkannya dengan mempersembahkan banteng Nandi.
summary.en: The milk of Surabhi's cows flooded Shiva's home; he struck the cows with fire from his third eye, and the gods calmed him by offering the bull Nandi.

description.id: Tempat Siwa hidup bertapa sebagai yogi; Mahabharata menyebut tempat tinggalnya di pegunungan (Kailasa).
description.en: Where Shiva lives as an ascetic yogi; the Mahabharata places his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa).

description.id: Di Indonesia Siwa dipuja terutama di Jawa dan Bali.
description.en: In Indonesia Shiva is revered especially in Java and Bali.

note.id: Istri Siwa.
note.en: Shiva's wife.

note.id: Putri Daksha yang menikah dengan Siwa dan akhirnya terlahir kembali sebagai Parwati.
note.en: Daughter of Daksha who married Shiva and was later reincarnated as Parvati.

note.id: Putra Siwa dan Parwati, dewa berkepala gajah.
note.en: Son of Shiva and Parvati, the elephant-headed god.

note.id: Putra Siwa dan Parwati.
note.en: Son of Shiva and Parvati.

note.id: Bersama Brahma dan Wisnu, Siwa termasuk dalam Trimurti; Arjuna menyapa Siwa sebagai Wisnu dalam wujud Siwa.
note.en: Shiva forms the Trimurti with Brahma and Vishnu; Arjuna addresses Shiva as Vishnu in the form of Siva.

note.id: Bersama Wisnu dan Siwa membentuk Trimurti.
note.en: With Vishnu forms the Trimurti with Shiva.

note.id: Dewa Weda yang dikaitkan dengan Siwa.
note.en: The Vedic deity associated with Shiva.

note.id: Banteng yang diterima dan ditunggangi Siwa.
note.en: The bull Shiva accepted and rode.

note.id: Sungai suci yang ditangkap Siwa dalam rambutnya.
note.en: The holy river Shiva caught in his hair.

note.id: Raja ular yang melingkar di leher Siwa.
note.en: The serpent king around Shiva's neck.

note.id: Iblis yang diciptakan Siwa dari rambutnya bersama Rudrakali.
note.en: Demon Shiva created from his hair, together with Rudrakali.

note.id: Daksha tidak menyetujui pernikahan Sati dengan Siwa dan mengadakan kurban tanpa Siwa; Siwa kemudian menghidupkannya kembali.
note.en: Daksha disapproved of Sati's marriage to Shiva and held a sacrifice without him; Shiva later revived him.

note.id: Penerima senjata Pasupata dalam Mahabharata.
note.en: Recipient of the Pasupata weapon in the Mahabharata.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa satu dewa dapat dipandang sebagai pelebur sekaligus pencipta?
learning_questions.en: Why can one god be seen as both destroyer and creator?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dua sumber menceritakan kisah racun dan leher biru Siwa dengan cara yang berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why do two sources tell the story of Shiva's poison and blue throat in different ways?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang dikatakan kisah Kirata tentang hubungan antara dewa dan pemujanya?
learning_questions.en: What does the Kirata story say about the relationship between a god and his devotee?

topic.en: Origin of the Nilakantha poison story

short_description.id: Siwa, juga disebut Mahadewa, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Saiwa, dan anggota Trimurti yang berperan sebagai pelebur dan pelindung.
short_description.en: Shiva, also called Mahadeva, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Shaivism, and a member of the Trimurti who acts as destroyer and protector.

long_description.id: Siwa, yang namanya berarti "mujur" atau "menguntungkan", juga dikenal sebagai Mahadewa dan Sankara, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Dalam tradisi Saiwa ia Yang Mahatinggi, Tuhan yang mencipta, memelihara, dan mengubah alam semesta. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia anggota Trimurti bersama Brahma dan Wisnu, berperan sebagai Pelindung, dan sebagai penguasa Waktu ia pelebur sekaligus pencipta segala sesuatu.
long_description.en: Shiva, whose name means "auspicious" or "propitious", is also called Mahadeva and Sankara and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. In Shaivism he is the highest being, the Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe. According to the World History Encyclopedia he belongs to the Trimurti with Brahma and Vishnu, serves as the Protector, and as lord of Time is both destroyer and creator of all things.

long_description.id: Siwa memiliki banyak aspek, yang welas asih maupun yang menakutkan. Dalam aspek welas asihnya ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang hidup bertapa di Kailasa sekaligus kepala keluarga bersama istrinya, Parwati, dan kedua anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya; dalam aspek garangnya ia sering digambarkan membinasakan raksasa. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia pertapa agung yang memusatkan diri pada meditasi, tetapi juga memiliki sisi gelap sebagai pemimpin roh jahat dan hantu serta penguasa pencuri, penjahat, dan pengemis. Ia dikenal pula sebagai Adiyogi, yogi pertama, pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
long_description.en: Shiva shows both gentle and terrifying sides. In his gentle forms he appears as an all-knowing ascetic yogi dwelling on Kailasa, and also as a family man with his consort Parvati and their sons Ganesha and Kartikeya; in his wrathful forms he is frequently portrayed destroying demons. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the great ascetic who concentrates on meditation, yet he also has a darker side as leader of evil spirits and ghosts and master of thieves, villains and beggars. He is also honoured as Adiyogi, the first yogi, patron of yoga, meditation and the arts.

long_description.id: Ciri ikonografinya antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula sebagai senjatanya, dan kendang damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga, lambang kesuburan atau energi ilahi yang terdapat di kuil-kuilnya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Asia ia biasanya mewakili Nataraja yang membawakan tarian kosmis Tandava dalam lingkaran api, dan kadang membawa busur perak Pinaka serta menunggang banteng putih. Siwa dipuja luas oleh umat Hindu di India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia, terutama di Jawa dan Bali.
long_description.en: Among his emblems are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, a crescent moon, the holy Ganga flowing from his matted hair, a third eye on his forehead, the trident as his weapon and the damaru drum; he is usually worshipped in the aniconic form of the lingam, a symbol of fertility or divine energy found in his temples. According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Asian art he usually represents Nataraja, performing the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire, and is sometimes shown with the silver bow Pinaka and riding a white bull. Hindus honour Shiva across India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia, notably in Java and Bali.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisahnya memperlihatkan kekuatannya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali dari rambutnya, yang kemudian memenggal Daksha, menangkap Gangga dalam sanggulnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu tidak menghancurkan peradaban, dan menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api dari mata ketiganya sebelum para dewa menenangkannya dengan banteng Nandi. Dalam Mahabharata, ia menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan, dan sejak itu disebut Nilakantha, serta mengambil rupa seorang Kirata dan menurut ringkasan epos itu menganugerahkan senjata Pasupata kepada Arjuna.
long_description.en: His stories show his power. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali from his hair, who then beheaded Daksha, caught the Ganga in his topknot so that her fall would not destroy civilisation, and struck Surabhi's cows with fire from his third eye before the gods calmed him with the bull Nandi. In the Mahabharata he swallows the poison that appeared during the churning and is called Nilakantha from then on, and he takes the form of a Kirata and, according to a summary passage of the epic, grants the Pasupata weapon to Arjuna.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Daksha disapproved of Sati's marriage to Shiva and held a sacrificial ceremony for all the gods except Shiva; outraged at the slight, Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created two demons (Virabhadra and Rudrakali) from his hair, who wreaked havoc on the ceremony and beheaded Daksha; at the gods' appeal he ended the violence and revived Daksha with the head of a ram (or goat).

claims.quote: Realising his error, Shiva then sent for a new head with which to make the boy whole again but the nearest at hand was of an elephant. And so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, realising his error, Shiva sent for a new head to make the boy whole again, and the nearest was an elephant's, so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to cushion Ganga's fall to earth and stop so great a river from destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata (terjemahan Ganguli), atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan; Maheswara menahannya di tenggorokan, dan sejak itu ia disebut Nilakantha (berleher biru).
statement.en: In the Mahabharata (Ganguli translation), at Brahman's request Siva swallowed the poison for the safety of creation; the divine Maheswara held it in his throat and from that time is called Nilakantha (blue-throated).

claims.quote: the illustrious Hara—assuming the form of a Kirata resplendent as a golden tree, and with a huge and stalwart form like a second Meru ... the handsome god of gods was accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman ... Sankara in the guise of a Kirata suddenly bade him stop

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersosok besar dan kekar seperti Meru kedua, berkilau bagai pohon emas, ditemani Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; Sankara juga disebut tampil dalam rupa Kirata.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata, resplendent as a golden tree, with a huge, stalwart form like a second Meru, accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman; Sankara is also said to appear in the guise of a Kirata.

claims.quote: I will give to thee that favourite weapon of mine called the Pasuputa ... this weapon should not be hurled without adequate cause; for if hurled at any foe of little might it may destroy the whole universe.

statement.en: In the Mahabharata, the god says he will give his favourite weapon, called the Pasuputa, and warns that it must not be hurled without adequate cause since, hurled even at a weak foe, it may destroy the whole universe.

claims.quote: O god of gods, O Mahadeva, O thou of blue throat, O thou of matted locks ... Thou art Siva in the form of Vishnu, and Vishnu in the form of Siva. Thou destroyedest of old the great sacrifice of Daksha.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Arjuna menyapa sang dewa sebagai dewa para dewa, Mahadewa, yang berleher biru dan berambut gimbal, dan berkata bahwa ia adalah Siwa dalam wujud Wisnu dan Wisnu dalam wujud Siwa, yang dahulu menghancurkan kurban agung Daksha.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Arjuna addresses the god as god of gods, Mahadeva, of blue throat and matted locks, and says he is Siva in the form of Vishnu and Vishnu in the form of Siva, who of old destroyed the great sacrifice of Daksha.

claims.quote: that wielder of the Pinaka-that one who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa)—accompanied by Uma

statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Mahadeva is described as the wielder of the Pinaka who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa), accompanied by Uma.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Sati was eventually reincarnated as Parvati in her next life and re-married Shiva.

claims.quote: Vasuki, the king of Serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Vasuki, raja ular, mengancam memuntahkan bisa ular ke lautan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vasuki, king of the serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas.

claims.quote: And Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna and seeing that his body had been emaciated with ascetic austerities, spake unto him ... I will as I have been pleased with thee, grant thee an irresistible weapon. Soon shall thou be able to wield that weapon of mine.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara, melihat keajaiban sikap Arjuna dan tubuhnya yang kurus karena pertapaan, menyatakan senang dan akan menganugerahkan senjata tak tertahankan yang tak lama lagi dapat digunakan Arjuna.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna whose body was emaciated by ascetic austerities, says he is pleased and will grant him an irresistible weapon of his that Arjuna will soon be able to wield.

claims.quote: Arjuna, having, in combat, pleased the god of gods, Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata

statement.id: Dalam ringkasan kisah pada Mahabharata, Arjuna, setelah menyenangkan dewa para dewa Tryambaka (si mata tiga) yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran, memperoleh senjata agung Pasupata.
statement.en: In a summary passage of the Mahabharata, Arjuna, having pleased in combat the god of gods Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata.

short_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus dan menggenggam petir sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus and wields the lightning bolt as his weapon.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang. Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan Jupiter.
long_description.en: Zeus stands at the head of the Greek pantheon: god of the sky and of thunder in ancient Greek religion and myth, reigning over the gods from Mount Olympus. Theoi.com describes him as lord of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a dignified bearded man in his prime holding a thunderbolt and sceptre, with an eagle. In ancient Rome he was equated with Jupiter.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia. Kronos menelan setiap anaknya begitu lahir, tetapi Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan memberi Kronos sebuah batu berbalut kain. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan diam-diam di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia. Setelah dewasa ia merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga Kronos memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
long_description.en: Zeus is the child of the Titans Kronos and Rheia. Kronos swallowed each child at birth, but Rhea saved Zeus by giving Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling cloth. According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secret on Mount Dikte in Crete, nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia. On coming of age he recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

long_description.id: Kekuasaannya diperoleh melalui perang. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dipersenjatai petir oleh para Kyklopes, dan dibantu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan para Titan. Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya lalu mengundi kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah. Ia kemudian menjatuhkan raja para Giant dengan petirnya, dan sempat dikalahkan Typhoeus sebelum Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya sehingga Zeus menang dan mengurung raksasa itu di bawah Gunung Etna.
long_description.en: His rule was won through war. According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the giants from Tartaros, was armed with lightning-bolts by the Kyklopes and, aided by the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and the Titans. Zeus and his brothers then cast lots to share out the universe, and Zeus received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below. He later laid low the king of the Giants with his lightning, and was for a time defeated by Typhoeus until Pan stole back his strength, so that Zeus won and bound the monster beneath Mount Etna.

long_description.id: Dalam kebanyakan tradisi, Zeus menikah dengan Hera, saudarinya, yang menurut theoi.com ia rayu dalam rupa burung kukuk. Ia juga terkenal karena banyak petualangan cintanya, yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles; menurut theoi.com ia merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam berbagai samaran, seperti angsa untuk Leda dan banteng untuk Europa. Athena lahir dari Metis, yang ditelan Zeus setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya, dan keluar dari kepala Zeus.
long_description.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, his sister, whom according to theoi.com he seduced in the guise of a cuckoo-bird. He was also infamous for his many love affairs, which produced numerous divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles; according to theoi.com he seduced many mortal women in various disguises, such as a swan for Leda and a bull for Europa. Athena was born of Metis, whom Zeus swallowed after an oracle said her son would replace him, and emerged from Zeus's head.

long_description.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petir yang ia genggam seperti lembing, disertai tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis. Hewan sucinya adalah elang dan banteng, dan tanaman sucinya adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel Dodona para imamnya terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai daun zaitun dari hutan sucinya. Takhtanya dijaga Kratos, Zelos, Nike, dan Bia, dan Hermes menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.
long_description.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus's most distinctive attribute was the lightning bolt he wielded like a javelin, together with a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis. His sacred animals were the eagle and the bull, and his sacred plants the holm oak and the olive; at the Dodona oracle his priests drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while victors at the Olympic Games wore wreaths of olive from the god's sacred grove. His throne was guarded by Kratos, Zelos, Nike and Bia, and Hermes served as his personal herald.

long_description.id: Zeus juga menegakkan keadilan dan hukuman. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia menghukum Prometheus yang memberi manusia api curian dengan mengirim Pandora ke bumi, memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar sambil menyelamatkan Deukalion dan Pyrrha, dan menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus.
long_description.en: Zeus was also an enforcer of justice and punishment. According to the World History Encyclopedia, he was king of the twelve Olympian gods; he controlled the weather, offered signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus. According to theoi.com he punished Prometheus, who gave mankind stolen fire, by sending Pandora to earth, decided to wipe wicked mankind out with a great deluge while sparing Deukalion and Pyrrha, and punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus.

statement.en: According to theoi.com, once the Titan-gods had fallen, Zeus and his brothers drew lots to divide the cosmos among themselves, with Zeus receiving the heavens, Poseidon the sea and Haides the underworld.

claims.quote: Zeus liberated the six giant-sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros. In gratitude the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires (Hundred-Handed) aided him in his assault on the Titanes with volleys of thrown boulders. Kronos and his allies were eventually defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan enam putra raksasa Langit dari jurang Tartaros; para Kyklopes mempersenjatainya dengan petir dan para Hekatonkheires membantunya menyerang Titan dengan lemparan batu, hingga Kronos dan sekutunya kalah dan dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the six giant sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros; the Kyklopes armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires aided his assault on the Titanes with thrown boulders, until Kronos and his allies were defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

claims.quote: Upon coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis to his cause. She served the Titan Kronos a magical draught which caused him to disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga ia memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, on coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

claims.quote: Zeus devoured the pregnant goddess Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods. Their child, Athena, was subsequently born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil ketika sebuah ramalan menyatakan putranya ditakdirkan menggantikannya sebagai Raja Para Dewa; anak mereka, Athena, kemudian lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus devoured the pregnant Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods; their child Athena was later born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

claims.quote: Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya Hera, ratu langit, setelah merayunya dalam rupa burung kukuk.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

claims.quote: Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods of heaven. Zeus punished this act by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, and sent her to earth with a vessel full of troubles to plague mankind.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Prometheus menciptakan umat manusia dan memberi mereka api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukumnya dengan memerintahkan penciptaan perempuan pertama, Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

claims.quote: The early generations of man descended into wickedness and corruption and Zeus decided to wipe them from the face of the earth with a great deluge. One virtuous couple, Deukalion and Pyrrha, were spared and afterwards allowed to repopulate the world with the casting of stones which transformed into men.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus memutuskan menghapus generasi awal manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; pasangan saleh Deukalion dan Pyrrha diselamatkan dan memulihkan dunia dengan melempar batu yang menjelma manusia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus decided to wipe the wicked early generations of man from the earth with a great deluge; the virtuous couple Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared and repopulated the world with cast stones that turned into men.

claims.quote: The earth-goddess Gaia (Gaea), angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise up against the gods of Olympos. They laid siege to the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia yang murka atas pemenjaraan para Titan mendorong para Giant memberontak melawan dewa-dewa Olimpos; mereka mengepung benteng surgawi, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya yang mematikan.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia, angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise against the gods of Olympos; they besieged the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

claims.quote: Gaia produced one more giant, Typhoeus, the most monstrous of his kind and set him upon Olympos. The rest of the gods fled in horror and Zeus himself was defeated in combat with the monster tearing the sinews from his limbs rendering him helpless. Pan later stole back the god's strength and, restored, Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia melahirkan Typhoeus, raksasa paling mengerikan, yang menyerang Olimpos; para dewa melarikan diri dan Zeus sendiri dikalahkan, otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya. Pan kemudian mencuri kembali kekuatannya, dan Zeus memenangkan pertarungan ulang serta mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia produced Typhoeus, the most monstrous of the giants, and set him upon Olympos; the gods fled and Zeus himself was defeated, the sinews torn from his limbs. Pan later stole back the god's strength, and Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

claims.quote: Zeus punished the worst villians of myth for their impiety and crimes against the gods including Tantalos who stole ambrosia from heaven, Lykaon (Lycaon) who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Zeus' wife the goddess Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus and steal the worship that was due the gods.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menghukum para penjahat terburuk dalam mitos karena kedurhakaan mereka, di antaranya Tantalos yang mencuri ambrosia, Lykaon yang menghidangkan daging manusia kepada para dewa, Ixion yang mencoba memperkosa Hera, dan Salmoneus yang menirukan Zeus.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus punished the worst villains of myth for impiety, including Tantalos who stole ambrosia, Lykaon who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus.

claims.quote: Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his stylized lightning bolt which he wielded in his hand like a javelin. His other attributes included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike (winged goddess of victory), and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petirnya yang digenggam seperti lembing; atribut lainnya mencakup tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis (pelindung lengan dari kulit kambing).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his lightning bolt wielded like a javelin; others included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

claims.quote: Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull. In myth he abducted the youth Ganymede in the shape of an eagle and the maiden Europa in the guise of a bull.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, hewan suci Zeus adalah elang dan banteng; dalam mitos ia menculik pemuda Ganymede dalam rupa elang dan gadis Europa dalam rupa banteng.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull; in myth he abducted the youth Ganymede as an eagle and the maiden Europa as a bull.

claims.quote: His sacred plants were the evergreen holm oak and the olive tree. At the ancient oracle of Dodona Zeus' priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with a wreath of olive-leaves picked from the god's sacred grove.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, tanaman suci Zeus adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel kuno Dodona para imam terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred plants were the holm oak and the olive tree; at the ancient oracle of Dodona his priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with olive-leaves from the god's sacred grove.

claims.quote: His throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, takhta Zeus dijaga empat roh bersayap, dua laki-laki dan dua perempuan, bernama Kratos (Kekuatan), Zelos (Persaingan), Nike (Kemenangan), dan Bia (Paksaan).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

claims.quote: The god Hermes was Zeus' personal herald who acted as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Hermes adalah juru bicara pribadi Zeus yang bertugas sebagai diplomat, utusan, dan agen umum kehendak sang dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Hermes was Zeus' personal herald, acting as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

claims.quote: The god's favorite mortal son was Herakles (Heracles) whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, putra fana kesayangan Zeus adalah Herakles, yang ia dukung sepanjang cobaannya dan akhirnya diterima di Olimpos sebagai dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' favorite mortal son was Herakles, whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

claims.quote: Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos (Cronus) and Rheia and a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth). He was a brother of the gods Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia serta cucu Ouranos (Langit) dan Gaia (Bumi), dan saudara Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter, dan Hestia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos and Rheia, a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth), and a brother of Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

claims.quote: Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children - Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya, dewi langit Hera, dan mereka memiliki tiga anak: Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children: Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

cultural_context.id: Di Tiongkok kuno naga dipandang adil dan baik hati serta berkaitan dengan hujan dan penguasa: bagi banyak orang kaisar adalah penjelmaan naga pembawa hujan, di desa-desa diadakan tarian naga untuk memohon hujan, dan naga menjadi shio kelima dalam zodiak.
cultural_context.en: In ancient China the dragon was seen as just and benevolent and tied to rain and rulers: for many the emperor was an incarnation of the rain-bringing dragon, villages held dragon dances to ask for rain, and the dragon is the fifth sign of the zodiac.

literal_meaning.en: serpent

who.id: Makhluk mirip ular raksasa dalam banyak budaya.
who.en: A giant serpent-like creature of many cultures.

origin.id: Cerita rakyat di seluruh dunia.
origin.en: Folklore worldwide.

role.id: Lambang kekuasaan dan pembawa hujan di Asia Timur, makhluk penjaga harta yang dikalahkan dalam tradisi Barat.
role.en: A symbol of power and bringer of rain in East Asia, a hoard-guarding creature that is slain in Western tradition.

famous_for.id: Sayap, cakar, dan semburan api.
famous_for.en: Wings, claws and fiery breath.

did_you_know.id: Penggambaran naga tertua yang diketahui adalah figur giok berbentuk C dari budaya Hongshan di Mongolia Dalam bagian timur, berusia antara 4500 dan 3000 SM.
did_you_know.en: The earliest known depiction of a dragon is a C-shaped jade figure of the Hongshan culture from eastern Inner Mongolia, dated between 4500 and 3000 BCE.

description.id: Naga Tiongkok dipercaya menguasai hujan, laut, dan air, serta dianggap bertanggung jawab atas angin kencang, hujan es, guntur, dan kilat.
description.en: Chinese dragons were thought to govern rain, sea and water and were held responsible for strong winds, hailstorms, thunder and lightning.

description.id: Naga Tiongkok dapat mengubah bentuk dan ukuran sesuka hati, dan dalam cerita rakyat naga tertentu dapat menjelma manusia.
description.en: The Chinese dragon can change shape and size at will, and in folk-tales some dragons can take human form.

description.id: Naga Tiongkok terbang disertai kilat dan guntur; dalam Beowulf naga api terbang ke gundukan makam.
description.en: The Chinese dragon flies accompanied by lightning and thunder; in Beowulf the fire-dragon flies to the barrows.

description.id: Dalam tradisi Barat naga digambarkan menyemburkan api; dalam Beowulf naga mulai menyemburkan api untuk membakar balai megah.
description.en: In the Western tradition dragons are depicted as fire-breathing; in Beowulf the dragon begins to vomit forth fire to burn the great manor.

description.id: Dalam mitos Yunani drakon dikalahkan pahlawan atau dewa, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia naga di budaya lain biasanya dibunuh pahlawan pemberani; dalam Beowulf Sigmund menghancurkan naga penjaga harta.
description.en: In Greek myth drakontes were defeated by heroes or gods, and according to the World History Encyclopedia dragons of other cultures are typically slain by a brave hero; in Beowulf Sigmund destroys a hoard-guarding dragon.

description.id: Naga yang menguasai hujan dan air, dipandang baik hati, dan lambang kaisar; digambarkan dengan tanduk rusa, cakar elang, sisik ikan mas, dan bagian tubuh hewan lain.
description.en: A dragon that governs rain and water, regarded as benevolent and emblem of the emperor; described with a stag's horns, eagle's claws, carp's scales and parts of other animals.

description.id: Menurut cerita rakyat dalam artikel itu, ada ras naga yang dipimpin raja naga Lung-Wang, dan menurut kepercayaan tradisional tiap Empat Laut dipimpin seorang raja naga.
description.en: According to the folk-tales in that article there is a race of dragons led by the Dragon-king Lung-Wang, and by traditional belief each of the Four Seas is presided over by a dragon king.

description.id: Ular besar bersifat gaib yang dalam mitos dikalahkan pahlawan atau dewa, tetapi dalam pemujaan dikaitkan dengan penyembuhan dan kekayaan.
description.en: A large serpent with supernatural qualities, defeated by heroes or gods in myth but associated with healing and wealth in cult.

description.id: Naga api penjaga harta yang terbang pada malam hari dan menyemburkan api.
description.en: A hoard-guarding fire-dragon that flies by night and spits fire.

title.en: A dragon helps Yu the Great

role.en: Helper of a ruler

summary.id: Menurut mitos Tiongkok, Yu Agung, pendiri legendaris dinasti Xia, dibantu seekor naga (atau sesungguhnya adalah naga) dan seekor kura-kura mengendalikan banjir di kerajaannya.
summary.en: In Chinese myth, Yu the Great, legendary founder of the Xia dynasty, got help from a dragon (or was in fact one himself) and a turtle in taming the floodwaters of his kingdom.

role.en: Fire-spewing guardian of a hoard

summary.id: Dalam puisi Beowulf, naga api menguasai balai harta karun selama tiga ratus musim dingin, terbang pada malam hari dikelilingi api, dan menyemburkan api untuk membakar balai megah.
summary.en: In the poem Beowulf, a fire-dragon holds a hoard-hall for three hundred winters, flies by night encompassed with fire, and spits fire to burn the great manor.

role.en: Dragon slain by a hero

summary.id: Beowulf mengisahkan Sigmund yang memperoleh kemuliaan besar karena menghancurkan naga besar penjaga harta.
summary.en: Beowulf tells how Sigmund won great glory by destroying the great dragon that guarded a hoard.

description.id: Tempat ditemukannya penggambaran naga tertua yang diketahui, figur giok berbentuk C.
description.en: Where the earliest known depiction of a dragon, a C-shaped jade figure, was found.

description.id: Budaya Hongshan menghasilkan penggambaran naga tertua yang diketahui, figur berbentuk C dari giok.
description.en: The Hongshan culture produced the earliest known depiction of a dragon, a C-shaped jade figure.

title.en: The dragon as emblem of imperial power

description.id: Sejak dinasti Han naga Tiongkok menjadi lambang kekuasaan kaisar.
description.en: From the Han dynasty onwards Chinese dragons were emblems of imperial power.

description.id: Kata dragon masuk ke bahasa Inggris dari bahasa Prancis Kuno.
description.en: The word dragon entered English from Old French.

note.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga Tiongkok bersisik mirip Naga, makhluk menyerupai ular dalam cerita rakyat Hindu yang menjaga sumber air.
note.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, scaly Chinese dragons are similar to the Nagas, snake-like creatures of Hindu folklore that protect water sources.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa naga dianggap baik di Asia Timur tetapi jahat di Eropa?
learning_questions.en: Why are dragons seen as good in East Asia but evil in Europe?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang dapat menjelaskan perbedaan peran naga dalam tarian hujan Tiongkok dan dalam kisah penjaga harta seperti Beowulf?
learning_questions.en: What might explain the difference between the dragon's role in Chinese rain dances and in hoard-guarding tales such as Beowulf?

summary.en: Western tradition: dragons are depicted as fire-breathing embodiments of evil associated with death; in Greek myth drakontes are defeated by heroes or gods.

short_description.id: Naga (dragon) adalah makhluk mitos dalam cerita rakyat berbagai budaya, berbentuk kurang lebih seperti ular dengan ciri hewan lain; di Asia Timur ia dianggap baik dan pembawa hujan, dalam tradisi Barat ia penyembur api.
short_description.en: The dragon is a mythical creature of the folklore of many cultures, roughly serpentine with features of other animals; in East Asia it is seen as benevolent and a rain-bringer, in Western tradition as a fire-breather.

long_description.id: Naga adalah makhluk mitos yang ditemukan dalam cerita rakyat berbagai budaya di seluruh dunia. Bentuknya kurang lebih seperti ular, sering dengan ciri dari hewan lain seperti sayap dan cakar, dan dalam hampir semua budaya ia dipandang sebagai makhluk yang kuat dan menggetarkan.
long_description.en: The dragon is a mythical creature found in the folklore of cultures worldwide. It is roughly serpentine, often with features drawn from other animals such as wings and claws, and in nearly all cultures it is seen as a powerful, awe-inspiring creature.

long_description.id: Makhluk mirip naga sudah muncul dalam seni Mesopotamia kuno, kadang bermusuhan kadang baik hati. Di Asia Timur naga umumnya dianggap makhluk baik: naga Tiongkok dipercaya menguasai hujan, laut, dan air, dan sejak dinasti Han menjadi lambang kekuasaan kaisar. Drakon Yunani kuno adalah ular besar bersifat gaib yang dalam mitos dikalahkan pahlawan atau dewa, sedangkan dalam pemujaan ia sosok lembut yang dikaitkan dengan penyembuhan dan kekayaan. Dalam tradisi Barat, naga digambarkan menyemburkan api dan melambangkan kejahatan serta kematian.
long_description.en: Creatures resembling dragons already appear in the art of ancient Mesopotamia, sometimes as foes and sometimes as friends. In East Asia dragons were mostly seen as benevolent: Chinese dragons were believed to rule over rain, seas and other waters, and from Han times they stood for the emperor's authority. Ancient Greek drakontes were huge snakes with uncanny powers, slain by gods or heroes in myth yet gentle bringers of healing and riches in worship. Western tradition, by contrast, pictures dragons breathing fire and standing for evil and death.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga Tiongkok paling sering digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa yang lentur, berdiam di sumber air atau awan, dan bila terbang disertai kilat dan guntur. Deskripsi tradisional memberinya tanduk rusa jantan, dahi unta, leher ular, sisik ikan mas, dan cakar elang, dan ia dapat mengubah bentuk serta ukurannya sesuka hati. Petani kuno menganggapnya pembawa hujan, sehingga di desa-desa diadakan tarian naga untuk memohon hujan, dan menurut keyakinan tradisional tiap Empat Laut dipimpin seorang raja naga.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the Chinese dragon is most often pictured as a giant, lithe creature living in water sources or clouds, flying amid lightning and thunder. The traditional description lends it a stag's horns, a camel's forehead, a snake's neck, a carp's scales and an eagle's claws, and it can alter its shape and size at will. Ancient farmers saw it as a bringer of rain, so villages held dragon dances to ask for rain, and by traditional belief each of the Four Seas has a dragon king.

long_description.id: Berbeda dari budaya lain tempat naga biasanya dibunuh pahlawan, naga di Tiongkok umumnya dipandang adil dan baik hati. Bagi banyak orang kaisar adalah penjelmaan naga pembawa hujan, naga menjadi shio kelima dalam zodiak, dan sebuah mitos menyebut naga membantu Yu Agung mengendalikan banjir. Penggambaran naga tertua yang diketahui adalah figur giok berbentuk C dari budaya Hongshan, berusia antara 4500 dan 3000 SM.
long_description.en: Unlike other cultures where the dragon is typically slain by a hero, the dragon in China was usually regarded as just and benevolent. For many the emperor was an incarnation of the rain-bringing dragon, the dragon is the fifth sign of the zodiac, and one myth has a dragon helping Yu the Great control the floods. The earliest known depiction of a dragon is a C-shaped jade figure of the Hongshan culture, dated between 4500 and 3000 BCE.

long_description.id: Dalam puisi Beowulf, terjemahan J. Lesslie Hall, naga api digambarkan terbang berapi-api ke gundukan makam pada malam hari, dan penghancur bangsa-bangsa itu menguasai balai hartanya selama tiga ratus musim dingin. Naga itu menyemburkan api untuk membakar balai megah, dan dalam puisi yang sama Sigmund memperoleh kemuliaan karena menghancurkan seekor naga penjaga harta. Perairan yang digambarkan puisi itu juga dipenuhi ular dan naga-danau.
long_description.en: In the poem Beowulf, in J. Lesslie Hall's translation, the fire-dragon is described as flying flaming to the barrows by night, and the waster of peoples held its hoard-hall for three hundred winters. The dragon spits fire to burn the great manor, and in the same poem Sigmund wins glory by destroying a hoard-guarding dragon. The waters it describes are also filled with serpents and mere-dragons.

long_description.id: Kata dragon masuk ke bahasa Inggris pada awal abad ke-13 dari bahasa Prancis Kuno, dari bahasa Latin draco, yang berasal dari bahasa Yunani drákōn, ular. Kata Yunani itu kemungkinan berasal dari kata kerja dérkomai, melihat, yang mungkin merujuk pada tatapan maut atau mata tajam. Naga juga muncul dalam karya fiksi modern, antara lain karya J. R. R. Tolkien, Ursula K. Le Guin, dan George R. R. Martin.
long_description.en: The word dragon reached English in the early 13th century by way of Old French and Latin draco from Greek drákōn, serpent. The Greek term probably grew from the verb dérkomai, to see, perhaps alluding to a lethal stare or piercing eyes. Dragons also loom large in modern fantasy, not least in the books of J. R. R. Tolkien, of Ursula K. Le Guin and of George R. R. Martin.

claims.quote: A dragon is a mythical creature found in the folklore of cultures throughout the world. It is roughly serpentine in form, and often possesses features drawn from different animals, such as wings and claws. In nearly all cultures, it is conceived of as a powerful and awe-inspiring creature.

statement.id: Naga adalah makhluk mitos dalam cerita rakyat berbagai budaya di dunia, berbentuk kurang lebih seperti ular dengan ciri hewan lain seperti sayap dan cakar, dan dipandang kuat serta menggetarkan.
statement.en: The dragon is a mythical creature of folklore worldwide, roughly serpentine with features like wings and claws, seen as powerful and awe-inspiring.

claims.quote: Dragon-like creatures appear in ancient Mesopotamian art, where they could be hostile or benevolent. In East Asia, dragons were usually regarded as positive beings; Chinese dragons were thought to govern the rain, the sea, and other forms of water, and from the Han dynasty onwards they were emblems of imperial power.

statement.id: Makhluk mirip naga muncul dalam seni Mesopotamia kuno; di Asia Timur naga umumnya makhluk baik, naga Tiongkok menguasai hujan, laut, dan air, dan sejak dinasti Han menjadi lambang kekuasaan kaisar.
statement.en: Dragon-like creatures appear in ancient Mesopotamian art; in East Asia dragons were usually positive, Chinese dragons governed rain, sea and water, and from the Han dynasty were imperial emblems.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek drakontes were large serpents endowed with supernatural qualities; in myth they were defeated by heroes or gods, whereas in cult they were gentle figures associated with healing and wealth. In the Western tradition, dragons have been depicted as fire-breathing embodiments of evil, associated with death.

statement.id: Drakon Yunani kuno adalah ular besar bersifat gaib yang dikalahkan pahlawan atau dewa dalam mitos tetapi dalam pemujaan dikaitkan dengan penyembuhan dan kekayaan; dalam tradisi Barat naga menyemburkan api dan melambangkan kejahatan serta kematian.
statement.en: Ancient Greek drakontes were supernatural serpents defeated by heroes or gods in myth but linked to healing and wealth in cult; in the Western tradition dragons are fire-breathing embodiments of evil and death.

claims.quote: The word dragon entered the English language in the early 13th century from Old French dragon, which, in turn, comes from Latin draco (genitive draconis), meaning "huge serpent, dragon", from Ancient Greek: δράκων, drákōn (genitive δράκοντος, drákontos) "serpent".

statement.id: Kata dragon masuk ke bahasa Inggris pada awal abad ke-13 dari bahasa Prancis Kuno, dari Latin draco ('ular besar'), dari Yunani Kuno δράκων (drákōn), 'ular'.
statement.en: The word dragon entered English in the early 13th century from Old French, from Latin draco ('huge serpent'), from Ancient Greek δράκων (drákōn), 'serpent'.

claims.quote: The Greek word δράκων is most likely derived from the Greek verb δέρκομαι (dérkomai) meaning "I see"

statement.id: Kata Yunani δράκων kemungkinan berasal dari kata kerja δέρκομαι (dérkomai), 'aku melihat', yang mungkin merujuk pada tatapan maut atau mata tajam.
statement.en: The Greek δράκων most likely derives from the verb δέρκομαι (dérkomai), 'I see', perhaps referring to a deadly glance or sharp eyes.

claims.quote: Dragons have featured in works of modern fiction by writers such as J. R. R. Tolkien, Ursula K. Le Guin, and George R. R. Martin.

statement.id: Naga muncul dalam karya fiksi modern penulis seperti J. R. R. Tolkien, Ursula K. Le Guin, dan George R. R. Martin.
statement.en: Dragons feature in modern fiction by writers such as J. R. R. Tolkien, Ursula K. Le Guin and George R. R. Martin.

claims.quote: One of the earliest creatures to appear in the tales and legends of ancient China, the dragon is most often depicted as a giant and lithe beast which dwells in either water sources or clouds. The Chinese dragon is extraordinarily powerful, and when it flies, it is usually accompanied by lightning and thunder.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga Tiongkok paling sering digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa yang lentur dan berdiam di sumber air atau awan; ia amat kuat, dan bila terbang biasanya disertai kilat dan guntur.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the Chinese dragon is most often depicted as a giant, lithe beast dwelling in water sources or clouds; it is extraordinarily powerful and, when it flies, is usually accompanied by lightning and thunder.

claims.quote: The traditional description gives it the horns of a stag, the forehead of a camel, the eyes of a demon, the neck of a snake, the belly of a sea-monster, the scales of a carp, the claws of an eagle, the pads of a tiger, and the ears of an ox.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, deskripsi tradisional naga Tiongkok memberinya tanduk rusa jantan, dahi unta, mata iblis, leher ular, perut makhluk laut, sisik ikan mas, cakar elang, telapak harimau, dan telinga sapi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the traditional description of the Chinese dragon gives it the horns of a stag, forehead of a camel, eyes of a demon, neck of a snake, belly of a sea-monster, scales of a carp, claws of an eagle, pads of a tiger and ears of an ox.

claims.quote: Other qualities of the dragon were that it could change its shape and size at will and disappear or reappear wherever it wished.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga Tiongkok dipercaya dapat mengubah bentuk dan ukurannya sesuka hati serta menghilang atau muncul di mana pun ia mau.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the Chinese dragon was believed able to change its shape and size at will and to disappear or reappear wherever it wished.

claims.quote: Despite the dragon's fearsome aspect, it was not usually seen as the bad-intentioned monster that inhabits the myths of other cultures around the world where it is typically slain by a brave hero figure. Indeed, in China, the dragon was and is regarded as being a just and benevolent creature.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, meski tampak menakutkan, naga di Tiongkok umumnya tidak dipandang sebagai monster jahat seperti dalam mitos budaya lain yang biasanya menampilkannya dibunuh pahlawan, melainkan makhluk yang adil dan baik hati.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, despite its fearsome aspect the dragon in China was not usually seen as the bad-intentioned monster of other cultures' myths, where it is typically slain by a hero, but as a just and benevolent creature.

claims.quote: Further, ancient farmers thought dragons brought much-needed rains and water to aid their crops. Dragons were also thought responsible for strong winds, hailstorms, thunder, lightning, and tornadoes

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, petani kuno menganggap naga membawa hujan dan air bagi tanaman mereka, dan naga juga dianggap bertanggung jawab atas angin kencang, hujan es, guntur, kilat, dan angin puyuh.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, ancient farmers thought dragons brought the rain and water their crops needed, and dragons were also held responsible for strong winds, hailstorms, thunder, lightning and tornadoes.

claims.quote: In rural communities, there was a dragon dance to induce the creature's generosity in dispensing rain and a procession where a large figure of a dragon made from paper or cloth spread over a wooden frame was carried.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di desa-desa Tiongkok ada tarian naga untuk membujuk kemurahan naga dalam menurunkan hujan, serta arak-arakan membawa patung naga besar dari kertas atau kain di atas rangka kayu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, rural communities in China held a dragon dance to induce the creature's generosity in dispensing rain, and a procession carrying a large dragon figure of paper or cloth over a wooden frame.

claims.quote: Another traditional belief was that the Four Seas of the world (to the ancient Chinese there were four and not seven) were each presided over by a dragon king.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kepercayaan tradisional menyatakan bahwa Empat Laut di dunia masing-masing dipimpin seorang raja naga.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, a traditional belief held that each of the Four Seas of the world was presided over by a dragon king.

claims.quote: Indeed, for many, the emperor was actually an incarnation of the supreme rain-bringing dragon.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, bagi banyak orang kaisar sesungguhnya adalah penjelmaan naga tertinggi pembawa hujan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, for many people the emperor was actually an incarnation of the supreme rain-bringing dragon.

claims.quote: The earliest known depiction of a dragon is a stylised C-shaped representation carved in jade. Found in eastern Inner Mongolia, it belonged to the Hongshan culture, which thrived between 4500 and 3000 BCE.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, penggambaran naga tertua yang diketahui adalah figur berbentuk C yang distilisasi dan diukir dari giok, ditemukan di Mongolia Dalam bagian timur, milik budaya Hongshan yang berkembang antara 4500 dan 3000 SM.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the earliest known depiction of a dragon is a stylised C-shaped figure carved in jade, found in eastern Inner Mongolia and belonging to the Hongshan culture, which thrived between 4500 and 3000 BCE.

claims.quote: In folk-tales, there was a race of dragons led by their Dragon-king Lung-Wang. With scaly bodies, four legs, and horns they could take on human form and whisk away young girls. They are similar to Nagas, the snake-like creatures of Hindu folklore which protect water sources.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia (dalam artikel tentang naga di Tiongkok kuno), dalam cerita rakyat ada ras naga yang dipimpin Raja Naga Lung-Wang; mereka bertubuh bersisik, berkaki empat, dan bertanduk, dapat menjelma manusia dan menculik gadis, dan mirip Naga, makhluk menyerupai ular dalam cerita rakyat Hindu yang menjaga sumber air.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia (in its article on the dragon in ancient China), folk-tales tell of a race of dragons led by their Dragon-king Lung-Wang; they have scaly bodies, four legs and horns, could take human form and whisk away young girls, and are similar to the Nagas, the snake-like creatures of Hindu folklore that protect water sources.

claims.quote: Finally, the dragon is the fifth sign of the Chinese zodiac or shengxiao

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga adalah shio kelima dalam zodiak Tiongkok.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the dragon is the fifth sign of the Chinese zodiac.

claims.quote: One famous myth tells of a dragon actively helping a ruler, Yu the Great (c. 2070 BCE), the legendary founder of the Xia dynasty, who was helped by a dragon (or actually was a dragon) and a turtle to manage the floodwaters which were devastating his kingdom and so control them into a better irrigation system.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebuah mitos terkenal menceritakan naga membantu penguasa Yu Agung, pendiri legendaris dinasti Xia, bersama seekor kura-kura mengendalikan banjir yang melanda kerajaannya menjadi sistem irigasi yang lebih baik.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, a famous myth tells of a dragon helping the ruler Yu the Great, legendary founder of the Xia dynasty, together with a turtle, to control the floodwaters devastating his kingdom and turn them into a better irrigation system.

claims.quote: He who flaming and fiery flies to the barrows, Naked war-dragon, nightly escapeth Encompassed with fire; men under heaven Widely beheld him.
claims.locator: Beowulf, Section XXXII (The Hoard and the Dragon)

statement.id: Dalam puisi Beowulf (terjemahan J. Lesslie Hall), naga api digambarkan terbang berapi-api ke gundukan makam dan keluar malam hari dikelilingi api, dan terlihat luas oleh orang di bawah langit.
statement.en: In the poem Beowulf (J. Lesslie Hall translation), the fire-dragon is described as flying flaming to the barrows and escaping by night encompassed with fire, widely seen by men under heaven.

claims.quote: So three-hundred winters the waster of peoples Held upon earth that excellent hoard-hall,
claims.locator: Beowulf, Section XXXII (The Hoard and the Dragon)

statement.id: Dalam Beowulf, penghancur bangsa-bangsa itu menguasai balai harta karun yang mulia selama tiga ratus musim dingin.
statement.en: In Beowulf, the waster of peoples held that excellent hoard-hall for three hundred winters.

claims.quote: The stranger began then to vomit forth fire, To burn the great manor; the blaze then glimmered For anguish to earlmen

statement.id: Dalam Beowulf, sang naga mulai menyemburkan api untuk membakar balai megah, dan nyala api itu membawa penderitaan bagi para bangsawan.
statement.en: In Beowulf, the dragon began to vomit forth fire to burn the great manor, and the blaze brought anguish to the earlmen.

claims.quote: To Sigmund accrued then No little of glory, when his life-days were over, Since he sturdy in struggle had destroyed the great dragon,

statement.id: Dalam Beowulf, Sigmund memperoleh kemuliaan besar ketika menghancurkan naga besar penjaga harta.
statement.en: In Beowulf, Sigmund won great glory when he destroyed the great dragon that guarded a hoard.

claims.quote: Many a serpent, mere-dragons wondrous Trying the waters, nickers a-lying
claims.locator: Beowulf, Section XXII (The water is filled with serpents and sea-dragons)

statement.id: Dalam Beowulf, perairan yang digambarkan dalam puisi itu dipenuhi ular dan naga-danau (mere-dragons) yang menakjubkan.
statement.en: In Beowulf, the waters described in the poem are filled with serpents and wondrous mere-dragons.

text.id: Arca Wisnu di Thailand berasal dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9; kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
text.en: Vishnu statues in Thailand date from the 4th to 9th century; the earliest grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan dipandang sebagai pelindung manusia yang menjaga tatanan (dharma).
cultural_context.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and is seen as the guardian of humanity who protects the order of things (dharma).

literal_meaning.id: meliputi segala; menurut Medhātith, yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya
literal_meaning.en: all pervasive; according to Medhātith, one who is everything and inside everything

who.id: Dewa pemelihara dalam agama Hindu.
who.en: The preserver god of Hinduism.

origin.id: Agama Hindu, terutama tradisi Waisnawa.
origin.en: Hinduism, especially Vaishnavism.

role.id: Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti dan pelindung dharma yang turun sebagai awatara.
role.en: The Preserver within the Trimurti and protector of dharma who descends as avatars.

famous_for.id: Sepuluh awatara, termasuk Rama dan Kresna, serta kisahnya sebagai Kurma, Varaha, Matsya, Vamana, dan Nara-Simha.
famous_for.en: His ten avatars, including Rama and Krishna, and his stories as Kurma, Varaha, Matsya, Vamana and Nara-Simha.

did_you_know.id: Wisnu juga disebut Trivikrama, 'yang bertiga langkah', karena dalam wujud Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah.
did_you_know.en: Vishnu is also called Trivikrama, 'of the three steps', because as Vamana he crossed the sky, the Earth and the Underworld in three steps.

description.id: Turun ke dunia dalam berbagai wujud awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya, untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melawan raksasa.
description.en: Descends in various avatar forms, as people, animals or a mix of both, to restore cosmic order and fight demons.

description.id: Wisnu bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra dan sering memegang kerang dan gada; Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada.
description.en: Vishnu is armed with the Sudarsanacakra discus and often holds a conch and a mace; the Vishnu Purana shows him with the shell, the discus and the mace.

name.id: Memberi kesempatan hidup abadi kepada para dewa
name.en: Giving the gods the chance of immortality

description.id: Dengan menjelma Maya, Wisnu mengambil nektar dari para raksasa dan memberikannya kepada para dewa.
description.en: By taking the form of Maya, Vishnu recovered the nectar from the demons and gave it to the gods.

title.en: The churning of the ocean of milk

role.en: Supporter of the mountain and giver of nectar

summary.id: Para dewa dan raksasa mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan gunung itu, sehingga Wisnu menopangnya sebagai kura-kura Kurma. Ia kemudian menjelma Maya untuk mengambil nektar dari para raksasa dan memberikannya kepada para dewa. Wisnu Purana juga menyebut Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
summary.en: The gods and demons churned the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki as a rope but could not handle the mountain, so Vishnu held it up as the tortoise Kurma. He then became Maya to take the nectar from the demons and give it to the gods. The Vishnu Purana likewise says that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

role.id: Babi hutan raksasa yang menyelamatkan Bumi
role.en: The gigantic boar who rescues the Earth

summary.id: Sebagai babi hutan raksasa Varaha, Wisnu bertarung seribu tahun melawan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi ke dasar laut, lalu mengangkat Bumi dengan taringnya.
summary.en: As the gigantic boar Varaha, Vishnu fought the giant Daitya for a thousand years after Hiranyaksha took the Earth to the bottom of the sea, then raised the Earth on his tusk.

short_description.id: Wisnu, juga disebut Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti yang turun ke dunia sebagai awatara.
short_description.en: Vishnu, also called Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism and the Preserver within the Trimurti, who descends to the world as avatars.

long_description.id: Wisnu, yang namanya berarti Yang Meliputi Segala, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, salah satu tradisi besar agama Hindu masa kini, dan dewa pemeliharaan. Dalam Trimurti, yang juga mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara, dan Lakshmi adalah pasangannya.
long_description.en: Vishnu, whose name means the All-Pervasive, is also called Narayana and Hari and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. Vaishnavism, one of the great Hindu traditions today, reveres him as the highest being and god of preservation. In the Trimurti, with Brahma and Shiva, he is the Preserver, and Lakshmi is his partner.

long_description.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya, Wisnu digambarkan sebagai makhluk mahatahu yang berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba, Kshira Sagara, bersama pasangannya, Lakshmi. Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun dalam wujud awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma. Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan dari kesepuluhnya Rama dan Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
long_description.en: In his benevolent aspects Vishnu is depicted as an omniscient being lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with his consort Lakshmi. Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, of whom Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya. Dalam wujud Kurma ia menopang gunung saat samudra diaduk, lalu menjelma Maya yang jelita untuk membuat para raksasa melepaskan nektar kepada para dewa. Sebagai Varaha ia mengangkat Bumi dari dasar laut setelah bertarung seribu tahun, sebagai Matsya ia membawa kapal bagi Manu, sebagai Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah, dan sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ia menjawab tantangan Hiranya-Kasipu. Wisnu Purana menambahkan bahwa Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menopang tongkat pengaduk.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars, as people, animals or a mix of both. As Kurma he held up the mountain while the ocean was churned and then became the beautiful Maya so that the demons would give up the nectar to the gods. As Varaha he raised the Earth from the sea bottom after a thousand-year fight, as Matsya he carried a ship for Manu, as Vamana he crossed the world in three steps, and as the man-lion Nara-Simha he answered Hiranya-Kasipu's challenge. The Vishnu Purana adds that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, supported the churning-stick.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru, kadang menunggang Garuda, dan bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang, gada atau pedang, dan teratai. Ia dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, dan dikaitkan dengan matahari lewat nama Surya Narayana. Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada, serta menyebut Janārddana sebagai pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue, sometimes rides Garuda and bears the Sudarsanacakra discus; in his four hands he often holds a conch, a mace or sword, and a lotus. He is considered to dwell in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru and is linked with the sun through the name Surya Narayana. The Vishnu Purana shows him seated on Garuda with the shell, discus and mace, and calls Janārddana the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan ia memiliki tiga istri: Lakshmi, Sarasvati, dan Ganga, dua yang terakhir akhirnya ia kirim kepada Brahma dan Siwa. Menurut Wikipedia, arca Wisnu berlengan empat dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9 ditemukan di Thailand dan mirip dengan arca di India kuno, dan sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and has three wives, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Ganga, the latter two eventually sent to Brahma and Shiva. According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu from the 4th to 9th century have been found in Thailand and mirror those of ancient India, and some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

statement.en: The name Vishnu (Sanskrit: विष्णु, also spelled Viṣṇu) means 'all pervasive'.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of men, he protects the order of things (dharma), and he appears on earth in various incarnations (avatars) to fight demons and to maintain cosmic harmony.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah pemelihara dan pelindung manusia yang menjaga dharma dan muncul di bumi dalam berbagai awatara untuk melawan raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of humanity who protects dharma and appears on earth in various avatars to fight demons.

claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods. However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk mengaduk samudra para dewa dan raksasa memakai Gunung Mandara dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan bebannya sehingga memanggil Wisnu, yang menopang gunung itu di punggungnya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to churn the ocean the gods and demons used Mount Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, but could not handle its weight and called on Vishnu, who held the mountain on his shell in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise.

claims.quote: according to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), 'one who is everything and inside everything'

statement.id: Menurut Medhātith (sekitar 1000 M), Wisnu berarti 'yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya'.
statement.en: According to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), Vishnu means 'one who is everything and inside everything'.
