statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar; sebagai tanda kedudukannya yang unggul, dalam beberapa kisah Brahma dianggap lahir dari bunga teratai yang tumbuh dari pusar Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect; to illustrate his superior status, in some accounts Brahma is born from a lotus flower that grew from Vishnu's navel.

claims.quote: Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (the goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (the goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (the goddess who is the personification of the River Ganges). However, unable to live with the quarrels between his three wives, Vishnu eventually sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menikah dengan Lakshmi (dewi keberuntungan), Sarasvati (dewi kebijaksanaan), dan Ganga (personifikasi Sungai Gangga), tetapi karena pertengkaran istri-istrinya ia mengirim Ganga kepada Siwa dan Sarasvati kepada Brahma.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (personification of the River Ganges), but unable to bear their quarrels he sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

claims.quote: He is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and fabulous jewels and where there are lakes resplendent with lotus flowers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, tempat segalanya terbuat dari emas berkilau dan permata, dengan danau-danau yang dipenuhi teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and jewels and lakes are resplendent with lotus flowers.

claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara atau penampakan duniawi, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.quote: As Varaha, the gigantic boar, he defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha had mischievously taken the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea. The incredible fight between the two lasted for a thousand years but Vishnu prevailed and finally raised the Earth from the watery depths, carrying it on his tusk.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai Varaha, babi hutan raksasa, Wisnu mengalahkan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi (Bhumi-devi) ke dasar laut; setelah pertarungan seribu tahun, Wisnu menang dan mengangkat Bumi dari kedalaman dengan taringnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, as Varaha, the gigantic boar, Vishnu defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha took the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea; after a fight lasting a thousand years Vishnu prevailed and raised the Earth from the depths on his tusk.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menjelma Maya yang jelita (personifikasi Ilusi) hingga para raksasa terpedaya dan melepaskan nektar, yang lalu ia berikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang hidup abadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu took the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion), so that the distracted Demons relinquished the nectar, which he gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.quote: Vishnu appears as another avatar in the form of the fish Matsya. Manu, the sage and son of Vivsavat-Sun, was washing in a river one day when a small fish suddenly jumped into his hand. ... Vishnu then reappeared on the scene as the gigantic fish, this time with golden scales and a single horn, and carrying the promised ship for Manu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu muncul sebagai awatara ikan Matsya yang melompat ke tangan Manu; kelak ia tampil sebagai ikan raksasa bersisik emas dan bertanduk satu yang membawa kapal bagi Manu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appears as the avatar of the fish Matsya, who jumped into the hand of Manu; later he reappears as the gigantic fish with golden scales and a single horn carrying the promised ship for Manu.

claims.quote: Vishnu was persuaded by the gods to interrupt his meditations and confront the giant warrior Bali, which he did in the form of a dwarf Brahman (or priest) called Vamana. ... with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and, with his final step, the Underworld, thus leaving nothing for the poor giants.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu confronted the giant warrior Bali as a dwarf Brahman called Vamana; with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and with the last the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is often also called Trivikrama, meaning 'of the three steps'.

claims.quote: Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu (King of the Asuras or Demons) not only impiously called for people to worship him as a god but also foolishly challenged Vishnu to show himself there and then if the god really were omnipresent.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu, King of the Asuras, called on people to worship him as a god and challenged Vishnu to show himself if he were really omnipresent.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hindu art Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature that devours snakes.

claims.quote: His weapon is the Sudarsanacakra or discus (chakra), perhaps representative of his association with the sun but also, with its thousand spokes, symbolic of the wheel of time. He often holds various other objects in his (usually) four hands such as a conch shell trumpet which sounds the Creation, a mace (gada) or a sword which represents strength, and a lotus

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu's weapon is the Sudarsanacakra discus, perhaps representing his link with the sun and the wheel of time; in his usually four hands he often holds a conch shell trumpet that sounds the Creation, a mace or sword representing strength, and a lotus.

claims.quote: Certainly, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names suggests - Surya Narayana.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names, Surya Narayana, suggests.

claims.quote: Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, apa pun yang dilahirkan makhluk hidup dianggap bagian Hari, dan apa pun yang membinasakan makhluk dianggap bagian Janārddana sebagai Rudra; dengan demikian Janārddana adalah pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, whatever is generated by a living being is considered a portion of Hari, and whatever destroys a living being the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra; in this way Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

claims.quote: And, O mighty ascetic, remaining in the midst of the Milky sea in the shape of a tortoise, the revered Hari himself became the support of the churning-stick.

statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the revered Hari himself, in the shape of a tortoise in the midst of the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi, terutama di Bengal dan Udupi; Wikipedia mencatat kelahirannya dirayakan umat Hindu setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, dan dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan petualangannya yang paling populer.
cultural_context.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god, especially in Bengal and Udupi; Wikipedia records that Hindus celebrate his birthday each year at Krishna Janmashtami, and in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene of his adventures.

description.en: Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains; the Vishnu Purana says he held it with one hand as if in sport.

description.en: He enchanted the gopis with his divine flute playing.

description.id: Ia membunuh atau menghajar musuh seperti Putana, Kaliya, dan Kamsa; Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menindih Kansa hingga tewas dan bertekad membunuh Kāliya.
description.en: He killed or thrashed enemies such as Putana, Kaliya and Kamsa; the Vishnu Purana says he crushed Kansa to death and resolved to slay Kāliya.

description.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya yang tak terhingga lalu kembali ke wujud Krishna yang dikenal Arjuna.
description.en: In the Bhagavad Gita he shows Arjuna all his infinite semblances and then returns to the form of Krishna that Arjuna knew.

description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel.

role.id: Anak kedelapan yang disembunyikan dari Kamsa

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Krishna lahir di Mathura dari Devaki dan Wasudewa tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa yang diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan telah membunuh tujuh anak sebelumnya, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana. Wisnu Purana menyebut suara dari langit yang memperingatkan Kansa.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, had killed seven children before, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana. The Vishnu Purana tells of the voice from the sky that warned Kansa.

role.en: Protector of his community

summary.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia banjir itu dikirim Indra, dan menurut Wisnu Purana ia menahan gunung dengan satu tangan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam sementara awan Indra menurunkan hujan.
summary.en: Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill to shelter his community from devastating rains. According to the World History Encyclopedia the deluge was sent by Indra, and according to the Vishnu Purana he held the mountain with one hand for seven days and nights while Indra's clouds poured rain.

role.en: Rescuer of Vraja from the poisonous serpent

summary.id: Wisnu Purana menceritakan Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, lalu bertekad membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja bebas dari rasa takut; World History Encyclopedia menyebut Kaliya di antara musuh yang ia kalahkan.
summary.en: The Vishnu Purana tells how Krishna saw the pool of the serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolved to slay it so that Vraja's people would be free of fear; the World History Encyclopedia lists Kaliya among the enemies he defeated.

role.en: Vanquisher of the tyrant

summary.id: Krishna mengalahkan tiran Kamsa dan kemudian menjadi raja Mathura; dalam Wisnu Purana ia menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan menimpanya hingga Kansa tewas.
summary.en: Krishna dealt with the tyrant Kamsa and afterwards became king of Mathura; in the Vishnu Purana he seizes Kansa by the hair, throws him to the ground and falls upon him until Kansa dies.

role.en: Charioteer and teacher

summary.id: Krishna menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita. Dalam Gita ia menyatakan dirinya Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk dan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya; ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya.
summary.en: Krishna was Arjuna's charioteer in the war at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita. In the Gita he declares himself the Spirit in every creature's heart, and, according to the World History Encyclopedia, that the whole universe was created by him; he shows Arjuna all his semblances.

summary.en: Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating him, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

short_description.id: Kresna, juga disebut Govinda, Madhava, dan Gopala, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu sekaligus Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, tokoh sentral Mahabharata dan penyampai Bhagavad Gita.
short_description.en: Krishna, known too as Govinda, Madhava and Gopala, is a leading Hindu god honoured both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the supreme deity, a central figure of the Mahabharata and teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.

long_description.id: Kresna, juga dikenal sebagai Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan banyak nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dan dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya. Hari kelahirannya dirayakan setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, yang jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September.
long_description.en: Krishna, called also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and by many other names, is one of the great gods of Hinduism. Devotees honour him both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the highest god in his own right, cherishing him for his love, mercy, protection and gentleness. His birth is celebrated each year at Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.

long_description.id: Kresna sering digambarkan berkulit gelap sesuai arti namanya, hitam atau gelap. Menurut Wikipedia, ia tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, yang menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, perannya ganda: ia penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.
long_description.en: Artists often give Krishna dark skin, matching his name, which means black or dark. According to Wikipedia he figures centrally in texts including Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana and Bhagavad Gita, which present him as divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and at times a cowherd. According to the World History Encyclopedia his role is twofold: he punishes human deeds yet also brings enlightenment.

long_description.id: Ia lahir di Mathura dari Dewaki dan Wasudewa, tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa, yang telah diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan, membunuh tujuh anak lebih dahulu, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana tempat ia tumbuh sebagai penggembala yang memikat para gopi.
long_description.en: He was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva, but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, killed seven children first, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana, where he grew up as a cowherd who stirred the hearts of the gopis.

long_description.id: Kisah hidupnya memuat banyak keajaiban: ia memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya dan mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahan gunung itu dengan satu tangan, bertekad membunuh ular Kāliya, dan menindih Kansa hingga tewas. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia juga mengalahkan Putana, Kaliya, dan Pancajana, dan mencuri pohon Parijata dari Indra.
long_description.en: Wonders run through his story: his flute charmed the gopis, and he raised Govardhan Hill as a shelter for his people against torrential rain. The Vishnu Purana says he held the mountain with one hand, resolved to slay the serpent Kāliya and crushed Kansa to death. According to the World History Encyclopedia he also overcame Putana, Kaliya and Pancajana and stole the Parijata tree from Indra.

long_description.id: Kemudian ia mendirikan kota Dvaraka dan menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang Kurukshetra. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita pada malam sebelum perang; dalam Gita ia menyatakan seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya, dan dalam terjemahan Arnold Krishna berkata ia adalah Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk, memperlihatkan semua rupa-Nya kepada Arjuna, lalu kembali ke rupa Krishna yang dikenalnya. Ia tewas oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, dan tujuh hari kemudian Dvaraka tenggelam.
long_description.en: He went on to found the city of Dvaraka and drive Arjuna's chariot in the Kurukshetra War. According to the World History Encyclopedia he recounted the Bhagavad Gita on the eve of the battle; in the Gita he states that the whole universe was created by him, and in Arnold's translation Krishna says he is the Spirit in every creature's heart, shows Arjuna all his semblances and then returns to the Krishna form Arjuna knew. He was killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, and seven days later Dvaraka was submerged.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan ia terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi, dengan hari kelahirannya dirayakan pada Krishna Janmashtami. Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya berkulit gelap, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambut, dan memainkan seruling; dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan yang paling populer, antara lain di Angkor Wat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia mungkin pahlawan paling populer dalam mitologi Hindu.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi, with his birthday celebrated at Krishna Janmashtami. In Hindu art he typically has dark skin, a yellow robe, a peacock feather in his hair and a flute; in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene, at sites such as Angkor Wat. The World History Encyclopedia calls him perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

claims.quote: also known as Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, and other names and titles is a major deity in Hinduism. He is worshipped as the eighth avatar of Vishnu and as the Supreme God in his own right. He is widely revered for his divine qualities of love, compassion, protection, and tenderness.

statement.id: Kresna (कृष्ण), juga Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya.
statement.en: Krishna (कृष्ण), also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and other names, is a major Hindu deity worshipped as the eighth avatar of Vishnu and as Supreme God in his own right, revered for love, compassion, protection and tenderness.

claims.quote: Krishna's birthday is celebrated every year by Hindus on Krishna Janmashtami, according to the lunisolar Hindu calendar, which falls in late August or early September of the Gregorian calendar.

statement.id: Hari kelahiran Kresna dirayakan umat Hindu setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, akhir Agustus atau awal September.
statement.en: Krishna's birthday is celebrated by Hindus every year on Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.

claims.quote: Krishna is often depicted in dark skin in accordance with meaning of his name, "black" or "dark".

statement.id: Krishna sering digambarkan berkulit gelap sesuai arti namanya, 'hitam' atau 'gelap'.
statement.en: Krishna is often depicted in dark skin in accordance with the meaning of his name, 'black' or 'dark'.

claims.quote: Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva, but was raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his maternal uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa.

statement.id: Kresna lahir di Mathura dari Dewaki dan Wasudewa, tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, raja zalim Kamsa.
statement.en: Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa.

claims.quote: he enchanted the gopis with his divine flute playing, performed the celestial Rasa Lila, and lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains. He later defeated Kamsa and restored order in Mathura. He went on to establish the city of Dvaraka and played a central role in the Kurukshetra War, serving as Arjuna’s charioteer

statement.id: Krishna memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya, mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat, mengalahkan Kamsa, mendirikan kota Dvaraka, dan berperan penting dalam perang Kurukshetra sebagai kusir kereta Arjuna.
statement.en: Krishna enchanted the gopis with his flute, lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains, defeated Kamsa, founded the city of Dvaraka and played a central role in the Kurukshetra War as Arjuna's charioteer.

claims.quote: Krishna (Krsna or Hari Krishna) is a major god of the Hindu pantheon and considered the eighth incarnation of Vishnu. He is perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna (Krsna atau Hari Krishna) adalah dewa utama jajaran dewa Hindu, dianggap inkarnasi kedelapan Wisnu, dan mungkin yang paling populer di antara para pahlawan mitologi Hindu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna (Krsna or Hari Krishna) is a major god of the Hindu pantheon, considered the eighth incarnation of Vishnu, and perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

claims.quote: He is a central figure in the Mahabharata, the Bhagavata Purana, the Brahma Vaivarta Purana, and the Bhagavad Gita, and is mentioned in many Hindu philosophical, theological, and mythological texts. These texts describes him as a divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer, and sometimes a cowherd.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Krishna adalah tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, dan teks-teks itu menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna is a central figure in the Mahabharata, the Bhagavata Purana, the Brahma Vaivarta Purana and the Bhagavad Gita, and these texts describe him as a divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and sometimes a cowherd.

claims.quote: Krishna's adventures appear in the Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa, and the sacred texts known as the Puranas where he is described as the Supreme Being and creator of the universe.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, petualangan Krishna muncul dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa, dan Purana, yang menyebutnya Yang Mahatinggi dan pencipta alam semesta.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's adventures appear in the Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa and the Puranas, where he is described as the Supreme Being and creator of the universe.

claims.quote: One day Vishnu, the great Hindu god pulled two hairs from his own head, one white and one black. The black hair was planted into the womb of Devaki, a princess of the city of Mathura

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut, putih dan hitam; rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki, putri kota Mathura, dan lahirlah Krishna.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs from his head, one white and one black; the black hair was planted into the womb of Devaki, a princess of the city of Mathura, and Krishna was born.

claims.quote: Unfortunately for Krishna his mother's brother, Kamsa, had been warned that Devaki's eighth child would kill him, and so Kamsa determined to murder the eighth child, a crime he had already carried out seven times before Krishna was born.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Kamsa, saudara laki-laki ibu Krishna, diperingatkan bahwa anak kedelapan Devaki akan membunuhnya, sehingga ia membunuh tujuh anak sebelum Krishna lahir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Kamsa, his mother's brother, had been warned that Devaki's eighth child would kill him and had killed seven children before Krishna was born.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vasudeva took the precaution of hiding Krishna in the remote village of Vrindavana where the boy was brought up as a simple cowherd (in this guise he can be referred to as Govinda).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di desa terpencil Vrindavana, tempat ia dibesarkan sebagai penggembala sederhana yang dapat disebut Govinda.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vasudeva hid Krishna in the remote village of Vrindavana, where he was brought up as a simple cowherd who can be called Govinda.

claims.quote: There he spent an idyllic childhood and stirred the hearts of many gopis or herd-women with his dark good looks, playful charm, and mastery of music and dance.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna menghabiskan masa kecil yang indah dan memikat banyak gopi dengan ketampanannya yang gelap, pesonanya yang jenaka, serta keahliannya bermusik dan menari.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna spent an idyllic childhood and stirred the hearts of many gopis with his dark good looks, playful charm and mastery of music and dance.

claims.quote: Krishna's dual role is as the punisher of human deeds but also as a bringer of enlightenment.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran ganda Krishna adalah sebagai penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's dual role is as the punisher of human deeds but also as a bringer of enlightenment.

claims.quote: Krishna's foster parents at Vrindavana were Nanda and Yashoda, his sister is Subhadra, and his brother Balarama. Krishna's favourite consort was the cowherd woman Radha

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, orang tua asuh Krishna di Vrindavana adalah Nanda dan Yashoda, saudarinya Subhadra, saudaranya Balarama, dan selir kesayangannya Radha, perempuan penggembala.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's foster parents at Vrindavana were Nanda and Yashoda, his sister is Subhadra, his brother Balarama, and his favourite consort the cowherd woman Radha.

claims.quote: Queen Rukmini, an earthly form of the goddess Lakshmi, is considered Krishna's second most favoured wife after Radha. With Rukmini, Krishna had a son, Pradyumna, and a daughter, Carumati.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Ratu Rukmini, wujud duniawi dewi Lakshmi, dianggap istri kesayangan kedua Krishna setelah Radha, dan dari Rukmini Krishna memiliki putra Pradyumna serta putri Carumati.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Queen Rukmini, an earthly form of the goddess Lakshmi, is considered Krishna's second most favoured wife after Radha, and with Rukmini Krishna had a son, Pradyumna, and a daughter, Carumati.

claims.quote: Notable amongst these are his various killings and thrashings of prominent enemies such as the ogress Putana, the giant bull danava, the giant snake Kaliya, and the king of the Hayas (horses). Also swiftly dealt with was the scheming tyrant Kamsa – after whose beheading Krishna established himself as king of Mathura.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna membunuh dan menghajar musuh-musuh terkemuka seperti raksasi Putana, banteng danava raksasa, ular raksasa Kaliya, dan raja Haya (kuda), serta mengalahkan tiran Kamsa, setelah itu ia menjadi raja Mathura.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna killed and thrashed prominent enemies such as the ogress Putana, the giant bull danava, the giant snake Kaliya and the king of the Hayas (horses), and dealt with the tyrant Kamsa, after whose beheading he became king of Mathura.

claims.quote: the sea-demon Pancajana who looked like a conch shell and who lost his magic shell to Krishna which the hero carried thereafter and used as a trumpet.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, iblis laut Pancajana yang menyerupai kerang kehilangan kerang saktinya kepada Krishna, yang sejak itu membawanya dan memakainya sebagai trompet.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the sea-demon Pancajana, who looked like a conch shell, lost his magic shell to Krishna, who carried it thereafter and used it as a trumpet.

claims.quote: Krishna also found time to lift the mountain Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, to conquer Saubha, the floating city of the Titans (daityas), got the better of the sea-god Varuna, and even managed to steal the divine discus possessed by the fire-god Agni.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana untuk menggagalkan banjir dahsyat kiriman Indra, menaklukkan Saubha kota terapung para Titan, mengungguli dewa laut Varuna, dan mencuri cakram ilahi milik dewa api Agni.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna lifted Mount Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, conquered Saubha, the floating city of the Titans, got the better of the sea-god Varuna and stole the divine discus of the fire-god Agni.

claims.quote: Krishna acted as the warrior-prince Arjuna's charioteer in the Great War, the Battle of Kurukshetra, between the Pandavas (whom Krishna supported) and the Kauravas. It was on the eve of this battle that Krishna recounted the sacred song of the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna menjadi kusir kereta pangeran-pejuang Arjuna dalam Perang Besar di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa (yang ia dukung) dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita kepada Arjuna.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna acted as the warrior-prince Arjuna's charioteer in the Great War at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas (whom he supported) and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna.

claims.quote: It is in the Bhagavad Gita that Krishna also states that 'All this universe has been created by me; all things exist in me'. Arjuna, in the same work, tells us that Krishna is 'divine, prior to the gods, unborn, omnipresent'.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam Bhagavad Gita Krishna menyatakan bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya dan segala sesuatu ada di dalam dirinya, dan Arjuna menyebutnya ilahi, mendahului para dewa, tak dilahirkan, dan mahahadir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in the Bhagavad Gita Krishna states that the whole universe was created by him and all things exist in him, and Arjuna calls him divine, prior to the gods, unborn and omnipresent.

claims.quote: In other adventures Krishna built the great fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat, known as the 'City of Gates'. Seven days after Krishna was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, Dvaraka was submerged beneath the ocean.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna membangun kota benteng Dvaraka di Gujarat, dijuluki Kota Gerbang; tujuh hari setelah ia tewas secara tak sengaja oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, Dvaraka tenggelam di bawah laut.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna built the fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat, known as the 'City of Gates'; seven days after he was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, Dvaraka was submerged beneath the ocean.

claims.quote: Krishna had also stolen the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating the god in the process. Krishna planted the tree at Dvaraka, but upon his death it was returned to Indra.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna mencuri pohon suci Parijata dari Indra dan mengalahkannya, menanamnya di Dvaraka, tetapi setelah ia wafat pohon itu dikembalikan kepada Indra.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating the god, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

claims.quote: The worship of Krishna may have started as early as the 5th century BCE. Today he is worshipped as the supreme Hindu god by many believers, and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi in southern India.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pemujaan Krishna mungkin bermula sedini abad ke-5 SM; kini ia dipuja banyak orang sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi di India selatan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the worship of Krishna may have started as early as the 5th century BCE; today many believers worship him as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi in southern India.

claims.quote: Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with a dark skin (usually blue-black), and he may carry the cakra discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki – both given to him by Agni. He typically wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his long black hair, and commonly plays a flute.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Krishna biasanya digambarkan berkulit gelap (biasanya biru-hitam), dapat membawa cakram Vajranabha dan gada Kaumodaki pemberian Agni, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambutnya, dan umumnya memainkan seruling.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with dark skin (usually blue-black), may carry the discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki given by Agni, wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his hair and commonly plays a flute.

claims.quote: In Khmer art the most popular scene of Krishna's adventures is the lifting of Mt. Govardhana, and the god is frequently represented in the architectural sculpture at such famous sites as Angkor Wat.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Khmer adegan petualangan Krishna yang paling populer adalah pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana, yang sering terpahat pada arsitektur di situs terkenal seperti Angkor Wat.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Khmer art the most popular scene of Krishna's adventures is the lifting of Mt. Govardhana, frequently represented in architectural sculpture at famous sites such as Angkor Wat.

claims.quote: Its simple plot consists of a dialogue held by Prince Arjuna, the brother of King Yudhisthira, with Krishna, the Supreme Deity, wearing the disguise of a charioteer.

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahan Edwin Arnold, alur Bhagavad Gita berupa dialog Pangeran Arjuna dengan Krishna, Dewa Tertinggi yang menyamar sebagai kusir kereta.
statement.en: In the preface to Edwin Arnold's translation, the plot of the Bhagavad Gita is a dialogue between Prince Arjuna and Krishna, the Supreme Deity, wearing the disguise of a charioteer.

claims.quote: I am the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart; From Me they come; by Me they live; at My word they depart!

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna berkata bahwa ia adalah Roh yang bersemayam dalam hati setiap makhluk; dari-Nya mereka datang, oleh-Nya mereka hidup, dan atas titah-Nya mereka pergi.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna says he is the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart; from him they come, by him they live, and at his word they depart.

claims.quote: Vishnu of the Adityas I am, those Lords of Light ... of Rudras Sankara

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna berkata bahwa di antara para Aditya ia adalah Wisnu dan di antara para Rudra ia adalah Sankara.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna says that among the Adityas he is Vishnu and among the Rudras he is Sankara.

claims.quote: I show thee all my semblances, infinite, rich, divine, My changeful hues, my countless forms.

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya yang tak terhingga, kaya, dan ilahi, dengan warna-warna yang berubah dan wujud yang tak terhitung.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna shows Arjuna all his semblances, infinite, rich and divine, with changeful hues and countless forms.

claims.quote: Once more I am thy Krishna, the form thou knew'st of old!

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), setelah menampakkan wujud-Nya yang menakjubkan, Krishna berkata kepada Arjuna bahwa ia kembali menjadi Krishna dengan rupa yang dikenalnya dahulu.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), after showing his awesome form, Krishna tells Arjuna that he is once more the Krishna of the form he knew of old.

claims.quote: Having thus made up his mind, Krishna immediately upheld the mountain Govardhana with one hand as if in sport ... For seven days and nights did the vast clouds, despatched by Indra, pour down showers upon the Gokula of Nanda, to destroy the dwellers, but they were protected by the height of the mountain.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana dengan satu tangan seolah bermain, dan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam awan kiriman Indra menurunkan hujan atas Gokula milik Nanda tetapi para penghuninya terlindung oleh ketinggian gunung itu.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna upheld Mount Govardhana with one hand as if in sport, and for seven days and nights the clouds sent by Indra poured showers on the Gokula of Nanda, but its dwellers were protected by the height of the mountain.

claims.quote: There he saw the pool with the dreadful serpent Kāliya, boiling with the fires of poison ... I must slay this serpent, so that the inhabitants of Vraja may live here happily freed from fear.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular dahsyat Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, dan berniat membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja hidup bahagia tanpa rasa takut.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna sees the pool with the dreadful serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolves to slay it so that the inhabitants of Vraja may live happily freed from fear.

claims.quote: laid hold of him by the hair of his head, and struck his tiara to the ground: then casting him down upon the earth, Govinda threw himself upon him. Crushed by the weight of the upholder of the universe, the son of Ugrasena, Kansa the king, gave up the ghost.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkan mahkotanya, lalu menjatuhkan Kansa ke tanah dan menimpanya, sehingga Kansa, putra Ugrasena, tewas tertindih beban sang penopang alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna seizes Kansa by the hair, strikes his tiara to the ground and throws him down and falls upon him, so that Kansa, the son of Ugrasena, gives up the ghost, crushed by the weight of the upholder of the universe.

claims.quote: A voice was heard in the sky, loud and deep as thunder, which addressing Kansa, said—"O foolish, the eighth child of this damsel, whom thou art carrying in the car, along with her husband, shall destroy thy life".

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, sebuah suara dari langit berkata kepada Kansa bahwa anak kedelapan Devaki akan mengakhiri hidupnya.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, a voice from the sky tells Kansa that the eighth child of Devaki shall destroy his life.

claims.quote: the supreme deity plucked off two hairs, one white and one black and said to the celestials ... This, my black hair, shall be impersonated in the eighth conception of the goddess-like Devaki, the wife of Vasudeva and shall destroy Kansa

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Sang Dewa Tertinggi mencabut dua helai rambut, putih dan hitam, dan menyatakan bahwa rambut hitamnya akan menjelma dalam kandungan kedelapan Devaki, istri Wasudewa, dan akan membinasakan Kansa.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the supreme deity plucks off two hairs, one white and one black, and declares that his black hair shall be impersonated in the eighth conception of Devaki, the wife of Vasudeva, and shall destroy Kansa.

text.en: Known in ancient Greek religion; the Delphic oracle was already well visited in the 8th century BCE.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia sangat dicintai kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
cultural_context.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence on the Greeks than any other god. According to the World History Encyclopedia he was much loved most likely because of his links with music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.

literal_meaning.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkannya dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
literal_meaning.en: Its origin is unclear; the Greeks most often linked it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

description.id: Sebagai dewa orakel Delphi, nubuat Apollo sering dimintai petunjuk dalam berbagai urusan.
description.en: As god of the Delphic oracle, Apollo's prophecies were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

description.en: Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, directly or through his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics.

description.id: Dengan panahnya Apollo dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah; kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panahnya.
description.en: With his arrows Apollo could bring ill health and plague; sudden deaths were believed to be the effect of his arrows.

summary.en: Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos. At his first taste of ambrosia he was said to become a man at once, and was then given a bow made by Hephaestus.

role.en: Slayer of the serpent and master of the oracle

summary.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular Python dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingatinya. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: Apollodorus menyebut Themis, Hyginus menyebut Python sendiri.
summary.en: According to legend Apollo created the oracle where he killed the serpent Python, and the Pythian games began in its memory. Classical sources differ on who held the oracle earlier: Apollodorus names Themis, Hyginus names Python himself.

summary.en: As a baby Hermes stole Apollo's sacred cattle. He was allowed to keep them after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented from a tortoiseshell.

role.id: Pelindung bangsa Troya dan pembawa wabah

summary.id: Dalam Iliad Apollo berpihak kepada bangsa Troya, menyelamatkan Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos, membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles.
summary.en: In the Iliad Apollo sides with the Trojans, saves Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos, brings plague on the Achaeans, and guides Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles.

summary.en: Zeus killed Asclepius for bringing a mortal back to life. Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes and, as punishment, had to serve Admetus of Therae for a year as a shepherd.

role.en: Punisher of boasting

summary.id: Bersama Artemis, Apollo menewaskan putra-putra Niobe yang menyombongkan kesuburannya. Ia juga mengalahkan satir Marsyas dalam adu musik dan menguliti sang satir hidup-hidup.
summary.en: With Artemis, Apollo slew the sons of Niobe, who boasted of her fertility. He also beat the satyr Marsyas in a music contest and had him flayed alive.

short_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis.
short_description.en: Apollo is one of the Olympian gods of ancient Greek religion and myth, with functions including light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis.

long_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi yang mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan. Ia putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos. Menurut theoi.com, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang. Busurnya, menurut World History Encyclopedia, dibuat oleh Hephaestus.
long_description.en: Apollo is a god of the Olympian circle in ancient Greek religion and mythology. Light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery all fall within his domains. Zeus and Leto are his parents and Artemis is his twin; the World History Encyclopedia places his birth on the island of Delos. Theoi.com says he was pictured as a handsome youth, beardless and long-haired. The same encyclopedia says his bow was made by Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk. Menurut legenda yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, ia mendirikan orakel itu di tempat ia membunuh ular Python, dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingati kematian makhluk itu. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: menurut Apollodorus orakel itu milik Themis, sedangkan menurut Hyginus milik Python sendiri.
long_description.en: Apollo, patron god of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and people often sought guidance from his oracles. A legend recorded by the World History Encyclopedia says he founded the oracle on the spot where he killed the serpent Python, and that the Pythian games began in memory of that creature. Classical sources disagree about who held the oracle before him: Apollodorus names Themis, while Hyginus says Python held it himself.

long_description.id: Apollo umumnya dipandang sebagai dewa penolong yang menolak kejahatan, bergelar Alexicacus. Ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah, tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah dengan panahnya; menurut theoi.com, kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panah Apollo. Dalam Iliad, menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea. Sisi gelapnya juga tampak pada kisah Niobe dan satir Marsyas.
long_description.en: Apollo was generally regarded as a helper who turns evil away, bearing the title Alexicacus. He rescued people from epidemics, yet his arrows could also bring sickness and plague; theoi.com notes that sudden deaths were believed to come from his arrows. In the Iliad, says the World History Encyclopedia, he takes the Trojan side and sends plague upon the Achaeans. His darker side also shows in the stories of Niobe and the satyr Marsyas.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia memperoleh liranya dari Hermes. Anaknya yang paling terkenal antara lain Orpheus dan Asclepius; Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana, dan Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops.
long_description.en: As god of mousike, Apollo presides over every kind of music, song, dance and poetry; he invented string music and often keeps company with the Muses. The World History Encyclopedia says he obtained his lyre from Hermes. Among his best-known children are Orpheus and Asclepius; Zeus killed Asclepius for reviving a mortal, and Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Apollo paling sering tampil sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut dan dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu, rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, benda yang dikaitkan dengannya mencakup busur perak dan kithara dari cangkang kura-kura; sumber lain menambahkan pedang, plektrum, dan trivet persembahan sebagai lambang nubuatnya. Ia juga mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda yang memasuki masyarakat warga dan menjadi prajurit.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek art Apollo most often appears as a handsome beardless youth, recognised by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod, a deer, and a bow and quiver. The World History Encyclopedia lists a silver bow and a kithara made from a tortoise shell among his associated objects; a second source adds the sword, the plectrum and the sacrificial tripod as an emblem of his prophetic power. He also oversaw the initiation rites of young men entering the full civic community and becoming warriors.

long_description.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan matahari dan Helios, tetapi sumber berbeda soal sejak kapan kaitan itu ada. Menurut tradisi Yunani ia membantu para pemukim mendirikan kota Troya, tetapi kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas.
long_description.en: In literary contexts Apollo stands for harmony, order and reason, set against Dionysus. He is often linked with the sun and Helios, though sources differ on how early that link dates. Greek tradition says he helped colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect influence running the other way, since Hittite texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas.

claims.quote: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt.

statement.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto, saudara kembar Artemis.
statement.en: Apollo is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion and myth whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto, twin of Artemis.

claims.quote: As the patron deity of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo is an oracular god—the prophetic deity of the Delphic Oracle and the deity of ritual purification. His oracles were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi, Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk.
statement.en: As patron of Delphi, Apollo is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and his oracles were often consulted.

claims.quote: He was in general seen as the god who affords help and wards off evil, and is referred to as Alexicacus, the "averter of evil". Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, whether through the god himself or mediated through his son Asclepius. Apollo delivered people from epidemics, yet he is also a god who could bring ill health and deadly plague with his arrows.

statement.id: Apollo dipandang sebagai dewa penolong dan penolak kejahatan (Alexicacus), dikaitkan dengan pengobatan secara langsung atau melalui putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dengan panahnya.
statement.en: Apollo was seen as a helper and averter of evil (Alexicacus), linked with medicine directly or via his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics but could also bring disease with his arrows.

claims.quote: As the god of mousike, Apollo presides over all music, songs, dance, and poetry. He is the inventor of string-music and the frequent companion of the Muses

statement.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse.
statement.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry; he is the inventor of string music and a frequent companion of the Muses.

claims.quote: APOLLON (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young. He was depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) adalah dewa Olimpus nubuat dan orakel, musik, lagu dan puisi, panahan, penyembuhan, wabah dan penyakit, serta perlindungan anak muda; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young, depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair.

claims.quote: Apollo was perhaps the most loved of all the gods. He was worshipped at Delphi and Delos, amongst the most famous of all Greek religious sanctuaries.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo mungkin dewa yang paling dicintai, dan dipuja di Delphi dan Delos, dua tempat suci agama Yunani yang paling terkenal.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was perhaps the most loved of the gods, worshipped at Delphi and Delos, among the most famous of Greek religious sanctuaries.

claims.quote: The slaying of the serpent Python which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphoi (Delphi).

statement.id: Salah satu mitos paling terkenal Apollo menurut theoi.com adalah pembunuhan ular Python yang menjaga tempat suci orakel di Delphi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, one of the most famous myths of Apollo is the slaying of the serpent Python, which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphi.

claims.quote: Son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, Apollo was born on the island of Delos

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin brother of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos.

claims.quote: At his first taste of ambrosia, he was said to have immediately transformed from babe to man. Apollo was then given his bow, made by the master craftsman of Mount Olympus, Hephaestus.

statement.id: Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa; ia lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus, pengrajin ulung Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: At his first taste of ambrosia Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man; he was then given his bow, made by Hephaestus, master craftsman of Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: Apollo acquired his lyre from his mischievous half-brother Hermes, the messenger god. While still a baby, Hermes had stolen Apollo's sacred herd of cattle, cleverly reversing their hooves to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

statement.id: Apollo memperoleh liranya dari saudara tirinya, Hermes sang dewa pembawa pesan, yang semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo dan membalik tapak kuku sapi-sapi itu agar jejaknya sulit diikuti.
statement.en: Apollo acquired his lyre from his half-brother Hermes, the messenger god, who as a baby had stolen Apollo's sacred cattle and reversed their hooves to make the tracks hard to follow.

claims.quote: Hermes was permitted to keep his ill-gotten gains but only after he gave Apollo his lyre which he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

statement.id: Hermes boleh menyimpan hasil curiannya, tetapi hanya setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang ia ciptakan dari cangkang kura-kura.
statement.en: Hermes was allowed to keep his ill-gotten gains, but only after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

claims.quote: perhaps the most famous are Orpheus (who inherited his father's musical skills and became a virtuoso with the lyre or kithara), Asclepius (to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine)

statement.id: Di antara anak-anak Apollo yang paling terkenal adalah Orpheus, yang mewarisi keahlian musik ayahnya pada lira atau kithara, dan Asclepius, yang diberinya pengetahuan tentang penyembuhan dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Among Apollo's most famous children are Orpheus, who inherited his father's musical skills on the lyre or kithara, and Asclepius, to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine.

claims.quote: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad. On the side of the Trojans, he gives particular assistance to the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas, and Glaukos, saving their lives on more than one occasion with his divine intervention.

statement.id: Apollo adalah tokoh penting dalam kisah Perang Troya karya Homer, Iliad; ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan beberapa kali menyelamatkan nyawa para pahlawan Troya Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos dengan campur tangan ilahinya.
statement.en: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad; on the Trojan side, he repeatedly saved the lives of the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos by divine intervention.

claims.quote: He brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army (holding Zeus' fearsome aegis) in an attack which destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and was also responsible for guiding Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

statement.id: Apollo membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, memimpin seluruh pasukan Troya menghancurkan tembok pertahanan kamp Yunani, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles sehingga pahlawan Yunani yang tampak kebal itu tewas.
statement.en: Apollo brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army in an attack that destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and guided Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

claims.quote: The pair did have a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius after he had used his marvellous medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life. In revenge, Apollo then killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

statement.id: Apollo dan Zeus sempat bertikai hebat ketika Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana dengan keahlian pengobatannya; sebagai balasan Apollo membunuh para Kiklops, raksasa bermata satu pembuat petir Zeus.
statement.en: Apollo and Zeus had a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius for using his medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life; in revenge Apollo killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

claims.quote: As punishment, Apollo was obliged to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

statement.id: Sebagai hukuman, Apollo harus mengabdi selama setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae dengan menggembalakan domba raja itu.
statement.en: As punishment, Apollo had to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

claims.quote: Apollo's darker side as the bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when he is, with his sister Artemis, the remorseless slayer of Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boasting that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

statement.id: Sisi gelap Apollo sebagai pembawa wabah dan pembalasan ilahi tampak paling terkenal ketika ia bersama saudarinya Artemis menewaskan enam (atau dalam sebagian riwayat tujuh) putra Niobe sebagai hukuman atas kesombongannya bahwa ia lebih subur daripada Leto.
statement.en: Apollo's darker side as bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when, with his sister Artemis, he slew Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boast that she was more fertile than Leto.

claims.quote: Another hapless victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas who unwisely claimed he was musically more gifted than the god. The pair had a competition and the Muses ruled that Apollo was indeed the better musician.

statement.id: Korban lain amarah Apollo adalah satir Marsyas yang dengan gegabah mengaku lebih berbakat dalam musik daripada sang dewa; keduanya bertanding dan para Muse memutuskan Apollo musisi yang lebih baik.
statement.en: Another victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas, who unwisely claimed to be more musically gifted than the god; the two competed and the Muses ruled that Apollo was the better musician.

claims.quote: Apollo then had the mortal flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

statement.id: Apollo kemudian menguliti Marsyas hidup-hidup karena kelancangannya dan memaku kulitnya pada sebatang pohon pinus.
statement.en: Apollo then had Marsyas flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

claims.quote: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal to humanity the intentions of his father Zeus, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python. The Panhellenic Pythian games were begun at the site in order to commemorate the death of this divine creature.
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo yang hendak menyingkapkan kehendak ayahnya, Zeus, kepada manusia mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular (atau naga) Python; Pythian Games dimulai di tempat itu untuk memperingati kematian makhluk ilahi tersebut.
statement.en: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal his father Zeus's intentions to humanity, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python; the Pythian games were begun there to commemorate the death of this divine creature.

claims.quote: The oracle of Delphi was already well-visited in the 8th century BCE - despite being difficult to get to and open only in summer
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM, meskipun sulit dijangkau dan hanya buka pada musim panas.
statement.en: The oracle of Delphi was already well visited in the 8th century BCE, despite being hard to reach and open only in summer.

claims.quote: a silver bow - symbolic of his prowess as an archer. a kithara (or lyre) - made from the shell of a tortoise, this was symbolic of Apollo's ability in music and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

statement.id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Apollo antara lain busur perak, lambang kehebatannya memanah, dan kithara (lira) dari cangkang kura-kura, lambang kemampuan musiknya dan kepemimpinannya atas paduan suara sembilan Muse.
statement.en: Objects associated with Apollo include a silver bow, symbolic of his prowess as an archer, and a kithara (or lyre) made from a tortoise shell, symbolic of his musical ability and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

claims.quote: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites performed by young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

statement.id: Apollo mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda (efebe) saat mereka memasuki masyarakat warga sepenuhnya dan menjadi prajurit.
statement.en: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites of young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

claims.quote: The god is frequently associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios does not go further back than the 5th century BCE.

statement.id: Sang dewa sering dikaitkan dengan matahari (sebagai Phoebus Apollo) dan dewa matahari Helios, tetapi para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: The god is often associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.

claims.quote: the view which was almost universal among the later poets, mythographers, and philesophers, and according to which Apollo was identical with Helios, or the Sun
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, pandangan yang hampir universal di kalangan penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian adalah bahwa Apollo identik dengan Helios, sang Matahari.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the view almost universal among later poets, mythographers and philosophers was that Apollo was identical with Helios, the Sun.

claims.quote: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had previously been in the possession of Themis, and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm, and Apollo, after having slain the monster, took possession of the oracle.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, orakel itu sebelumnya dimiliki Themis dan naga Python menjaga celah misteriusnya; setelah membunuh monster itu, Apollo mengambil alih orakel tersebut.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had earlier belonged to Themis and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm; after slaying the monster, Apollo took possession of the oracle.

claims.quote: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus, Python sendirilah yang memiliki orakel itu.
statement.en: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle.

claims.quote: All sudden deaths of men, whether they were regarded as a punishment or a reward, were believed to be the effect of the arrows of Apollo; and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the camp of the Greeks.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Semua kematian mendadak, baik dianggap hukuman maupun ganjaran, dipercaya akibat panah Apollo, dan dengan panah yang sama ia mengirim wabah ke kemah orang Yunani.
statement.en: All sudden deaths, whether regarded as punishment or reward, were believed to result from Apollo's arrows, and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the Greek camp.

claims.quote: Apollo and his worship, his festivals and oracles, had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god.

claims.quote: But the first time that we hear of the worship of Apollo at Rome is in the year B. C. 430, when, for the purpose of averting a plague, a temple was raised to him
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Pemujaan Apollo di Roma pertama kali terdengar pada tahun 430 SM, ketika sebuah kuil didirikan untuk menolak wabah.
statement.en: The worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in the year 430 BC, when a temple was raised to him to avert a plague.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name is unclear. The spelling Ἀπόλλων ... Thus, the Greeks most often associated Apollo's name with the Greek verb ἀπόλλυμι (apollymi), "to destroy".

statement.id: Asal kata nama Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkan nama itu dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
statement.en: The etymology of the name Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) is unclear; the Greeks most often associated it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

claims.quote: According to Greek tradition, he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy. However, this story may reflect a cultural influence which had the reverse direction: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya; namun kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh budaya dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa.
statement.en: According to Greek tradition he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect cultural influence in the reverse direction, since Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa.

claims.quote: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow. Other attributes of his included the kithara (an advanced version of the common lyre), the plectrum and the sword. Another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

statement.id: Atribut Apollo yang paling umum adalah busur dan anak panah; atribut lainnya mencakup kithara, plektrum, dan pedang, dan lambang umum lain adalah trivet persembahan yang melambangkan kekuatan nubuatnya.
statement.en: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow; others included the kithara, the plectrum and the sword, and another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

claims.quote: In literary contexts, Apollo represents harmony, order, and reason—characteristics contrasted with those of Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

statement.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus, dewa anggur, yang melambangkan kegairahan dan kekacauan.
statement.en: In literary contexts Apollo represents harmony, order and reason, contrasted with Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

claims.quote: the god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928)

statement.id: Pengajaran sang dewa kepada para Muse menjadi pokok karya Igor Stravinsky, Apollon musagète (1927–1928).
statement.en: The god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928).

claims.quote: In spaceflight, the 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo, by NASA manager Abe Silverstein

statement.id: Program NASA tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an untuk mengorbitkan dan mendaratkan astronaut di Bulan dinamai menurut Apollo oleh manajer NASA Abe Silverstein.
statement.en: The 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo by NASA manager Abe Silverstein.

claims.quote: Apollo appears frequently in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful, beardless youth. He is easily identified with either a kithara or a lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer (which he often fights over with Hercules), and a bow and quiver.
claims.locator: How is Apollo Represented in Art?

statement.id: Apollo sering muncul dalam semua media seni Yunani kuno, paling sering sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut, dan mudah dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu (penanda orakelnya di Delphi), rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah.
statement.en: Apollo appears often in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful beardless youth, and is easily identified by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer, and a bow and quiver.

claims.quote: Apollo was a much-loved god, and this was most likely due to his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing, and medicine.

statement.id: Apollo adalah dewa yang sangat dicintai, kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan banyak segi positif kehidupan manusia seperti musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Apollo was a much-loved god, most likely because of his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.
