text.id: Dikenal dalam agama Yunani kuno; Himne Homerik Pertama untuk Aphrodite kemungkinan digubah sekitar pertengahan abad ke-7 SM.
text.en: Known in ancient Greek religion; the First Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite was probably composed in the mid-seventh century BC.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite dipuja oleh pria, wanita, dan pejabat negara-kota, serta turut berperan dalam perdagangan, peperangan, dan politik kota-kota Yunani kuno dan sebagai pelindung para pelaut. Festival Aphrodisia dirayakan di seluruh Yunani, terutama di Athena dan Korintus. Menurut pandangan kosmogonik yang dicatat theoi.com, ia personifikasi daya penghasil alam dan ibu semua makhluk hidup.
cultural_context.en: The World History Encyclopedia says Aphrodite was worshipped by men, women and city-state officials, had a part in the commerce, warfare and politics of ancient Greek cities, and watched over seafarers. Her festival, the Aphrodisia, was held across Greece, above all in Athens and Corinth. Cosmogonic views recorded on theoi.com make her the personification of nature's generative powers and the mother of all living beings.

literal_meaning.id: Hesiod mengartikan nama itu "bangkit dari buih" (aphrós, "buih laut"); sebagian besar ahli modern menganggapnya etimologi rakyat, dan nama itu umumnya diterima kemungkinan berasal dari bahasa Semit.
literal_meaning.en: Hesiod interprets the name as "risen from the foam" (aphrós, "sea-foam"); most modern scholars regard this as folk etymology, and the name is generally accepted as probably Semitic in origin.

who.id: Dewi cinta dan kecantikan dalam agama Yunani kuno.
who.en: Goddess of love and beauty in ancient Greek religion.

origin.id: Agama Yunani kuno, dengan pusat pemujaan di Kythera, Siprus, Korintus, dan Athena.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion, with cult centres at Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens.

role.id: Salah satu dari tiga dewi yang perselisihannya berujung pada Perang Troya.
role.en: One of three goddesses whose rivalry led to the Trojan War.

famous_for.id: Menurut Hesiod, lahir dari buih laut, dan dipilih Paris sebagai dewi tercantik.
famous_for.en: According to Hesiod, being born from sea foam, and being chosen by Paris as the most beautiful goddess.

did_you_know.id: Ourania adalah julukan kultus yang paling umum bagi Aphrodite, tetapi hampir tidak pernah muncul dalam teks sastra.
did_you_know.en: Ourania was Aphrodite's most common cultic epithet, yet it almost never appears in literary texts.

description.id: Menurut kepercayaan populer, Aphrodite membangkitkan cinta di hati para dewa dan manusia dan dengan kekuatan itu berkuasa atas seluruh makhluk hidup.
description.en: According to popular belief, Aphrodite excited love in the hearts of gods and men and by this power ruled over all living creation.

description.id: Aphrodite memiliki kuasa menganugerahkan kecantikan dan pesona yang tak tertahankan kepada orang lain.
description.en: Aphrodite had the power of granting beauty and invincible charms to others.

description.id: Dalam seni ia mengenakan pita atau ikat pinggang yang menyimpan kekuatan ajaibnya akan cinta, hasrat, dan daya pikat.
description.en: In art she wears a band or girdle that held her magic powers of love, desire and seductive allurement.

description.id: Dalam pertarungan Typhon dengan para dewa, Aphrodite mengubah dirinya menjadi ikan.
description.en: In the contest of Typhon with the gods, Aphrodite metamorphosed herself into a fish.

description.id: Aphrodite menghukum mereka yang mengabaikan pemujaannya atau meremehkan kekuasaannya; Hippolytos dihancurkan karena meremehkan pemujaannya.
description.en: Aphrodite punished those who neglected her worship or despised her power; Hippolytos was destroyed for scorning her worship.

description.id: Aphrodite menghidupkan arca Pygmalion sebagai jawaban atas doanya.
description.en: Aphrodite brought Pygmalion's statue to life in answer to his prayers.

description.id: Ketika berusaha menyelamatkan Aeneas dari pertempuran di Troya, Aphrodite dikejar dan dilukai tangannya oleh Diomedes.
description.en: When she tried to rescue Aeneas from the fighting at Troy, Aphrodite was pursued and wounded in the hand by Diomedes.

role.en: The goddess who is born

summary.id: Menurut Theogony karya Hesiod, Aphrodite lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus yang dipotong dan dilemparkan Kronos ke laut; setelah bangkit dari buih ia mendekati Kythera dan pergi ke Siprus. Dalam Iliad ia putri Zeus dan Dione.
summary.en: According to Hesiod's Theogony Aphrodite was born from the foam produced by Uranus's genitals, which Cronus severed and threw into the sea; after rising from the foam she approached Cythera and went on to Cyprus. In the Iliad she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione.

role.en: The victorious goddess

summary.id: Pada pernikahan Peleus dan Thetis, Eris menawarkan apel emas bagi dewi tercantik. Hera, Athena, dan Aphrodite bersaing, Zeus menunjuk Paris sebagai hakim, dan Paris memilih Aphrodite sehingga ia memberinya Helena dari Sparta.
summary.en: Eris, goddess of strife, put up a golden apple at the wedding of Peleus and Thetis for whichever goddess was fairest. Hera, Athena and Aphrodite all claimed it, Zeus named Paris as the judge, and Paris chose Aphrodite, who then gave him Helen of Sparta.

role.en: Protector of her son and of Paris

summary.id: Aphrodite melindungi putranya Aeneas dari Diomedes dan menyelamatkan Paris dari murka Menelaos. Ketika berusaha menyelamatkan Aeneas, ia dilukai Diomedes di tangan.
summary.en: Aphrodite protects her son Aeneas from Diomedes and saves Paris from the wrath of Menelaos. In trying to rescue Aeneas she was wounded in the hand by Diomedes.

role.en: The unfaithful wife

summary.id: Dalam Odyssey, Demodokos menggambarkan Aphrodite sebagai istri Hephaestus yang berzina dengan Ares. Iliad dan Theogony menyebut istri Hephaestus dewi lain, sedangkan sumber kemudian umumnya menganggap Ares suami atau pasangan resminya.
summary.en: In the Odyssey Demodocus describes Aphrodite as the wife of Hephaestus who committed adultery with Ares. The Iliad and Theogony name a different wife for Hephaestus, and later sources generally regard Ares as her husband or official consort.

role.id: Dewi yang jatuh cinta karena Zeus
role.en: The goddess made to fall in love by Zeus

summary.id: Menurut Himne Homerik Pertama, Zeus membuat Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada gembala fana Anchises, yang darinya ia menjadi ibu Aeneas.
summary.en: According to the First Homeric Hymn, Zeus made Aphrodite fall in love with the mortal shepherd Anchises, by whom she became the mother of Aeneas.

role.en: The grieving lover

summary.id: Aphrodite menyimpan Adonis di dalam peti yang dijaga Persephone, yang menolak mengembalikannya; Zeus memutuskan Adonis tinggal empat bulan setahun bersama masing-masing dewi. Duka Aphrodite atas wafatnya diperingati dalam festival Adonia.
summary.en: Aphrodite kept Adonis in a chest guarded by Persephone, who refused to return him; Zeus ruled that Adonis spend four months of the year with each lady. Aphrodite's grief at his death was commemorated in the Adonia festival.

role.en: Punisher and helper

summary.id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite menghancurkan Hippolytos yang meremehkan pemujaannya, menghidupkan arca Pygmalion sebagai jawaban atas doanya, dan menganiaya Psyche, gadis yang dicintai putranya Eros.
summary.en: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite destroyed Hippolytos for scorning her worship, brought Pygmalion's statue to life in answer to his prayers, and persecuted Psyche, the maiden loved by her son Eros.

description.id: Pulau pusat pemujaan utama Aphrodite; menurut Hesiod ia pertama-tama mendekati pulau ini setelah bangkit dari buih.
description.en: An island that was one of Aphrodite's main cult centres; according to Hesiod she first approached it after rising from the foam.

description.id: Pusat pemujaan utama Aphrodite dan salah satu tempat yang mengaku sebagai tempat kelahirannya.
description.en: A main cult centre of Aphrodite and one of the places claiming to be her birthplace.

description.id: Kota di Siprus tempat Aphrodite muncul dari laut saat lahir, asal julukan Paphian.
description.en: A city in Cyprus where Aphrodite emerged from the sea at her birth, the origin of the epithet Paphian.

description.id: Salah satu pusat pemujaan utama Aphrodite; Aphrodisia dirayakan terutama di Athena dan Korintus.
description.en: One of Aphrodite's main cult centres; the Aphrodisia was celebrated particularly in Athens and Corinth.

description.id: Pusat pemujaan utama Aphrodite, tempat ia dirayakan setiap tahun dalam festival Aphrodisia.
description.en: A main cult centre of Aphrodite, where she was celebrated annually at the Aphrodisia festival.

description.id: Himne yang menceritakan Aphrodite dan Anchises kemungkinan digubah sekitar masa ini.
description.en: The hymn telling of Aphrodite and Anchises was probably composed around this time.

description.id: Praxiteles memahat arca marmer Aphrodite dari Knidos, yang kemudian dipuji Plinius Tua sebagai patung terbesar yang pernah dibuat.
description.en: Praxiteles carved the marble statue Aphrodite of Knidos, later praised by Pliny the Elder as the greatest sculpture ever made.

description.id: Menurut Livius, Aphrodite dan Venus secara resmi disamakan ketika pemujaan Venus Erycina dibawa ke Roma dari Gunung Eryx.
description.en: According to Livy, Aphrodite and Venus were officially identified when the cult of Venus Erycina was introduced to Rome from Mount Eryx.

note.id: Ayah Aphrodite dalam Iliad.
note.en: Aphrodite's father in the Iliad.

note.id: Ibu Aphrodite dalam Iliad.
note.en: Aphrodite's mother in the Iliad.

note.id: Menurut Hesiod, Aphrodite lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus; tradisi lain menyebutnya putri Uranus dan Hemera.
note.en: According to Hesiod Aphrodite was born from the foam produced by Uranus's genitals; another tradition calls her a daughter of Uranus and Hemera.

note.id: Suami Aphrodite dalam Odyssey; Iliad dan Theogony menyebut istri Hephaestus dewi lain.
note.en: Aphrodite's husband in the Odyssey; the Iliad and Theogony name a different wife for Hephaestus.

note.id: Kekasih Aphrodite dalam Odyssey dan Iliad; dalam sumber kemudian umumnya dianggap suami atau pasangan resminya; ayah Phobos, Deimos, dan Harmonia.
note.en: Aphrodite's lover in the Odyssey and Iliad; in later sources generally regarded as her husband or official consort; father of Phobos, Deimos and Harmonia.

note.id: Hampir selalu menemani Aphrodite dan sering dipandang sebagai putranya.
note.en: Almost always accompanies Aphrodite and is often seen as her son.

note.id: Putra Aphrodite dengan Anchises, yang ia lindungi dalam Perang Troya.
note.en: Aphrodite's son by Anchises, whom she protects in the Trojan War.

note.id: Putri Aphrodite dengan Ares.
note.en: Aphrodite's daughter by Ares.

note.id: Gembala fana yang dicintai Aphrodite atas kehendak Zeus.
note.en: The mortal shepherd Aphrodite loved at Zeus's will.

note.id: Pemuda rupawan kekasih Aphrodite yang kematiannya ia tangisi.
note.en: The beautiful youth Aphrodite loved and mourned.

note.id: Pangeran Troya yang memilih Aphrodite sebagai dewi tercantik dan menerima Helena darinya.
note.en: The Trojan prince who chose Aphrodite as the most beautiful goddess and received Helen from her.

note.id: Bersama Hera, bersaing dengan Aphrodite memperebutkan apel emas di hadapan Paris.
note.en: With Hera, a rival of Aphrodite for the golden apple before Paris.

note.id: Bersaing dengan Aphrodite memperebutkan apel emas di hadapan Paris.
note.en: A rival of Aphrodite for the golden apple before Paris.

note.id: Penjaga Adonis yang menolak mengembalikannya kepada Aphrodite.
note.en: Guardian of Adonis who refused to give him back to Aphrodite.

note.id: Pahlawan Yunani yang melukai tangan Aphrodite di Troya.
note.en: The Greek hero who wounded Aphrodite's hand at Troy.

note.id: Dihancurkan Aphrodite karena meremehkan pemujaannya.
note.en: Destroyed by Aphrodite for scorning her worship.

note.id: Gadis yang dicintai Eros dan dianiaya Aphrodite.
note.en: The maiden loved by Eros and persecuted by Aphrodite.

note.id: Dewi Romawi yang disamakan dengan Aphrodite.
note.en: The Roman goddess identified with Aphrodite.

note.id: Dewi Timur Dekat yang menurut sebagian ahli memengaruhi Aphrodite; merpati semula lambangnya.
note.en: The Near Eastern goddess who, according to some scholars, influenced Aphrodite; the dove was originally her symbol.

description.id: Film karya William A. Seiter yang dibintangi Ava Gardner, yang menjadikan simbolisme dewi cinta sebagai pusat ceritanya.
description.en: A film by William A. Seiter starring Ava Gardner, in which the symbolism of the goddess of love is central.

description.id: Film karya Woody Allen yang menjadikan simbolisme dewi cinta sebagai pusat ceritanya.
description.en: A film by Woody Allen in which the symbolism of the goddess of love is central.

description.id: Agama neopagan yang didirikan Gleb Botkin pada 1938, yang memuja dewi ibu yang oleh para penganutnya diidentifikasi sebagai Aphrodite.
description.en: A neopagan religion founded by Gleb Botkin in 1938 that worships a mother goddess identified by its practitioners as Aphrodite.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dua penyair besar Yunani, Homer dan Hesiod, bisa menceritakan kelahiran Aphrodite secara berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why might Homer and Hesiod tell Aphrodite's birth differently?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang bisa dipelajari dari perbedaan sumber tentang siapa suami Aphrodite?
learning_questions.en: What can we learn from the differing sources about who Aphrodite's husband was?

short_description.id: Aphrodite adalah dewi Yunani kuno cinta dan kecantikan, dipuja terutama di Kythera, Siprus, Korintus, dan Athena; menurut Hesiod ia lahir dari buih laut.
short_description.en: Aphrodite is the ancient Greek goddess of love and beauty, worshipped chiefly at Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens; according to Hesiod she was born from sea foam.

long_description.id: Aphrodite adalah dewi Yunani kuno yang dikaitkan dengan cinta dan kecantikan. Pusat pemujaan utamanya adalah Kythera, Siprus, Korintus, dan Athena, tempat ia dirayakan setiap tahun dalam festival Aphrodisia; di Lakonia ia dipuja sebagai dewi perang. Ia bergelar Cytherea dan Cypris karena Kythera dan Siprus sama-sama mengaku sebagai tempat kelahirannya. Julukan kultusnya yang paling umum adalah Ourania, "surgawi", dan ia juga dikenal sebagai Pandemos.
long_description.en: Aphrodite is an ancient Greek goddess linked with love and beauty. Her chief cult centres were Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens, where the Aphrodisia festival honoured her every year; in Laconia she was worshipped as a goddess of war. The names Cytherea and Cypris reflect that both Cythera and Cyprus claimed to be her birthplace. Ourania, "heavenly", was her commonest cultic epithet, and she was also called Pandemos.

long_description.id: Dalam Iliad karya Homer ia putri Zeus dan Dione, sedangkan dalam Theogony karya Hesiod ia lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus yang dipotong dan dilemparkan Kronos ke laut. Menurut Hesiod nama Aphrodite berasal dari aphrós, "buih laut", tetapi sebagian besar ahli modern menganggapnya etimologi rakyat. Asal-usulnya diperdebatkan: pengaruh yang diusulkan mencakup dewi cinta Timur Dekat, dewi asli Siprus, dan dewi fajar Proto-Indo-Eropa.
long_description.en: Homer's Iliad makes her a child of Zeus and Dione, while Hesiod's Theogony has her rise from the foam that gathered around Uranus's genitals after Cronus cut them off and cast them into the sea. Hesiod derives her name from aphrós, "sea-foam", though most modern scholars take this for folk etymology. Her origins are disputed: suggested influences include Near Eastern love goddesses, a native Cypriot goddess and a Proto-Indo-European dawn goddess.

long_description.id: Sumber berbeda tentang suaminya. Dalam Odyssey ia istri Hephaestus dan berzina dengan Ares; dalam Iliad dan Theogony istri Hephaestus adalah dewi lain, dan dalam sumber kemudian Ares umumnya dianggap suami atau pasangan resminya. Eros hampir selalu menemaninya dan sering dipandang sebagai putranya, dan menurut theoi.com ia ibu Phobos, Deimos, dan Harmonia dari Ares serta Aeneas dari Anchises.
long_description.en: Sources differ on her husband. In the Odyssey she is Hephaestus's wife and commits adultery with Ares; in the Iliad and Theogony Hephaestus has a different wife, and in later sources Ares is generally regarded as her husband or official consort. Eros almost always accompanies her and is often seen as her son, and according to theoi.com she was the mother of Phobos, Deimos and Harmonia by Ares and of Aeneas by Anchises.

long_description.id: Bersama Athena dan Hera, Aphrodite salah satu dari tiga dewi yang perselisihannya berujung pada Perang Troya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Paris memilih Aphrodite sebagai dewi tercantik sehingga sang dewi memberinya Helena dari Sparta; dalam Perang Troya ia melindungi Aeneas dan Paris, dan menurut theoi.com ia dilukai Diomedes di tangan. Theoi.com juga menyebut ia menghancurkan Hippolytos karena meremehkan pemujaannya.
long_description.en: With Athena and Hera, Aphrodite was among three goddesses whose rivalry led to the Trojan War. The World History Encyclopedia says Paris chose Aphrodite as the fairest goddess, and she gave him Helen of Sparta; in the Trojan War she shields Aeneas and Paris, and theoi.com says Diomedes wounded her in the hand. Theoi.com also reports that she destroyed Hippolytos for scorning her worship.

long_description.id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik dengan atribut merpati, apel, kerang, dan cermin. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni ia sering dikenali dari cermin, apel, karangan myrtus, burung suci atau merpati, tongkat kerajaan, dan bunga; dalam seni Arkaik dan Klasik ia biasanya berpakaian dan mengenakan ikat pinggang yang menyimpan kekuatan ajaibnya akan cinta dan hasrat. Hesiod menggambarkannya, antara lain, sebagai "lahir dari buih" dan paling sering sebagai "Aphrodite yang keemasan".
long_description.en: Theoi.com depicts Aphrodite as a beautiful woman whose attributes were a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror. The World History Encyclopedia says that artists often identify her through objects such as a mirror, apple, myrtle wreath, sceptre or flower, or a dove as her sacred bird; in Archaic and Classical art she is usually clothed and wears a girdle that held her magic powers of love and desire. Hesiod calls her, among other things, "foam-born" and most often "golden Aphrodite".

long_description.id: Bangsa Romawi menyamakan Aphrodite dengan Venus, yang semula dewi kesuburan pertanian, tumbuh-tumbuhan, dan musim semi; menurut Livius, penyamaan resmi terjadi pada abad ke-3 SM ketika pemujaan Venus Erycina dibawa ke Roma. Karena Aphrodite ibu Aeneas dan tradisi Romawi menyebut Aeneas pendiri Roma, Venus dipuja sebagai Venus Genetrix, ibu seluruh bangsa Romawi.
long_description.en: The Romans equated Aphrodite with Venus, originally a goddess of agricultural fertility, vegetation and springtime; according to Livy the official equation came in the third century BC, when the cult of Venus Erycina reached Rome. Since Aphrodite was the mother of Aeneas and Roman tradition made Aeneas the founder of Rome, Venus came to be honoured as Venus Genetrix, mother of the whole Roman nation.

claims.quote: is an ancient Greek goddess associated with love and beauty. Aphrodite's main cult centers were Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth, and Athens. In Athens, she was celebrated annually during the Aphrodisia festival. In Laconia, Aphrodite was worshipped as a warrior goddess.

statement.id: Afrodit adalah dewi Yunani kuno cinta dan kecantikan dengan pusat pemujaan di Kythera, Siprus, Korintus, dan Athena, tempat ia dirayakan setiap tahun dalam festival Aphrodisia; di Lakonia ia dipuja sebagai dewi perang.
statement.en: Aphrodite is the ancient Greek goddess of love and beauty with cult centres at Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens, where the Aphrodisia honoured her yearly; in Laconia she was a warrior goddess.

claims.quote: Thus she was known as Cytherea (Lady of Cythera) and Cypris (Lady of Cyprus), because both places claimed to be the site of her birth. The origins of Aphrodite have been the subject of scholarly debate.

statement.id: Ia dikenal sebagai Cytherea (Nyonya Kythera) dan Cypris (Nyonya Siprus) karena kedua tempat itu sama-sama mengaku sebagai tempat kelahirannya; asal-usul Aphrodite menjadi bahan perdebatan para ahli.
statement.en: She was known as Cytherea (Lady of Cythera) and Cypris (Lady of Cyprus) because both places claimed to be the site of her birth; the origins of Aphrodite have been the subject of scholarly debate.

claims.quote: In Homer's Iliad, she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione. In Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam ... produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea. In the Odyssey, Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus

statement.id: Dalam Iliad karya Homer ia putri Zeus dan Dione; dalam Theogony karya Hesiod ia lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus yang dipotong dan dilemparkan ke laut oleh putranya, Kronos; dalam Odyssey Aphrodite menikah dengan Hephaestus.
statement.en: In Homer's Iliad she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione; in Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea; in the Odyssey Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus.

claims.quote: Along with Athena and Hera, she was one of the three goddesses whose feud resulted in the Trojan War

statement.id: Bersama Athena dan Hera, ia salah satu dari tiga dewi yang perselisihannya berujung pada Perang Troya.
statement.en: Along with Athena and Hera, she was one of the three goddesses whose feud resulted in the Trojan War.

claims.quote: APHRODITE was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation. She was depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love). Her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite adalah dewi Olimpus cinta, kecantikan, kesenangan, dan keturunan, digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik yang sering ditemani dewa kecil bersayap Eros (Cinta); atributnya meliputi merpati, apel, kerang, dan cermin.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation, depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love); her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.

claims.quote: Worshipped by men, women, and city-state officials, Aphrodite also played a role in the commerce, warfare, and politics of ancient Greek cities. In addition, Aphrodite was honoured as a protector of those who travelled by sea

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite dipuja oleh pria, wanita, dan pejabat negara-kota, juga berperan dalam perdagangan, peperangan, dan politik kota-kota Yunani kuno, serta dihormati sebagai pelindung mereka yang bepergian lewat laut.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite was worshipped by men, women and city-state officials, played a role in the commerce, warfare and politics of ancient Greek cities, and was honoured as a protector of those who travelled by sea.

claims.quote: Ἀφροδίτη, romanized: Aphrodítē

statement.id: Namanya dalam aksara Yunani adalah Ἀφροδίτη (Aphrodítē).
statement.en: Her name in Greek script is Ἀφροδίτη (Aphrodítē).

claims.quote: Hesiod derives the name Aphrodite from aphrós (ἀφρός ) 'sea-foam', interpreting the name as "risen from the foam", but most modern scholars regard this as a spurious folk etymology.

statement.id: Hesiod menurunkan nama Aphrodite dari aphrós (ἀφρός) "buih laut", dan mengartikannya "bangkit dari buih", tetapi sebagian besar ahli modern menganggapnya etimologi rakyat yang keliru.
statement.en: Hesiod derives the name Aphrodite from aphrós (ἀφρός) "sea-foam", interpreting it as "risen from the foam", but most modern scholars regard this as a spurious folk etymology.

claims.quote: Aphrodite's name is generally accepted to likely be of Semitic origin, due to the believed Near Eastern origins of Aphrodite's worship, but its exact derivation cannot be determined with confidence.

statement.id: Nama Aphrodite umumnya diterima kemungkinan berasal dari bahasa Semit karena diyakini pemujaannya berasal dari Timur Dekat, tetapi asal pastinya tidak dapat dipastikan dengan yakin.
statement.en: Aphrodite's name is generally accepted as probably of Semitic origin, owing to the believed Near Eastern origins of her worship, but its exact derivation cannot be determined with confidence.

claims.quote: Proposed influences on her origins have included Near Eastern love goddesses, an indigenous Cypriot goddess, and a Proto-Indo-European dawn goddess.

statement.id: Pengaruh yang diusulkan atas asal-usulnya mencakup dewi cinta Timur Dekat, dewi asli Siprus, dan dewi fajar Proto-Indo-Eropa.
statement.en: Proposed influences on her origins have included Near Eastern love goddesses, an indigenous Cypriot goddess, and a Proto-Indo-European dawn goddess.

claims.quote: Some scholars believe that the cult of Aphrodite in Greece was influenced by the cult of Astarte in Phoenicia, which, in turn, was influenced by the cult of the Mesopotamian goddess known as "Ishtar" to the East Semitic peoples and as "Inanna" to the Sumerians.

statement.id: Sebagian ahli yakin bahwa pemujaan Aphrodite di Yunani dipengaruhi pemujaan Astarte di Fenisia, yang pada gilirannya dipengaruhi pemujaan dewi Mesopotamia yang dikenal sebagai "Ishtar" oleh bangsa Semit Timur dan "Inanna" oleh bangsa Sumer.
statement.en: Some scholars believe the cult of Aphrodite in Greece was influenced by the cult of Astarte in Phoenicia, which was in turn influenced by the cult of the Mesopotamian goddess known as "Ishtar" to the East Semitic peoples and "Inanna" to the Sumerians.

claims.quote: Most modern scholars have now rejected the notion of a purely Indo-European Aphrodite, but it is possible that Aphrodite, who may have originated as an Semitic deity, was influenced by the Indo-European dawn goddess.

statement.id: Sebagian besar ahli modern kini menolak gagasan Aphrodite yang murni Indo-Eropa, tetapi mungkin Aphrodite, yang barangkali berasal dari dewa Semit, dipengaruhi dewi fajar Indo-Eropa.
statement.en: Most modern scholars now reject the idea of a purely Indo-European Aphrodite, but it is possible that Aphrodite, who may have originated as a Semitic deity, was influenced by the Indo-European dawn goddess.

claims.quote: Like Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite was a warrior goddess; the second-century AD Greek geographer Pausanias records that, in Sparta, Aphrodite was worshipped as Aphrodite Areia, which means "warlike".

statement.id: Seperti Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite adalah dewi pejuang; geografer Yunani abad ke-2 M, Pausanias, mencatat bahwa di Sparta Aphrodite dipuja sebagai Aphrodite Areia, yang berarti "bersifat perang".
statement.en: Like Inanna-Ishtar, Aphrodite was a warrior goddess; the second-century AD Greek geographer Pausanias records that in Sparta Aphrodite was worshipped as Aphrodite Areia, meaning "warlike".

claims.quote: Aphrodite's most common cultic epithet was Ourania, meaning "heavenly", but this epithet almost never occurs in literary texts, indicating a purely cultic significance. Another common name for Aphrodite was Pandemos ("For All the Folk").

statement.id: Julukan kultus Aphrodite yang paling umum adalah Ourania, "surgawi", yang hampir tidak pernah muncul dalam teks sastra sehingga bermakna murni kultus; nama umum lainnya adalah Pandemos ("Bagi Seluruh Rakyat").
statement.en: Aphrodite's most common cultic epithet was Ourania, "heavenly", which almost never occurs in literary texts and so had a purely cultic significance; another common name was Pandemos ("For All the Folk").

claims.quote: Paphian (Παφία), was one of her epithets, after the Paphos in Cyprus where she had emerged from the sea at her birth.

statement.id: Paphian (Παφία) adalah salah satu julukannya, menurut Paphos di Siprus tempat ia muncul dari laut saat lahir.
statement.en: Paphian (Παφία) was one of her epithets, after Paphos in Cyprus where she had emerged from the sea at her birth.

claims.quote: In Athens, the Aphrodisia was celebrated on the fourth day of the month of Hekatombaion in honor of Aphrodite's role in the unification of Attica.

statement.id: Di Athena, Aphrodisia dirayakan pada hari keempat bulan Hekatombaion untuk menghormati peran Aphrodite dalam penyatuan Attika.
statement.en: In Athens the Aphrodisia was celebrated on the fourth day of the month of Hekatombaion in honour of Aphrodite's role in the unification of Attica.

claims.quote: The ancient Romans identified Aphrodite with their goddess Venus, who was originally a goddess of agricultural fertility, vegetation, and springtime.

statement.id: Bangsa Romawi kuno menyamakan Aphrodite dengan dewi mereka Venus, yang semula dewi kesuburan pertanian, tumbuh-tumbuhan, dan musim semi.
statement.en: The ancient Romans identified Aphrodite with their goddess Venus, who was originally a goddess of agricultural fertility, vegetation and springtime.

claims.quote: According to the Roman historian Livy, Aphrodite and Venus were officially identified in the third century BC when the cult of Venus Erycina was introduced to Rome from the Greek sanctuary of Aphrodite on Mount Eryx in Sicily.

statement.id: Menurut sejarawan Romawi Livius, Aphrodite dan Venus secara resmi disamakan pada abad ke-3 SM ketika pemujaan Venus Erycina dibawa ke Roma dari tempat suci Aphrodite Yunani di Gunung Eryx di Sisilia.
statement.en: According to the Roman historian Livy, Aphrodite and Venus were officially identified in the third century BC when the cult of Venus Erycina was introduced to Rome from the Greek sanctuary of Aphrodite on Mount Eryx in Sicily.

claims.quote: Because Aphrodite was the mother of the Trojan hero Aeneas in Greek mythology and the Roman tradition claimed Aeneas as the founder of Rome, Venus became venerated as Venus Genetrix, the mother of the entire Roman nation.

statement.id: Karena Aphrodite adalah ibu pahlawan Troya Aeneas dalam mitologi Yunani dan tradisi Romawi menyebut Aeneas pendiri Roma, Venus dipuja sebagai Venus Genetrix, ibu seluruh bangsa Romawi.
statement.en: Because Aphrodite was the mother of the Trojan hero Aeneas in Greek mythology and Roman tradition claimed Aeneas as founder of Rome, Venus came to be venerated as Venus Genetrix, mother of the entire Roman nation.

claims.quote: In the Iliad, Aphrodite is the apparently unmarried consort of Ares, the god of war, and the wife of Hephaestus is a different goddess named Charis. In Hesiod's Theogony, Aphrodite is unmarried and the wife of Hephaestus is Aglaea, the youngest of the three Charites.

statement.id: Dalam Iliad, Aphrodite adalah pasangan Ares sang dewa perang yang tampaknya belum menikah, dan istri Hephaestus adalah dewi lain bernama Charis; dalam Theogony karya Hesiod, Aphrodite tidak menikah dan istri Hephaestus adalah Aglaea, yang bungsu dari tiga Charites.
statement.en: In the Iliad Aphrodite is the apparently unmarried consort of Ares, god of war, and the wife of Hephaestus is a different goddess named Charis; in Hesiod's Theogony Aphrodite is unmarried and the wife of Hephaestus is Aglaea, the youngest of the three Charites.

claims.quote: In the Odyssey, the blind singer Demodocus describes Aphrodite as the wife of Hephaestus and tells how she committed adultery with Ares during the Trojan War.

statement.id: Dalam Odyssey, penyanyi buta Demodokos menggambarkan Aphrodite sebagai istri Hephaestus dan menceritakan bagaimana ia berzina dengan Ares semasa Perang Troya.
statement.en: In the Odyssey, the blind singer Demodocus describes Aphrodite as the wife of Hephaestus and tells how she committed adultery with Ares during the Trojan War.

claims.quote: In later sources, it was generally Ares who was regarded as the husband or official consort of the goddess, such as on the François Vase, a sixth-century BC krater, and in the poetry of Pindar and Aeschylus.

statement.id: Dalam sumber-sumber kemudian, Ares umumnya dianggap suami atau pasangan resmi sang dewi, misalnya pada Vas François, sebuah krater abad ke-6 SM, dan dalam puisi Pindaros dan Aiskhylos.
statement.en: In later sources it was generally Ares who was regarded as the goddess's husband or official consort, as on the François Vase, a sixth-century BC krater, and in the poetry of Pindar and Aeschylus.

claims.quote: Aphrodite is almost always accompanied by Eros, the personification of love. ... Eros is often seen as Aphrodite's son.

statement.id: Aphrodite hampir selalu ditemani Eros, personifikasi cinta; Eros sering dipandang sebagai putra Aphrodite.
statement.en: Aphrodite is almost always accompanied by Eros, the personification of love; Eros is often seen as Aphrodite's son.

claims.quote: The First Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite (Hymn 5), which was probably composed sometime in the mid-seventh century BC, describes how Zeus once became annoyed with Aphrodite for causing deities to fall in love with mortals, so he caused her to fall in love with Anchises, a handsome mortal shepherd who lived in the foothills beneath Mount Ida near the city of Troy.

statement.id: Himne Homerik Pertama untuk Aphrodite (Himne 5), yang kemungkinan digubah sekitar pertengahan abad ke-7 SM, menceritakan bagaimana Zeus kesal karena Aphrodite membuat para dewa jatuh cinta pada manusia fana, sehingga ia membuat Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada Anchises, gembala fana yang tampan yang tinggal di kaki Gunung Ida dekat kota Troya.
statement.en: The First Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite (Hymn 5), probably composed in the mid-seventh century BC, describes how Zeus, annoyed with Aphrodite for making deities fall in love with mortals, made her fall in love with Anchises, a handsome mortal shepherd living in the foothills beneath Mount Ida near the city of Troy.

claims.quote: Aphrodite's most prominent avian symbol was the dove, originally a symbol of her Near Eastern precursor Inanna-Ishtar.

statement.id: Lambang burung Aphrodite yang paling menonjol adalah merpati, yang semula lambang pendahulunya dari Timur Dekat, Inanna-Ishtar.
statement.en: Aphrodite's most prominent avian symbol was the dove, originally a symbol of her Near Eastern precursor Inanna-Ishtar.

claims.quote: In c. 364/361 BC, the Athenian sculptor Praxiteles carved the marble statue Aphrodite of Knidos, which Pliny the Elder later praised as the greatest sculpture ever made.

statement.id: Sekitar 364/361 SM, pemahat Athena Praxiteles memahat arca marmer Aphrodite dari Knidos, yang kemudian dipuji Plinius Tua sebagai patung terbesar yang pernah dibuat.
statement.en: Around 364/361 BC the Athenian sculptor Praxiteles carved the marble statue Aphrodite of Knidos, which Pliny the Elder later praised as the greatest sculpture ever made.

claims.quote: In cinema, the symbolism of the goddess of love has been central to William A. Seiter's 1948 film One Touch of Venus starring Ava Gardner, and to Woody Allen's 1995 film Mighty Aphrodite.

statement.id: Dalam sinema, simbolisme dewi cinta menjadi pusat film One Touch of Venus (1948) karya William A. Seiter yang dibintangi Ava Gardner, dan film Mighty Aphrodite (1995) karya Woody Allen.
statement.en: In cinema, the symbolism of the goddess of love has been central to William A. Seiter's 1948 film One Touch of Venus starring Ava Gardner and to Woody Allen's 1995 film Mighty Aphrodite.

claims.quote: In 1938, Gleb Botkin, a Russian immigrant to the United States, founded the Church of Aphrodite, a neopagan religion that worships a mother goddess, identified by its practitioners as Aphrodite.

statement.id: Pada 1938, Gleb Botkin, imigran Rusia di Amerika Serikat, mendirikan Church of Aphrodite, agama neopagan yang memuja dewi ibu yang oleh para penganutnya diidentifikasi sebagai Aphrodite.
statement.en: In 1938 Gleb Botkin, a Russian immigrant to the United States, founded the Church of Aphrodite, a neopagan religion that worships a mother goddess identified by its practitioners as Aphrodite.

claims.quote: The death of Hippolytos, who was destroyed by the goddess for scorning her worship.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Hippolytos dihancurkan sang dewi karena meremehkan pemujaannya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Hippolytos was destroyed by the goddess for scorning her worship.

claims.quote: The statue of Pygmalion which was brought to life by Aphrodite in answer to his prayers.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, arca Pygmalion dihidupkan oleh Aphrodite sebagai jawaban atas doanya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Pygmalion's statue was brought to life by Aphrodite in answer to his prayers.

claims.quote: The persecution of Psykhe (Psyche), the maiden loved by the goddess' son Eros.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite menganiaya Psykhe (Psyche), gadis yang dicintai putranya, Eros.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite persecuted Psykhe (Psyche), the maiden loved by her son Eros.

claims.quote: Later traditions call her a daughter of Kronos and Euonyme, or of Uranus and Hemera.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, tradisi yang lebih kemudian menyebutnya putri Kronos dan Euonyme, atau Uranus dan Hemera.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, later traditions call her a daughter of Kronos and Euonyme, or of Uranus and Hemera.

claims.quote: With the exception of the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite there is no trace of this legend in Homer, and according to him Aphrodite is the daughter of Zeus and Dione.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, selain pada Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite tidak ada jejak legenda buih ini dalam Homer, yang menyebut Aphrodite putri Zeus dan Dione.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, apart from the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite there is no trace of the foam legend in Homer, who makes Aphrodite the daughter of Zeus and Dione.

claims.quote: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera, and thence went to Cyprus
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod dan Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite, setelah bangkit dari buih sang dewi pertama-tama mendekati Pulau Kythera, lalu pergi ke Siprus.
statement.en: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera and from there went to Cyprus.

claims.quote: According to the cosmogonic views of the nature of Aphrodite, she was the personification of the generative powers of nature, and the mother of all living beings.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut pandangan kosmogonik tentang hakikat Aphrodite, ia adalah personifikasi daya penghasil alam dan ibu semua makhluk hidup.
statement.en: According to cosmogonic views of Aphrodite's nature, she was the personification of the generative powers of nature and the mother of all living beings.

claims.quote: in the contest of Typhon with the gods, Aphrodite metamorphosed herself into a fish
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Dalam pertarungan Typhon dengan para dewa, Aphrodite mengubah dirinya menjadi ikan.
statement.en: In the contest of Typhon with the gods, Aphrodite metamorphosed herself into a fish.

claims.quote: she was the goddess of love, who excited this passion in the hearts of gods and men, and by this power ruled over all the living creation.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan populer orang Yunani, Aphrodite adalah dewi cinta yang membangkitkan gairah itu di hati para dewa dan manusia, dan dengan kekuatan ini ia berkuasa atas seluruh makhluk hidup.
statement.en: According to the popular belief of the Greeks, she was the goddess of love who excited this passion in the hearts of gods and men and by this power ruled over all living creation.

claims.quote: Ancient mythology furnishes numerous instances in which Aphrodite punished those who neglected her worship or despised her power, as well as others in which she favoured and protected those who did homage to her and recognized her sway.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Mitologi kuno memuat banyak contoh Aphrodite menghukum mereka yang mengabaikan pemujaannya atau meremehkan kekuasaannya, juga contoh ia menyukai dan melindungi mereka yang memuliakannya dan mengakui kekuasaannya.
statement.en: Ancient mythology furnishes numerous instances in which Aphrodite punished those who neglected her worship or despised her power, and others in which she favoured and protected those who did homage to her and recognized her sway.

claims.quote: she had further the power of granting beauty and invincible charms to others.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Aphrodite juga memiliki kuasa untuk menganugerahkan kecantikan dan pesona yang tak tertahankan kepada orang lain.
statement.en: She also had the power of granting beauty and invincible charms to others.

claims.quote: when she endeavoured to rescue her darling Aeneas from the fight, she was pursued by Diomedes, who wounded her in her hand.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Dalam Perang Troya, ketika ia berusaha menyelamatkan Aeneas kesayangannya dari pertempuran, Aphrodite dikejar Diomedes yang melukai tangannya.
statement.en: In the Trojan War, when she tried to rescue her darling Aeneas from the fight, Aphrodite was pursued by Diomedes, who wounded her in her hand.

claims.quote: By Ares she became the mother of Phobos, Deimos, Harmonia, and, according to later traditions, of Eros and Anteros also.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Dari Ares, Aphrodite menjadi ibu Phobos, Deimos, Harmonia, dan menurut tradisi yang lebih kemudian juga Eros dan Anteros.
statement.en: By Ares she became the mother of Phobos, Deimos and Harmonia, and, according to later traditions, of Eros and Anteros also.

claims.quote: Aphrodite conceived an invincible passion for Anchises, by whom she became the mother of Aeneas and Lyrus.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Aphrodite dilanda hasrat tak tertahankan pada Anchises, yang darinya ia menjadi ibu Aeneas dan Lyrus.
statement.en: Aphrodite conceived an invincible passion for Anchises, by whom she became the mother of Aeneas and Lyrus.

claims.quote: At the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, Eris (goddess of strife) offered a golden apple for the most beautiful goddess. Hera, Athena, and Aphrodite vied for the honour, and Zeus appointed the Trojan prince Paris as judge.

statement.id: Pada pernikahan Peleus dan Thetis, Eris (dewi perselisihan) menawarkan apel emas bagi dewi tercantik; Hera, Athena, dan Aphrodite berebut kehormatan itu dan Zeus menunjuk pangeran Troya, Paris, sebagai hakim.
statement.en: At the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, Eris (goddess of strife) offered a golden apple for the most beautiful goddess; Hera, Athena and Aphrodite vied for the honour and Zeus appointed the Trojan prince Paris as judge.

claims.quote: Aphrodite offered the most beautiful woman in the world. Paris chose Aphrodite and so the victorious goddess gave him fair Helen of Sparta.

statement.id: Aphrodite menawarkan perempuan tercantik di dunia; Paris memilih Aphrodite sehingga sang dewi pemenang memberinya Helena dari Sparta yang jelita.
statement.en: Aphrodite offered the most beautiful woman in the world; Paris chose Aphrodite and the victorious goddess gave him fair Helen of Sparta.

claims.quote: In notable episodes, Aphrodite protects her son Aeneas from Diomedes and saves the hapless Paris from the wrath of Menelaos.

statement.id: Dalam episode-episode penting, Aphrodite melindungi putranya Aeneas dari Diomedes dan menyelamatkan Paris yang malang dari murka Menelaos.
statement.en: In notable episodes Aphrodite protects her son Aeneas from Diomedes and saves the hapless Paris from the wrath of Menelaos.

claims.quote: One of the goddess' most famous flings was with the beautiful Adonis. Aphrodite kept the youth safely in a chest guarded by Persephone, but the latter fell in love with him too and would not give him back to the goddess of love. Zeus was obliged to intervene, and he ruled that Adonis should spend four months of the year with each lady
claims.locator: Aphrodite Falls in Love with Adonis

statement.id: Salah satu hubungan Aphrodite yang paling terkenal adalah dengan Adonis yang rupawan; Aphrodite menyimpan pemuda itu di dalam peti yang dijaga Persephone, tetapi Persephone pun jatuh cinta dan tak mau mengembalikannya, sehingga Zeus turun tangan dan memutuskan Adonis tinggal empat bulan setahun bersama masing-masing dewi.
statement.en: One of the goddess's most famous flings was with the beautiful Adonis; Aphrodite kept the youth in a chest guarded by Persephone, who fell in love with him too and would not give him back, so Zeus intervened and ruled that Adonis spend four months of the year with each lady.

claims.quote: Aphrodite was distraught at her loss, and her grief was commemorated in a cult, the annual highlight of which was a women-only festival, the Adonia.
claims.locator: Aphrodite Falls in Love with Adonis

statement.id: Aphrodite sangat berduka atas kehilangan Adonis, dan dukanya diperingati dalam sebuah kultus yang puncak tahunannya adalah festival khusus perempuan, Adonia.
statement.en: Aphrodite was distraught at her loss, and her grief was commemorated in a cult whose annual highlight was a women-only festival, the Adonia.

claims.quote: She is usually clothed in Archaic and Classical art and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire, and seductive allurement.
claims.locator: How is Aphrodite Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Arkaik dan Klasik ia biasanya berpakaian dan mengenakan pita atau ikat pinggang bersulam rumit melintang di dadanya, yang menyimpan kekuatan ajaibnya akan cinta, hasrat, dan daya pikat.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical art she is usually clothed and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire and seductive allurement.

claims.quote: The goddess is often identified with one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre, and a flower.
claims.locator: How is Aphrodite Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sang dewi sering dikenali dari satu atau lebih benda berikut: cermin, apel, karangan myrtus, burung suci atau merpati, tongkat kerajaan, dan bunga.
statement.en: The goddess is often identified by one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre and a flower.

claims.quote: Hesiod describes the goddess as 'quick-glancing', 'foam-born', 'smile-loving', and most often as 'golden Aphrodite'.

statement.id: Hesiod menggambarkan sang dewi sebagai "bermata cepat", "lahir dari buih", "pencinta senyum", dan paling sering sebagai "Aphrodite yang keemasan".
statement.en: Hesiod describes the goddess as "quick-glancing", "foam-born", "smile-loving", and most often as "golden Aphrodite".

claims.quote: Aphrodite was married to the lame god Hephaistos, master of fire and crafts.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite menikah dengan dewa pincang Hephaistos, penguasa api dan kerajinan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Aphrodite was married to the lame god Hephaistos, master of fire and crafts.
